# V. Multivariate Data analysis - PCA

```{r}
# Multivariate Data Analysis for Soil Dataset using explor package
# Load required libraries
library(explor)
library(FactoMineR)
library(factoextra)
library(corrplot)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(RColorBrewer)

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("MULTIVARIATE DATA ANALYSIS - SOIL DATASET\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# Prepare the data for multivariate analysis
cat("Preparing soil data for multivariate analysis...\n")

# First, let's examine the data structure
cat("Examining soil_data structure...\n")
cat("• Total rows in soil_data:", nrow(soil_data), "\n")
cat("• Total columns:", ncol(soil_data), "\n")
cat("• Column names:", paste(names(soil_data)[1:min(10, ncol(soil_data))], collapse = ", "), "...\n\n")

# Get all numeric variables, excluding ID-like variables and year dummies
excluded_vars <- c("Plot_ID", "Plot_ID_3", "Plot_ID_2", "Plot", "Detailed_Plot",
                   "Sampling_Date", "Sample_Type", "Depth_cm", "Strip", "Remarks",
                   "Plot_Verification", "Year", "Campaign", "Texture",
                   "Number_of_Analyses_per_Plot", "Year_Before_Last_Analysis",
                   "Year_Last_Analysis", "Result_Before_Last_Analysis", 
                   "Result_Last_Analysis", "Analysis_Rank",
                   # Exclude year dummy variables
                   paste0("Year_", 1995:2024))

# Get numeric variables
numeric_vars <- soil_data %>%
  select_if(is.numeric) %>%
  select(-any_of(excluded_vars)) %>%
  names()

cat("Identified numeric variables:", length(numeric_vars), "\n")
if(length(numeric_vars) > 0) {
  cat("Variables for PCA:\n")
  for(i in 1:length(numeric_vars)) {
    cat("  ", i, ". ", numeric_vars[i], "\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("ERROR: No numeric variables found!\n")
  stop("Please check your data structure")
}

# Convert all numeric variables to proper numeric format
for(var in numeric_vars) {
  soil_data[[var]] <- as.numeric(as.character(soil_data[[var]]))
}

# Check for missing values in each variable
missing_summary <- soil_data %>%
  select(all_of(numeric_vars)) %>%
  summarise_all(~sum(is.na(.))) %>%
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "missing_count") %>%
  mutate(missing_percent = round(missing_count / nrow(soil_data) * 100, 2)) %>%
  arrange(desc(missing_count))

cat("\nMissing values summary:\n")
print(missing_summary)

# Remove variables with too many missing values (>80% for soil data)
vars_to_keep <- missing_summary %>%
  filter(missing_percent <= 80) %>%
  pull(variable)

cat("\nKeeping", length(vars_to_keep), "variables with ≤80% missing values\n")
cat("Variables kept:", paste(vars_to_keep, collapse = ", "), "\n")

# Variables removed due to high missingness
vars_removed <- missing_summary %>%
  filter(missing_percent > 80) %>%
  pull(variable)

if(length(vars_removed) > 0) {
  cat("Variables removed due to >80% missing:", paste(vars_removed, collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# Create analysis dataset with categorical info for supplementary analysis
categorical_vars <- c("Campaign", "Texture", "Sample_Type", "Strip", "Year")
existing_categorical <- intersect(categorical_vars, names(soil_data))

analysis_data <- soil_data %>%
  select(all_of(vars_to_keep), any_of(existing_categorical))

# Remove rows with too many missing values (>60% of numeric variables)
numeric_data_for_filtering <- analysis_data %>% select(all_of(vars_to_keep))
rows_to_keep <- rowSums(is.na(numeric_data_for_filtering)) <= length(vars_to_keep) * 0.6

analysis_data <- analysis_data[rows_to_keep, ]

cat("\nAfter filtering:\n")
cat("• Numeric variables:", length(vars_to_keep), "\n")
cat("• Categorical variables:", length(existing_categorical), "\n")
cat("• Observations:", nrow(analysis_data), "\n\n")

if(nrow(analysis_data) == 0) {
  stop("ERROR: No observations left after filtering!")
}

# Extract numeric data for PCA and handle remaining missing values
pca_data <- analysis_data %>%
  select(all_of(vars_to_keep))

# Replace remaining missing values with column medians (robust for soil data)
pca_data <- pca_data %>%
  mutate_all(~ifelse(is.na(.), median(., na.rm = TRUE), .))

# Check for and remove variables with zero variance or other issues
var_check <- apply(pca_data, 2, function(x) {
  if(all(is.na(x)) || all(is.infinite(x))) {
    return(NA)
  } else {
    return(var(x, na.rm = TRUE))
  }
})

# Identify problematic columns
zero_var_cols <- names(var_check)[var_check == 0 | is.na(var_check) | is.infinite(var_check)]

if(length(zero_var_cols) > 0) {
  cat("Removing", length(zero_var_cols), "variables with zero/NA/infinite variance:\n")
  cat(paste(zero_var_cols, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")
  pca_data <- pca_data %>% select(-all_of(zero_var_cols))
  vars_to_keep <- setdiff(vars_to_keep, zero_var_cols)
} else {
  cat("All variables have valid variance.\n\n")
}

# Remove any remaining infinite or extreme values
pca_data <- pca_data %>%
  mutate_all(~ifelse(is.infinite(.), median(., na.rm = TRUE), .)) %>%
  mutate_all(~ifelse(abs(.) > 1e6, median(., na.rm = TRUE), .))

# Scale the data (essential for PCA when variables have different units)
pca_data_scaled <- scale(pca_data)

# Add meaningful rownames
rownames(pca_data_scaled) <- paste0("Soil_Sample_", 1:nrow(pca_data_scaled))

# Update final variables
numeric_vars_final <- vars_to_keep

cat("Final dataset for PCA:\n")
cat("• Variables:", ncol(pca_data_scaled), "\n")
cat("• Observations:", nrow(pca_data_scaled), "\n")
cat("• Final variables:", paste(numeric_vars_final, collapse = ", "), "\n\n")

# Create output directory
if(!dir.exists("Enhanced_Soil_PCA_Analysis")) {
  dir.create("Enhanced_Soil_PCA_Analysis", recursive = TRUE)
}

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("1. PRINCIPAL COMPONENT ANALYSIS (PCA)\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# Perform PCA using FactoMineR
# Include supplementary categorical variables if available
if(length(existing_categorical) > 0) {
  # Prepare supplementary qualitative variables - CORRECTED SECTION
  sup_data <- analysis_data %>% 
    select(all_of(existing_categorical))
  
  # Handle NA values in supplementary variables PROPERLY
  for(col in names(sup_data)) {
    # Convert to character first to avoid factor level issues
    sup_data[[col]] <- as.character(sup_data[[col]])
    # Replace NAs with "Unknown"
    sup_data[[col]][is.na(sup_data[[col]]) | sup_data[[col]] == ""] <- "Unknown"
    # Now convert to factor (this includes "Unknown" as a valid level)
    sup_data[[col]] <- as.factor(sup_data[[col]])
  }
  
  # Find columns in supplementary data
  sup_quali <- which(names(cbind(pca_data_scaled, sup_data)) %in% existing_categorical)
  
  cat("Including supplementary categorical variables:", paste(existing_categorical, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  pca_result <- PCA(
    cbind(pca_data_scaled, sup_data), 
    scale.unit = FALSE,  # Already scaled
    quali.sup = sup_quali,  # Supplementary qualitative variables
    graph = FALSE,       # Don't show default plots
    ncp = min(10, ncol(pca_data_scaled))  # Max 10 components
  )
} else {
  cat("No supplementary categorical variables found\n")
  pca_result <- PCA(pca_data_scaled, 
                    scale.unit = FALSE,
                    graph = FALSE,
                    ncp = min(10, ncol(pca_data_scaled)))
}

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("2. INTERACTIVE PCA EXPLORATION\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

explor(pca_result)

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("3. CORRELATION ANALYSIS\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# Create correlation matrix
cor_matrix <- cor(pca_data, use = "complete.obs")

# Enhanced correlation plot
png("Enhanced_Soil_PCA_Analysis/soil_correlation_matrix.png", 
    width = 16, height = 14, units = "in", res = 300, bg = "white")

par(mar = c(2, 2, 4, 2))
corrplot(cor_matrix, 
         method = "color",
         type = "upper",
         order = "hclust",
         tl.col = "#000000",
         tl.srt = 45,
         tl.cex = 0.8,
         tl.font = 2,
         cl.cex = 1.0,
         col = colorRampPalette(c("#053061", "#2166AC", "#4393C3", "#92C5DE", 
                                 "#D1E5F0", "#F7F7F7", 
                                 "#FDDBC7", "#F4A582", "#D6604D", "#B2182B", "#67001F"))(100),
         title = "Soil Dataset - Correlation Matrix\n(Hierarchically Clustered)",
         mar = c(0,0,3,0),
         diag = FALSE,
         addCoef.col = "#000000",
         number.cex = 0.5,
         number.digits = 2,
         outline = TRUE)

dev.off()

cat("Correlation matrix saved as soil_correlation_matrix.png\n\n")

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("4. PCA SUMMARY STATISTICS\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# Print PCA summary
cat("Eigenvalues and variance explained:\n")
eigen_summary <- round(pca_result$eig, 3)
print(eigen_summary)

# Calculate how many components explain 80% of variance
cum_var <- pca_result$eig[,3]
components_80 <- which(cum_var >= 80)[1]
cat("\nComponents needed to explain 80% variance:", components_80, "\n")

cat("\nVariables with highest contributions to PC1 (Soil Structure):\n")
contrib_pc1 <- sort(pca_result$var$contrib[,1], decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(10, nrow(pca_result$var$contrib))]
print(round(contrib_pc1, 2))

cat("\nVariables with highest contributions to PC2 (Soil Chemistry):\n")
contrib_pc2 <- sort(pca_result$var$contrib[,2], decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(10, nrow(pca_result$var$contrib))]
print(round(contrib_pc2, 2))

cat("\nVariables with highest quality of representation (Cos2) on PC1-PC2:\n")
cos2_pc12 <- pca_result$var$cos2[,1] + pca_result$var$cos2[,2]
best_represented <- sort(cos2_pc12, decreasing = TRUE)[1:min(10, length(cos2_pc12))]
print(round(best_represented, 3))

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("5. DETAILED PCA VISUALIZATIONS\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# 1. Enhanced scree plot
scree_plot <- fviz_eig(pca_result, 
                       addlabels = TRUE, 
                       ylim = c(0, max(pca_result$eig[,2]) * 1.1),
                       barfill = "#8B4513",
                       barcolor = "#2F4F4F",
                       linecolor = "#DC143C") +
  ggtitle("PCA Scree Plot - Soil Dataset") +
  labs(subtitle = paste("First", components_80, "components explain 80% of variance")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 16, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12))

ggsave("Enhanced_Soil_PCA_Analysis/soil_pca_scree_plot.png", scree_plot,
       width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# 2. Enhanced biplot
biplot <- fviz_pca_biplot(pca_result, 
                         repel = TRUE,
                         col.var = "#8B4513",
                         col.ind = "#696969",
                         alpha.ind = 0.3,
                         alpha.var = 0.8,
                         title = "PCA Biplot - Soil Variables and Samples",
                         subtitle = paste("PC1 (", round(pca_result$eig[1,2], 1), "%) vs PC2 (", 
                                        round(pca_result$eig[2,2], 1), "%)", sep="")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11))

ggsave("Enhanced_Soil_PCA_Analysis/soil_pca_biplot.png", biplot,
       width = 12, height = 9, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# 3. Variables contribution plot
var_plot <- fviz_pca_var(pca_result,
                        col.var = "contrib",
                        gradient.cols = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07"),
                        repel = TRUE,
                        title = "Soil Variables Contribution to PC1-PC2",
                        subtitle = "Color intensity = Contribution level") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11))

ggsave("Enhanced_Soil_PCA_Analysis/soil_pca_variables_plot.png", var_plot,
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# 4. Variables quality plot (cos2)
cos2_plot <- fviz_pca_var(pca_result,
                         col.var = "cos2",
                         gradient.cols = c("#BB4444", "#EE9988", "#FFFFFF", "#77AADD", "#4477AA"),
                         repel = TRUE,
                         title = "Soil Variables Quality of Representation (Cos2)",
                         subtitle = "How well variables are represented by PC1-PC2") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11))

ggsave("Enhanced_Soil_PCA_Analysis/soil_pca_variables_cos2_plot.png", cos2_plot,
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# 5. Individuals plot colored by contribution
ind_plot <- fviz_pca_ind(pca_result,
                        col.ind = "contrib",
                        gradient.cols = c("#00AFBB", "#E7B800", "#FC4E07"),
                        repel = FALSE,
                        alpha.ind = 0.6,
                        title = "Soil Samples Plot - Colored by Contribution",
                        subtitle = "Each point represents one soil sample") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
        plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11))

ggsave("Enhanced_Soil_PCA_Analysis/soil_pca_individuals_plot.png", ind_plot,
       width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

cat("PCA visualization plots saved:\n")
cat("• soil_pca_scree_plot.png - Variance explained by each component\n")
cat("• soil_pca_biplot.png - Variables and observations together\n")
cat("• soil_pca_variables_plot.png - Variables contribution plot\n")
cat("• soil_pca_variables_cos2_plot.png - Variables quality representation\n")
cat("• soil_pca_individuals_plot.png - Individual soil samples plot\n\n")

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("6. SUPPLEMENTARY CATEGORICAL ANALYSIS\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# Analyze supplementary categorical variables if available
if(length(existing_categorical) > 0) {
  for(cat_var in existing_categorical) {
    if(cat_var %in% names(analysis_data)) {
      cat("Analyzing", cat_var, "...\n")
      
      # Create plot colored by categorical variable
      cat_levels <- unique(analysis_data[[cat_var]])
      cat_levels <- cat_levels[!is.na(cat_levels) & cat_levels != "" & cat_levels != "Unknown"]
      
      if(length(cat_levels) > 1 && length(cat_levels) <= 20) {
        # Create color palette
        if(length(cat_levels) <= 8) {
          colors <- RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(max(3, length(cat_levels)), "Set2")[1:length(cat_levels)]
        } else {
          colors <- rainbow(length(cat_levels))
        }
        
        # Plot individuals colored by categorical variable
        tryCatch({
          sup_plot <- fviz_pca_ind(pca_result,
                                  habillage = cat_var,
                                  palette = colors,
                                  addEllipses = TRUE,
                                  ellipse.level = 0.68,
                                  repel = FALSE,
                                  alpha.ind = 0.7,
                                  title = paste("PCA - Soil Samples colored by", cat_var),
                                  subtitle = paste("Ellipses show 68% confidence intervals")) +
            theme_minimal() +
            theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 14, face = "bold"),
                  plot.subtitle = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 11),
                  legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"))
          
          filename <- paste0("Enhanced_Soil_PCA_Analysis/soil_pca_by_", tolower(cat_var), ".png")
          ggsave(filename, sup_plot, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
          
          cat("  • Saved:", filename, "\n")
        }, error = function(e) {
          cat("  • Could not create plot for", cat_var, ":", e$message, "\n")
        })
      } else {
        cat("  • Skipping", cat_var, "- too many levels or insufficient data\n")
      }
    }
  }
}

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("7. PEDOLOGICAL INTERPRETATION ANALYSIS\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# Group variables by pedological/soil science meaning
pedological_groups <- list(
  # Soil Chemistry
  pH_Acidity = grep("pH|ph", numeric_vars_final, value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE),
  Exchangeable_Cations = grep("Exchangeable|CEC|meq", numeric_vars_final, value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE),
  Available_Nutrients = grep("Available|P2O5", numeric_vars_final, value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE),
  
  # Soil Physics
  Particle_Size = grep("Clay|Silt|Sand|percent", numeric_vars_final, value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE),
  Water_Retention = grep("PF|moisture", numeric_vars_final, value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE),
  
  # Soil Chemistry - Organic
  Organic_Matter = grep("Organic|Carbon|Nitrogen|CN", numeric_vars_final, value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE),
  
  # Soil Fertility
  Base_Saturation = grep("Saturation|CaO|Ratio", numeric_vars_final, value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE),
  Lime_Requirements = grep("Lime|CaO|Application|Target", numeric_vars_final, value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE),
  
  # Electrical Properties
  Conductivity = grep("Conductivity|Electrical", numeric_vars_final, value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
)

# Remove empty groups and overlapping variables
pedological_groups <- pedological_groups[sapply(pedological_groups, length) > 0]

# Remove variables that appear in multiple groups (keep in first occurrence)
used_vars <- c()
for(group_name in names(pedological_groups)) {
  pedological_groups[[group_name]] <- setdiff(pedological_groups[[group_name]], used_vars)
  used_vars <- c(used_vars, pedological_groups[[group_name]])
}

# Remove empty groups after deduplication
pedological_groups <- pedological_groups[sapply(pedological_groups, length) > 0]

cat("Pedological variable groups identified:\n")
for(group_name in names(pedological_groups)) {
  cat("•", group_name, ":", length(pedological_groups[[group_name]]), "variables\n")
  cat("  Variables:", paste(pedological_groups[[group_name]], collapse = ", "), "\n")
}

# Create contribution analysis by pedological groups
cat("\nContribution of pedological groups to first 3 PCs:\n")
for(i in 1:min(3, ncol(pca_result$var$contrib))) {
  cat("\n--- PC", i, "(", round(pca_result$eig[i,2], 1), "% variance) ---\n")
  
  for(group_name in names(pedological_groups)) {
    group_vars <- intersect(pedological_groups[[group_name]], rownames(pca_result$var$contrib))
    if(length(group_vars) > 0) {
      group_contrib <- sum(pca_result$var$contrib[group_vars, i], na.rm = TRUE)
      cat(group_name, "group total contribution:", round(group_contrib, 2), "%\n")
    }
  }
}

cat("================================================================\n")
cat("8. SAVE COMPREHENSIVE RESULTS\n")
cat("================================================================\n")

# Save all PCA results
save(pca_result, pca_data, pca_data_scaled, cor_matrix, 
     pedological_groups, analysis_data, numeric_vars_final,
     file = "Enhanced_Soil_PCA_Analysis/soil_pca_complete_results.RData")

# Create comprehensive summary table
n_components <- min(10, nrow(pca_result$eig))
summary_table <- data.frame(
  Component = paste0("PC", 1:n_components),
  Eigenvalue = round(pca_result$eig[1:n_components, 1], 3),
  Variance_Percent = round(pca_result$eig[1:n_components, 2], 2),
  Cumulative_Percent = round(pca_result$eig[1:n_components, 3], 2)
)

write.csv(summary_table, "Enhanced_Soil_PCA_Analysis/soil_pca_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Create variable contributions table
contrib_table <- data.frame(
  Variable = rownames(pca_result$var$contrib),
  PC1_Contrib = round(pca_result$var$contrib[,1], 3),
  PC2_Contrib = round(pca_result$var$contrib[,2], 3),
  PC3_Contrib = round(pca_result$var$contrib[,3], 3),
  PC1_Cos2 = round(pca_result$var$cos2[,1], 3),
  PC2_Cos2 = round(pca_result$var$cos2[,2], 3),
  PC3_Cos2 = round(pca_result$var$cos2[,3], 3)
)

write.csv(contrib_table, "Enhanced_Soil_PCA_Analysis/soil_variables_contributions.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Create coordinates table for soil samples
coord_table <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(pca_result$ind$coord),
  PC1 = round(pca_result$ind$coord[,1], 3),
  PC2 = round(pca_result$ind$coord[,2], 3),
  PC3 = round(pca_result$ind$coord[,3], 3)
)

# Add categorical information if available
if(length(existing_categorical) > 0) {
  for(cat_var in existing_categorical) {
    if(cat_var %in% names(analysis_data)) {
      coord_table[[cat_var]] <- analysis_data[[cat_var]]
    }
  }
}

write.csv(coord_table, "Enhanced_Soil_PCA_Analysis/soil_sample_coordinates.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## V.1. 3x3 PCA Variables Plot

```{r}
# 3x3 PCA Variables Plot Grid for Soil Dataset - All Variables Visible (CORRECTED)
# Load required libraries
library(FactoMineR)

# Check if PCA result exists
if(!exists("pca_result")) {
  stop("ERROR: pca_result not found. Please run the PCA analysis first!")
}

# Validate PCA result structure
if(is.null(pca_result$var) || is.null(pca_result$var$coord) || is.null(pca_result$eig)) {
  stop("ERROR: Invalid PCA result structure. Please check your PCA analysis.")
}

# Get available dimensions
max_dims <- min(ncol(pca_result$var$coord), nrow(pca_result$eig))
cat("Available PCA dimensions:", max_dims, "\n")

# Define sophisticated color palettes for soil science data

# Create custom theme for bold, professional plots with UNIFORM sizing for SOIL data
theme_pca_soil <- function() {
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    # UNIFORM TEXT SIZING FOR SOIL DATA
    plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, color = "#2F4F4F", margin = margin(b = 8)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 10, hjust = 0.5, color = "#8B4513", margin = margin(b = 6)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold", color = "#654321"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 8.5, color = "#2F4F4F"),
    
    # UNIFORM LEGEND STYLING FOR SOIL
    legend.title = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold", color = "#2F4F4F", hjust = 0.5),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 8, color = "#2F4F4F"),
    legend.key.size = unit(0.45, "cm"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 8),
    legend.box.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    
    # SOIL-THEMED GRID AND BACKGROUND
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "#F5DEB3", size = 0.4, linetype = "dashed"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "#FDF5E6", size = 0.25, linetype = "dotted"),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#FFFEF7", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#FFFFFF", color = NA),
    
    # UNIFORM LEGEND BACKGROUND (SOIL THEME)
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "#FDF5E6", color = "#D2B48C", size = 0.4),
    legend.key = element_rect(fill = "transparent", color = NA),
    
    # UNIFORM MARGINS
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10),
    
    # STRIP TEXT FOR MULTI-PANEL CONSISTENCY
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 9, color = "#2F4F4F"),
    
    # ENSURE SQUARE ASPECT RATIO
    aspect.ratio = 1
  )
}

# Enhanced function to create PCA variable plot showing ALL variables for SOIL data
create_soil_pca_plot <- function(pca_result, axes = c(1, 2), plot_title = "", 
                                 color_type = "contrib") {
  
  # Check if axes exist
  if (max(axes) > max_dims) {
    return(create_placeholder_plot(plot_title, axes))
  }
  
  # Variance explained for axis labels
  var_exp_1 <- round(pca_result$eig[axes[1], 2], 1)
  var_exp_2 <- round(pca_result$eig[axes[2], 2], 1)
  
  # --- CASE 1: Contribution ---
  if (color_type == "contrib") {
    # Get contribution values for this specific axes combination
    contrib_values <- pca_result$var$contrib[, axes[1]] + pca_result$var$contrib[, axes[2]]
    contrib_min <- min(contrib_values, na.rm = TRUE)
    contrib_max <- max(contrib_values, na.rm = TRUE)
    contrib_mid <- mean(c(contrib_min, contrib_max))
    
    cat("  Contribution range:", round(contrib_min, 2), "to", round(contrib_max, 2), "\n")
    
    p <- fviz_pca_var(pca_result,
                      axes = axes,
                      col.var = "contrib",
                      alpha.var = 0.85,
                      repel = TRUE,
                      labelsize = 3.0,
                      pointsize = 2.2,
                      arrowsize = 0.7,
                      select.var = list(contrib = Inf)) +  # Show ALL variables
      scale_color_gradient2(low = "#8FBC8F", 
                            mid = "#D2691E", 
                            high = "#8B0000",
                            midpoint = contrib_mid,
                            name = "Contrib\n%",
                            limits = c(contrib_min, contrib_max),
                            guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", 
                                                   title.hjust = 0.5,
                                                   barwidth = 1.3,
                                                   barheight = 5.0,
                                                   ticks.colour = "#2F4F4F",
                                                   ticks.linewidth = 0.6,
                                                   frame.colour = "#2F4F4F",
                                                   frame.linewidth = 0.8)) +
      labs(title = plot_title,
           subtitle = paste0("PC", axes[1], " & PC", axes[2], " • All Soil Variables"),
           x = paste0("PC", axes[1], " (", var_exp_1, "% variance)"),
           y = paste0("PC", axes[2], " (", var_exp_2, "% variance)"))
    
  # --- CASE 2: Cos² quality ---
  } else if (color_type == "cos2") {
    p <- fviz_pca_var(pca_result,
                      axes = axes,
                      col.var = "cos2",
                      alpha.var = 0.85,
                      repel = TRUE,
                      labelsize = 3.0,
                      pointsize = 2.2,
                      arrowsize = 0.7,
                      select.var = list(cos2 = 0)) +  # Show ALL variables
      scale_color_viridis_c(option = "plasma", name = "Quality\n(Cos²)",
                            guide = guide_colorbar(title.position = "top", 
                                                   title.hjust = 0.5,
                                                   barwidth = 1.3,
                                                   barheight = 5.0,
                                                   ticks.colour = "#2F4F4F",
                                                   ticks.linewidth = 0.6,
                                                   frame.colour = "#2F4F4F",
                                                   frame.linewidth = 0.8)) +
      labs(title = plot_title,
           subtitle = paste0("PC", axes[1], " & PC", axes[2], " • All Soil Variables"),
           x = paste0("PC", axes[1], " (", var_exp_1, "% variance)"),
           y = paste0("PC", axes[2], " (", var_exp_2, "% variance)"))
  }
  
  # Apply soil theme
  p <- p + theme_pca_soil()
  
  # Add reference lines, border, and fixed square ratio
  p <- p +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "#8B4513", size = 0.9, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "solid", color = "#8B4513", size = 0.9, alpha = 0.8) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf, 
             fill = NA, color = "#2F4F4F", size = 1.3) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1,
                xlim = c(-1.1, 1.1),
                ylim = c(-1.1, 1.1),
                expand = FALSE,
                clip = "on")
  
  return(p)
}

# Function to create placeholder plot for missing dimensions
create_placeholder_plot <- function(title, axes) {
  ggplot() + 
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, 
             label = paste("PC", max(axes), "\nnot available\nin soil dataset"), 
             size = 5, color = "#8B4513", fontface = "bold") +
    annotate("text", x = 0, y = -0.3,
             label = "Insufficient components\nfor this combination",
             size = 3.5, color = "#A0522D") +
    labs(title = title, 
         subtitle = paste0("PC", axes[1], " & PC", axes[2], " • Not Available")) +
    theme_pca_soil() +
    theme(axis.text = element_blank(), 
          axis.ticks = element_blank(),
          panel.grid = element_blank()) +
    coord_fixed(ratio = 1, xlim = c(-1, 1), ylim = c(-1, 1))
}
```

# VI. Dataset Joining: Yield and Soil Data Integration

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)

# Assuming your data and soil_data are already loaded
# If not, load them with: data <- read.csv("your_yield_data.csv") and soil_data <- read.csv("your_soil_data.csv")

cat("=== INITIAL DATA PREPARATION ===\n")
cat("Yield data dimensions:", dim(data), "\n")
cat("Yield data columns:\n")
print(colnames(data))

# Extract start year from Camp, e.g. "03-04" -> 2003
data <- data %>%
  mutate(year_start = 2000 + as.numeric(substr(Camp, 1, 2)))

# Normalize parcel names: uppercase only, keep spaces
data <- data %>%
  mutate(Parcelle_norm = str_to_upper(Parcelle))

cat("\nSoil data dimensions:", dim(soil_data), "\n")
cat("Soil data columns:\n")
print(colnames(soil_data))

# Normalize parcel names in soil data: uppercase only, keep spaces + ensure Annee is numeric
soil_data <- soil_data %>%
  mutate(
    Parc.Detaillee_norm = str_to_upper(Parc.Detaillee),
    Annee = as.numeric(Annee)
  )

# --- IDENTIFY AND HANDLE DUPLICATES INTELLIGENTLY ---
cat("\n=== DUPLICATE ANALYSIS WITH CYCLE CONSIDERATION ===\n")

# Check if Cycle column exists in yield data
if(!"Cycle" %in% colnames(data)) {
  cat("WARNING: 'Cycle' column not found in yield data. Available columns are:\n")
  print(colnames(data))
  stop("Please check the column name for cycle information.")
}

# Analyze cycles in the yield data
cycle_summary <- data %>%
  count(Cycle, sort = TRUE)
cat("Cycle types in yield data:\n")
print(cycle_summary)

# Find duplicates in soil data
soil_duplicates <- soil_data %>%
  group_by(Parc.Detaillee_norm, Annee) %>%
  mutate(
    duplicate_count = n(),
    row_number = row_number()
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Count duplicated parcel-year pairs
duplicate_pairs <- soil_duplicates %>%
  filter(duplicate_count > 1) %>%
  distinct(Parc.Detaillee_norm, Annee, duplicate_count)

total_duplicate_pairs <- nrow(duplicate_pairs)
total_duplicate_rows <- sum(duplicate_pairs$duplicate_count) - total_duplicate_pairs

cat("Number of duplicated parcel-year pairs:", total_duplicate_pairs, "\n")
cat("Total duplicate rows (excluding best selection):", total_duplicate_rows, "\n")

# Show sample of duplicates
cat("\nSample of duplicate groups:\n")
sample_duplicates <- soil_duplicates %>%
  filter(duplicate_count > 1) %>%
  arrange(Parc.Detaillee_norm, Annee) %>%
  head(20)
print(sample_duplicates[, c("Parc.Detaillee_norm", "Annee", "duplicate_count", "row_number")])

# Define non-yield cycles (adjust these based on your actual data)
non_yield_cycles <- c("Friche", "Lessivage", "Jachere")

# For duplicate resolution, we need to check which cycles are available for each parcel-year
# First, get the cycle information for each parcel-year from yield data
parcel_year_cycles <- data %>%
  select(Parcelle_norm, year_start, Cycle) %>%
  distinct()

# Join soil duplicates with cycle information to make informed decisions
soil_with_cycles <- soil_duplicates %>%
  left_join(
    parcel_year_cycles,
    by = c("Parc.Detaillee_norm" = "Parcelle_norm", "Annee" = "year_start")
  )

# Smart duplicate removal: prefer records that correspond to non-"Friche/Lessivage/Jachere" cycles
soil_data_smart_dedup <- soil_with_cycles %>%
  group_by(Parc.Detaillee_norm, Annee) %>%
  mutate(
    # Create priority: lower number = higher priority
    # If we have cycle info and it's a non-yield cycle, give it priority 2, others get priority 1
    # If no cycle info available, give priority 1.5 (neutral)
    priority = case_when(
      is.na(Cycle) ~ 1.5,  # No cycle info available
      Cycle %in% non_yield_cycles ~ 2,  # Non-yield cycles get lower priority
      TRUE ~ 1  # Other cycles get high priority
    ),
    # Within same priority, keep first occurrence
    priority_rank = row_number()
  ) %>%
  # Keep the record with highest priority (lowest priority number)
  # If tied, keep first occurrence within that priority
  filter(priority == min(priority) & priority_rank == 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-duplicate_count, -row_number, -priority, -priority_rank, -Cycle)  # Remove Cycle as it was just for decision making

cat("\nAfter smart duplicate removal:")
cat("\nSoil data dimensions:", dim(soil_data_smart_dedup), "\n")

# Analyze what cycles were selected for duplicates
duplicate_resolution_summary <- soil_duplicates %>%
  filter(duplicate_count > 1) %>%
  left_join(
    parcel_year_cycles,
    by = c("Parc.Detaillee_norm" = "Parcelle_norm", "Annee" = "year_start")
  ) %>%
  group_by(Parc.Detaillee_norm, Annee) %>%
  summarise(
    cycles_available = ifelse(all(is.na(Cycle)), "No cycle info", paste(unique(Cycle[!is.na(Cycle)]), collapse = ", ")),
    has_non_yield = any(!is.na(Cycle) & Cycle %in% non_yield_cycles),
    has_yield_cycle = any(!is.na(Cycle) & !Cycle %in% non_yield_cycles),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    data %>% select(Parcelle_norm, year_start, Cycle),
    by = c("Parc.Detaillee_norm" = "Parcelle_norm", "Annee" = "year_start"),
    suffix = c("", "_selected")
  )

cat("\n=== DUPLICATE RESOLUTION ANALYSIS ===\n")
cat("Cases where non-yield cycles were avoided:\n")
avoided_non_yield <- duplicate_resolution_summary %>%
  filter(has_yield_cycle & !Cycle %in% non_yield_cycles)
cat("Count:", nrow(avoided_non_yield), "\n")

cat("\nCases where only non-yield cycles were available:\n")
forced_non_yield <- duplicate_resolution_summary %>%
  filter(!has_yield_cycle & Cycle %in% non_yield_cycles)
cat("Count:", nrow(forced_non_yield), "\n")

if(nrow(forced_non_yield) > 0) {
  cat("These parcel-years may not have matching yield data:\n")
  print(forced_non_yield[, c("Parc.Detaillee_norm", "Annee", "Cycle", "cycles_available")])
}

# --- PERFORM THE JOIN ---
cat("\n=== JOINING DATASETS ===\n")

# Join the datasets
joined_data <- data %>%
  inner_join(
    soil_data_smart_dedup,
    by = c("Parcelle_norm" = "Parc.Detaillee_norm", "year_start" = "Annee")
  )

cat("Joined data dimensions:", dim(joined_data), "\n")
cat("Number of successfully joined records:", nrow(joined_data), "\n")

# Analyze cycles in joined data
joined_cycle_summary <- joined_data %>%
  count(Cycle, sort = TRUE)
cat("\nCycle distribution in joined data:\n")
print(joined_cycle_summary)

# Check if any non-yield cycles made it through
non_yield_in_joined <- joined_data %>%
  filter(Cycle %in% non_yield_cycles)
cat("\nRecords with non-yield cycles in final dataset:", nrow(non_yield_in_joined), "\n")
if(nrow(non_yield_in_joined) > 0) {
  cat("These may indicate parcel-years where only non-yield cycles were available:\n")
  print(non_yield_in_joined[, c("Parcelle_norm", "year_start", "Cycle")])
}

# --- CREATE LINKAGE SUMMARY ---
yield_keys <- data %>%
  distinct(Parcelle_norm, year_start) %>%
  rename(Year = year_start, Parcel = Parcelle_norm)

soil_keys <- soil_data_smart_dedup %>%
  distinct(Parc.Detaillee_norm, Annee) %>%
  rename(Year = Annee, Parcel = Parc.Detaillee_norm)

common_keys <- inner_join(yield_keys, soil_keys, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))
only_in_yield <- anti_join(yield_keys, soil_keys, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))
only_in_soil <- anti_join(soil_keys, yield_keys, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))

cat("\n=== LINKAGE SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Total unique parcel-year in yield data: ", nrow(yield_keys), "\n")
cat("Total unique parcel-year in soil data : ", nrow(soil_keys), "\n")
cat("Common parcel-year pairs               : ", nrow(common_keys), "\n")
cat("Parcel-years only in yield data        : ", nrow(only_in_yield), "\n")
cat("Parcel-years only in soil data         : ", nrow(only_in_soil), "\n")

# --- SAVE THE JOINED DATASET ---
output_filename <- "joined_yield_soil_data.csv"
write.csv(joined_data, output_filename, row.names = FALSE)
cat("\nJoined dataset saved as:", output_filename, "\n")

# --- DATASET STRUCTURE AND SUMMARY ---
cat("\n=== FINAL DATASET STRUCTURE ===\n")
str(joined_data)

cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
summary(joined_data)

# --- COLUMN OVERVIEW ---
cat("\n=== COLUMN OVERVIEW ===\n")
cat("Total columns in joined dataset:", ncol(joined_data), "\n")

cat("\nColumn names:\n")
print(colnames(joined_data))

# --- CYCLE ANALYSIS IN JOINED DATA ---
cat("\n=== OBSERVATIONS PER CYCLE IN JOINED DATA ===\n")
cycle_counts <- joined_data %>%
  count(Cycle, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2),
    is_non_yield = Cycle %in% non_yield_cycles
  )

print(cycle_counts)

cat("\nSUMMARY:\n")
cat("Total observations:", sum(cycle_counts$n), "\n")
cat("Yield-producing cycles:", sum(cycle_counts$n[!cycle_counts$is_non_yield]), 
    "(", round(sum(cycle_counts$n[!cycle_counts$is_non_yield]) / sum(cycle_counts$n) * 100, 1), "%)\n")
cat("Non-yield cycles:", sum(cycle_counts$n[cycle_counts$is_non_yield]), 
    "(", round(sum(cycle_counts$n[cycle_counts$is_non_yield]) / sum(cycle_counts$n) * 100, 1), "%)\n")

# Show year-by-year cycle distribution
cat("\n=== CYCLE DISTRIBUTION BY YEAR ===\n")
yearly_cycles <- joined_data %>%
  group_by(year_start, Cycle) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = Cycle, values_from = count, values_fill = 0) %>%
  arrange(year_start)

print(yearly_cycles)

# --- ADDITIONAL INSIGHTS ---
cat("\n=== ADDITIONAL INSIGHTS ===\n")
cat("Year range in joined data:", min(joined_data$year_start, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(joined_data$year_start, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("Number of unique parcels:", length(unique(joined_data$Parcelle_norm)), "\n")
cat("Average records per parcel:", round(nrow(joined_data) / length(unique(joined_data$Parcelle_norm)), 2), "\n")

# Show sample of final joined data
cat("\n=== SAMPLE OF JOINED DATA ===\n")
print(head(joined_data, 10))

cat("\n=== FINAL VALIDATION ===\n")
cat("Duplicate parcel-year combinations in final dataset:", 
    nrow(joined_data) - nrow(distinct(joined_data, Parcelle_norm, year_start)), "\n")
```

## VI.1. Yearly Analysis and Visualization of Joined Data

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(scales)
library(gridExtra)
library(RColorBrewer)

# Assuming joined_data is available from previous script
joined_data <- read.csv("joined_yield_soil_data.csv")

cat("=== YEARLY DATA ANALYSIS ===\n")

# --- OBSERVATIONS PER YEAR ---
yearly_counts <- joined_data %>%
  group_by(year_start) %>%
  summarise(
    observations = n(),
    unique_parcels = n_distinct(Parcelle_norm),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(year_start)

cat("Observations per year:\n")
print(yearly_counts)

cat("\nSummary statistics:\n")
cat("Total years covered:", length(unique(joined_data$year_start)), "\n")
cat("Year range:", min(joined_data$year_start), "-", max(joined_data$year_start), "\n")
cat("Average observations per year:", round(mean(yearly_counts$observations), 1), "\n")
cat("Total observations:", sum(yearly_counts$observations), "\n")

# --- HIGH-RESOLUTION PLOT SETTINGS ---
# Set up high-resolution graphics
options(bitmapType='cairo')

# Custom theme for professional plots
theme_professional <- function() {
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray30", margin = margin(b = 20)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.5),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
    )
}

# --- PLOT 1: OBSERVATIONS PER YEAR (BAR CHART) ---
p1 <- ggplot(yearly_counts, aes(x = year_start, y = observations)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#2E86AB", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = observations), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = yearly_counts$year_start, 
                     labels = yearly_counts$year_start) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Observations per Year",
    subtitle = "Total observations in joined dataset by year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Observations"
  ) +
  theme_professional() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# --- PLOT 2: UNIQUE PARCELS PER YEAR ---
p2 <- ggplot(yearly_counts, aes(x = year_start, y = unique_parcels)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#A23B72", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
  geom_text(aes(label = unique_parcels), vjust = -0.5, size = 3.5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = yearly_counts$year_start, 
                     labels = yearly_counts$year_start) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = comma, expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(
    title = "Number of Unique Parcels per Year",
    subtitle = "Distinct parcels observed each year",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Number of Unique Parcels"
  ) +
  theme_professional() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# --- PLOT 3: DUAL AXIS PLOT ---
# Normalize values for dual plotting
yearly_counts_norm <- yearly_counts %>%
  mutate(
    obs_scaled = scale(observations)[,1],
    parcels_scaled = scale(unique_parcels)[,1]
  )

p3 <- ggplot(yearly_counts, aes(x = year_start)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = observations, color = "Observations"), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = observations, color = "Observations"), size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_line(aes(y = unique_parcels * max(observations)/max(unique_parcels), color = "Unique Parcels"), 
            size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = unique_parcels * max(observations)/max(unique_parcels), color = "Unique Parcels"), 
             size = 3, alpha = 0.8) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Number of Observations",
    labels = comma,
    sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . * max(yearly_counts$unique_parcels)/max(yearly_counts$observations), 
                        name = "Number of Unique Parcels", labels = comma)
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = yearly_counts$year_start) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Observations" = "#2E86AB", "Unique Parcels" = "#A23B72")) +
  labs(
    title = "Observations and Unique Parcels Trends Over Time",
    subtitle = "Dual-axis view of data coverage by year",
    x = "Year",
    color = "Metric"
  ) +
  theme_professional() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    axis.title.y.left = element_text(color = "#2E86AB"),
    axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = "#A23B72"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# --- PLOT 4: HEATMAP OF DATA DENSITY ---
# Create a more detailed breakdown if there are multiple parcels per year
parcel_year_matrix <- joined_data %>%
  count(Parcelle_norm, year_start, name = "observations") %>%
  arrange(Parcelle_norm, year_start)

# Select top parcels by total observations for visualization
top_parcels <- parcel_year_matrix %>%
  group_by(Parcelle_norm) %>%
  summarise(total_obs = sum(observations), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  arrange(desc(total_obs)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 20) %>%
  pull(Parcelle_norm)

heatmap_data <- parcel_year_matrix %>%
  filter(Parcelle_norm %in% top_parcels)

p4 <- ggplot(heatmap_data, aes(x = factor(year_start), y = Parcelle_norm, fill = observations)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Observations", trans = "sqrt", labels = comma) +
  labs(
    title = "Data Density Heatmap: Top 20 Parcels by Total Observations",
    subtitle = "Square root scale to highlight patterns in observation frequency",
    x = "Year",
    y = "Parcel"
  ) +
  theme_professional() +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 8),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.grid = element_blank()
  )

# --- SAVE HIGH-RESOLUTION PLOTS ---
ggsave("observations_per_year.png", p1, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave("unique_parcels_per_year.png", p2, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave("trends_dual_axis.png", p3, width = 14, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")
ggsave("data_density_heatmap.png", p4, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# --- COMBINED PLOT ---
combined_plot <- grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2, 
                             top = "Yearly Data Overview - Joined Dataset")
ggsave("yearly_overview_combined.png", combined_plot, width = 16, height = 8, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

# --- DISPLAY PLOTS ---
print(p1)
print(p2)
print(p3)
print(p4)

# --- ADDITIONAL STATISTICS ---
cat("\n=== ADDITIONAL YEARLY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("Years with most observations:\n")
print(yearly_counts %>% arrange(desc(observations)) %>% head(5))

cat("\nYears with most unique parcels:\n")
print(yearly_counts %>% arrange(desc(unique_parcels)) %>% head(5))

cat("\nObservations per parcel by year (mean):\n")
obs_per_parcel <- yearly_counts %>%
  mutate(obs_per_parcel = round(observations / unique_parcels, 2)) %>%
  select(year_start, obs_per_parcel)
print(obs_per_parcel)

# --- DATA COMPLETENESS ANALYSIS ---
cat("\n=== DATA COMPLETENESS BY YEAR ===\n")
completeness <- joined_data %>%
  group_by(year_start) %>%
  summarise(
    total_records = n(),
    complete_records = sum(complete.cases(.)),
    completeness_pct = round((complete_records / total_records) * 100, 1),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )
print(completeness)
```

## VI.3. Crop Cycle Analysis and Visualization (Extended Version)

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# SUGARCANE SOIL ANALYSIS WITH PUBLICATION-READY VISUALIZATIONS
# Extended for higher ratoon cycles (up to 13+ ratoons) and special classes
# Professional styling for scientific publications - ENHANCED VERSION
# ============================================================================

# Load required libraries 
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gridExtra)
library(scales)
library(viridis)
library(stringr)

# Assuming your subset_data is already loaded
# If not, uncomment the next line:
subset_data <- read.csv("sugarcane_soil_analysis_subsetv2.csv")

# ============================================================================
# PUBLICATION THEME SETUP
# ============================================================================
publication_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", margin = margin(b = 15)),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray95", size = 0.3),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA)
  )

# ============================================================================
# ENHANCED CROP CYCLE LABELING FUNCTION - EXTENDED VERSION
# ============================================================================
create_crop_cycle_label <- function(cycle) {
  case_when(
    # Handle string-based special classes first
    is.character(cycle) & tolower(cycle) %in% c("essais", "essai") ~ "Trials (Essais)",
    is.character(cycle) & tolower(cycle) %in% c("jachere", "jacheres") ~ "Fallow (Jachere)",
    is.character(cycle) & tolower(cycle) %in% c("unknown", "na", "") ~ "Unknown",
    
    # Handle numeric cycles
    is.numeric(cycle) | (!is.na(as.numeric(cycle)) & !is.character(cycle)) ~ {
      numeric_cycle <- as.numeric(cycle)
      case_when(
        numeric_cycle == 0 ~ "Plant Cane (PC)",
        numeric_cycle == 1 ~ "1st Ratoon (R1)",
        numeric_cycle == 2 ~ "2nd Ratoon (R2)",
        numeric_cycle == 3 ~ "3rd Ratoon (R3)",
        numeric_cycle == 4 ~ "4th Ratoon (R4)",
        numeric_cycle == 5 ~ "5th Ratoon (R5)",
        numeric_cycle == 6 ~ "6th Ratoon (R6)",
        numeric_cycle == 7 ~ "7th Ratoon (R7)",
        numeric_cycle == 8 ~ "8th Ratoon (R8)",
        numeric_cycle == 9 ~ "9th Ratoon (R9)",
        numeric_cycle == 10 ~ "10th Ratoon (R10)",
        numeric_cycle == 11 ~ "11th Ratoon (R11)",
        numeric_cycle == 12 ~ "12th Ratoon (R12)",
        numeric_cycle == 13 ~ "13th Ratoon (R13)",
        numeric_cycle >= 14 ~ paste0(numeric_cycle, "th Ratoon (R", numeric_cycle, ")"),
        is.na(numeric_cycle) ~ "Unknown Cycle",
        TRUE ~ paste0("Ratoon ", numeric_cycle, " (R", numeric_cycle, ")")
      )
    },
    
    # Handle any remaining cases
    is.na(cycle) ~ "Unknown Cycle",
    TRUE ~ as.character(cycle)
  )
}

# Enhanced function to create crop type categories
create_crop_type_category <- function(cycle) {
  case_when(
    is.character(cycle) & tolower(cycle) %in% c("essais", "essai") ~ "Experimental",
    is.character(cycle) & tolower(cycle) %in% c("jachere", "jacheres") ~ "Fallow Land",
    is.numeric(cycle) | (!is.na(as.numeric(cycle)) & !is.character(cycle)) ~ {
      numeric_cycle <- as.numeric(cycle)
      case_when(
        numeric_cycle == 0 ~ "Plant Cane",
        numeric_cycle >= 1 & numeric_cycle <= 3 ~ "Young Ratoons (1-3)",
        numeric_cycle >= 4 & numeric_cycle <= 7 ~ "Mature Ratoons (4-7)",
        numeric_cycle >= 8 & numeric_cycle <= 13 ~ "Old Ratoons (8-13)",
        numeric_cycle > 13 ~ "Very Old Ratoons (>13)",
        is.na(numeric_cycle) ~ "Unknown",
        TRUE ~ "Ratoon Crop"
      )
    },
    is.na(cycle) ~ "Unknown",
    TRUE ~ "Other"
  )
}

# Function to create numeric order for sorting
get_cycle_order <- function(cycle) {
  case_when(
    is.character(cycle) & tolower(cycle) %in% c("essais", "essai") ~ -2,
    is.character(cycle) & tolower(cycle) %in% c("jachere", "jacheres") ~ -1,
    is.numeric(cycle) | (!is.na(as.numeric(cycle)) & !is.character(cycle)) ~ as.numeric(cycle),
    is.na(cycle) ~ 999,
    TRUE ~ 1000
  )
}

        crop_cycle == "" ~ NA,

    )
}
```

# VII. Proximity Matching Analysis for Enhanced Joining

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

# Assuming your data and soil_data are already loaded and normalized
# (Using the same normalization from your original code)

cat("=== ENHANCED PARCEL MATCHING ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Ensure data is normalized (from your original code)
data <- data %>%
  mutate(
    year_start = 2000 + as.numeric(substr(Camp, 1, 2)),
    Parcelle_norm = str_to_upper(Parcelle)
  )

soil_data <- soil_data %>%
  mutate(
    Parc.Detaillee_norm = str_to_upper(Parc.Detaillee),
    Annee = as.numeric(Annee)
  )

# Remove duplicates from soil data (simplified version)
soil_data_clean <- soil_data %>%
  group_by(Parc.Detaillee_norm, Annee) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%  # Keep first occurrence for each parcel-year
  ungroup()

# === 1. CORRESPONDENCE ANALYSIS FOR WHOLE DATASET ===
cat("\n=== 1. CORRESPONDENCE ANALYSIS - WHOLE DATASET ===\n")

yield_keys <- data %>%
  distinct(Parcelle_norm, year_start) %>%
  rename(Year = year_start, Parcel = Parcelle_norm)

soil_keys <- soil_data_clean %>%
  distinct(Parc.Detaillee_norm, Annee) %>%
  rename(Year = Annee, Parcel = Parc.Detaillee_norm)

# Direct matches
direct_matches <- inner_join(yield_keys, soil_keys, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))
only_in_yield <- anti_join(yield_keys, soil_keys, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))
only_in_soil <- anti_join(soil_keys, yield_keys, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))

cat("WHOLE DATASET SUMMARY:\n")
cat("Total unique parcel-year in yield data: ", nrow(yield_keys), "\n")
cat("Total unique parcel-year in soil data : ", nrow(soil_keys), "\n")
cat("Direct matches (found correspondences) : ", nrow(direct_matches), "\n")
cat("Parcel-years only in yield data       : ", nrow(only_in_yield), "\n")
cat("Parcel-years only in soil data        : ", nrow(only_in_soil), "\n")
cat("Match rate for soil data: ", round(nrow(direct_matches) / nrow(soil_keys) * 100, 2), "%\n")

# === 2. CORRESPONDENCE ANALYSIS FOR YIELD YEAR RANGE ===
cat("\n=== 2. CORRESPONDENCE ANALYSIS - YIELD YEAR RANGE ===\n")

yield_year_range <- range(yield_keys$Year, na.rm = TRUE)
cat("Yield data year range: ", yield_year_range[1], "-", yield_year_range[2], "\n")

# Filter soil data to yield year range
soil_keys_in_yield_range <- soil_keys %>%
  filter(Year >= yield_year_range[1] & Year <= yield_year_range[2])

only_in_soil_yield_range <- anti_join(soil_keys_in_yield_range, yield_keys, by = c("Parcel", "Year"))

cat("YIELD RANGE SUMMARY:\n")
cat("Soil data parcel-years in yield range : ", nrow(soil_keys_in_yield_range), "\n")
cat("Unmatched soil data in yield range    : ", nrow(only_in_soil_yield_range), "\n")
cat("Match rate in yield range: ", round((nrow(soil_keys_in_yield_range) - nrow(only_in_soil_yield_range)) / nrow(soil_keys_in_yield_range) * 100, 2), "%\n")

# === 3. PARCEL ID ANALYSIS AND PROXIMITY MATCHING ===
cat("\n=== 3. PARCEL ID STRUCTURE ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Function to extract block and parcel number
extract_parcel_info <- function(parcel_id) {
  # Handle cases like "MB 6C 2", "K 6A", "A 5", "B 2B", etc.
  # More flexible pattern to handle your specific format
  
  # Remove extra spaces and split
  clean_id <- str_trim(parcel_id)
  parts <- str_split(clean_id, "\\s+")[[1]]
  
  if(length(parts) >= 2) {
    block <- parts[1]  # First part is always the block
    
    # Second part contains number and possibly letter
    second_part <- parts[2]
    number_part <- str_extract(second_part, "\\d+")
    letter_part <- str_extract(second_part, "[A-Z]+")
    
    # If there's a third part, it might be an additional number or identifier
    additional_info <- if(length(parts) > 2) paste(parts[3:length(parts)], collapse = " ") else ""
    
    return(data.frame(
      original = parcel_id,
      block = block,
      number = as.numeric(number_part),
      letter = ifelse(is.na(letter_part), "", letter_part),
      additional = additional_info,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  } else {
    # Fallback for single part IDs
    return(data.frame(
      original = parcel_id,
      block = NA,
      number = NA,
      letter = "",
      additional = "",
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
}

# Analyze parcel structure in both datasets
cat("Sample parcel IDs from yield data:\n")
sample_yield_parcels <- head(unique(yield_keys$Parcel), 10)
print(sample_yield_parcels)

cat("\nSample parcel IDs from soil data:\n")
sample_soil_parcels <- head(unique(soil_keys$Parcel), 10)
print(sample_soil_parcels)

# Extract parcel information
yield_parcel_info <- do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(yield_keys$Parcel), extract_parcel_info)) %>%
  mutate(dataset = "yield") %>%
  left_join(yield_keys, by = c("original" = "Parcel"), relationship = "many-to-many")

soil_parcel_info <- do.call(rbind, lapply(unique(soil_keys$Parcel), extract_parcel_info)) %>%
  mutate(dataset = "soil") %>%
  left_join(soil_keys, by = c("original" = "Parcel"), relationship = "many-to-many")

# Analyze block distribution
cat("\nBlock distribution in yield data:\n")
yield_blocks <- yield_parcel_info %>% count(block, sort = TRUE)
print(yield_blocks)

cat("\nBlock distribution in soil data:\n")
soil_blocks <- soil_parcel_info %>% count(block, sort = TRUE)
print(soil_blocks)

# === 4. PROXIMITY MATCHING ALGORITHM ===
cat("\n=== 4. PROXIMITY MATCHING ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Function to find nearby parcels
find_nearby_parcels <- function(target_block, target_number, target_letter, target_year, 
                               available_parcels, proximity_range = 3) {
  
  candidates <- available_parcels %>%
    filter(
      block == target_block,
      Year == target_year,
      abs(number - target_number) <= proximity_range,
      number != target_number  # Exclude exact match (shouldn't exist anyway)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      distance = abs(number - target_number),
      letter_match = ifelse(letter == target_letter, 1, 0)  # 1 for match, 0 for no match
    ) %>%
    arrange(distance, desc(letter_match))  # Prefer closer numbers, then matching letters
  
  return(candidates)
}

# Apply proximity matching for unmatched soil data
unmatched_soil_with_info <- only_in_soil %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  do(cbind(., extract_parcel_info(.$Parcel))) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(-original) %>%  # Remove duplicate column
  filter(!is.na(block), !is.na(number))  # Only process parseable parcel IDs

cat("Unmatched soil parcels that can be processed: ", nrow(unmatched_soil_with_info), "\n")

# Available yield parcels for matching (ensure uniqueness)
available_yield_info <- yield_parcel_info %>%
  select(original, block, number, letter, Year) %>%
  distinct() %>%  # Ensure unique combinations
  rename(available_parcel = original)

# Perform proximity matching - ONE MATCH PER SOIL PARCEL
proximity_matches <- data.frame()

cat("Performing proximity matching...\n")
pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = nrow(unmatched_soil_with_info), style = 3)

for(i in 1:nrow(unmatched_soil_with_info)) {
  target <- unmatched_soil_with_info[i, ]
  
  nearby <- find_nearby_parcels(
    target$block, target$number, target$letter, target$Year,
    available_yield_info, proximity_range = 3
  )
  
  if(nrow(nearby) > 0) {
    best_match <- nearby[1, ]  # Take ONLY the closest match
    proximity_matches <- rbind(proximity_matches, data.frame(
      soil_parcel = target$Parcel,
      soil_year = target$Year,
      matched_yield_parcel = best_match$available_parcel,
      distance = best_match$distance,
      letter_match = best_match$letter_match,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    ))
  }
  
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
}
close(pb)

# Remove duplicates if any (each soil parcel should have max 1 match)
proximity_matches <- proximity_matches %>%
  group_by(soil_parcel, soil_year) %>%
  slice_head(n = 1) %>%  # Keep only first match per soil parcel-year
  ungroup()

cat("\n")

# === 5. RESULTS COMPARISON ===
cat("\n=== 5. RESULTS COMPARISON ===\n")

# Fix the counts - proximity matches should only apply to unmatched soil data
actual_unmatched_count <- nrow(only_in_soil_yield_range)  # Use yield range unmatched
successful_proximity_matches <- nrow(proximity_matches)

cat("ORIGINAL MATCHING RESULTS:\n")
cat("Direct matches: ", nrow(direct_matches), "\n")
cat("Unmatched soil data in yield range: ", actual_unmatched_count, "\n")

cat("\nPROXIMITY MATCHING RESULTS:\n")
cat("Additional matches found through proximity: ", successful_proximity_matches, "\n")
cat("Remaining unmatched after proximity: ", max(0, actual_unmatched_count - successful_proximity_matches), "\n")

total_matches <- nrow(direct_matches) + successful_proximity_matches
total_soil_in_range <- nrow(soil_keys_in_yield_range)
improvement_rate <- ifelse(actual_unmatched_count > 0, successful_proximity_matches / actual_unmatched_count * 100, 0)

cat("\nOVERALL IMPROVEMENT:\n")
cat("Total matches (direct + proximity): ", total_matches, "\n")
cat("Total soil data records in yield range: ", total_soil_in_range, "\n")
cat("Overall match rate: ", round(total_matches / total_soil_in_range * 100, 2), "%\n")
cat("Improvement from proximity matching: +", round(improvement_rate, 2), "% of previously unmatched\n")

# Distance analysis of proximity matches
if(nrow(proximity_matches) > 0) {
  cat("\nPROXIMITY MATCH DISTANCE ANALYSIS:\n")
  distance_summary <- proximity_matches %>%
    count(distance, sort = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2))
  print(distance_summary)
  
  letter_match_summary <- proximity_matches %>%
    count(letter_match) %>%
    mutate(percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2))
  cat("\nLetter matching in proximity matches:\n")
  print(letter_match_summary)
}

# === 6. DETAILED BREAKDOWN BY BLOCK ===
cat("\n=== 6. BLOCK-WISE ANALYSIS ===\n")

block_analysis <- unmatched_soil_with_info %>%
  group_by(block) %>%
  summarise(
    unmatched_count = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  left_join(
    proximity_matches %>%
      left_join(
        unmatched_soil_with_info %>% select(Parcel, block),
        by = c("soil_parcel" = "Parcel"),
        relationship = "many-to-many"
      ) %>%
      group_by(block) %>%
      summarise(proximity_matched = n(), .groups = "drop"),
    by = "block"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    proximity_matched = ifelse(is.na(proximity_matched), 0, proximity_matched),
    success_rate = round(proximity_matched / unmatched_count * 100, 2)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(success_rate))

cat("Block-wise proximity matching success:\n")
print(block_analysis)

# === 7. SAMPLE OF PROXIMITY MATCHES ===
cat("\n=== 7. SAMPLE OF PROXIMITY MATCHES ===\n")
if(nrow(proximity_matches) > 0) {
  sample_matches <- head(proximity_matches, 10)
  print(sample_matches)
}

# Save results
cat("\n=== SAVING RESULTS ===\n")
write.csv(direct_matches, "direct_matches.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(proximity_matches, "proximity_matches.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(only_in_soil, "unmatched_soil_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

cat("=== SIMPLIFIED YEARLY ANALYSIS FOR PROXIMITY MATCHING ===\n") 

# --- LOAD MATCH RESULTS ---

    mutate(match_type = "Direct Match")

} else {

}

# Load proximity matches

# Load original joined dataset for comparison

# --- CREATE COMBINED ANALYSIS DATASET ---
cat("\nCreating analysis dataset...\n")

# Prepare direct matches for analysis
direct_analysis <- direct_matches %>%
  select(Parcel, Year, match_type) %>%
  rename(parcel = Parcel, year = Year)

# Prepare proximity matches for analysis
if(nrow(proximity_matches) > 0) {
  proximity_analysis <- proximity_matches %>%
    select(soil_parcel, soil_year, match_type, distance, letter_match) %>%
    rename(parcel = soil_parcel, year = soil_year) %>%
    mutate(
      proximity_distance = distance,
      proximity_letter_match = letter_match
    ) %>%
    select(-distance, -letter_match)
} else {
  proximity_analysis <- data.frame()
}

# Combine all matches
if(nrow(proximity_analysis) > 0) {
  all_matches <- bind_rows(
    direct_analysis,
    proximity_analysis
  )
} else {
  all_matches <- direct_analysis
}

cat("Combined analysis dataset:", nrow(all_matches), "records\n")

# --- YEARLY STATISTICS ---
cat("\n=== YEARLY STATISTICS ===\n")

# Calculate yearly stats for enhanced dataset
yearly_stats <- all_matches %>%
  group_by(year, match_type) %>%
  summarise(
    observations = n(),
    unique_parcels = n_distinct(parcel),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Total by year
yearly_totals <- all_matches %>%
  group_by(year) %>%
  summarise(
    total_observations = n(),
    total_unique_parcels = n_distinct(parcel),
    direct_matches = sum(match_type == "Direct Match"),
    proximity_matches = sum(match_type == "Proximity Match"),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(year)

print("Enhanced dataset yearly totals:")
print(yearly_totals)

# Original dataset yearly stats (if available)
if(nrow(original_joined) > 0) {
  original_yearly <- original_joined %>%
    group_by(year_start) %>%
    summarise(
      original_observations = n(),
      original_unique_parcels = n_distinct(Parcelle_norm),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    rename(year = year_start)
  
  # Create comparison
  comparison <- yearly_totals %>%
    left_join(original_yearly, by = "year") %>%
    mutate(
      additional_obs = total_observations - coalesce(original_observations, 0),
      additional_parcels = total_unique_parcels - coalesce(original_unique_parcels, 0),
      improvement_pct = round((additional_obs / coalesce(original_observations, 1)) * 100, 1)
    )
  
  cat("\nComparison with original dataset:\n")
  print(comparison %>% 
        select(year, original_observations, total_observations, additional_obs, improvement_pct))
  
  cat("\nTotal improvement:\n")
  cat("Additional observations:", sum(comparison$additional_obs, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  cat("Additional unique parcels:", sum(comparison$additional_parcels, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
  
} else {

}

# --- PROXIMITY MATCH ANALYSIS ---

# --- PLOTTING SETUP ---
options(bitmapType='cairo')

theme_professional <- function() {
  theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray30", margin = margin(b = 20)),
      axis.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 11),
      legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.text = element_text(size = 11),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.5),
      plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
      plot.margin = margin(20, 20, 20, 20)
    )
}
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tidyr)

cat("=== CREATING COMPLETE ENHANCED DATASET ===\n")

# --- LOAD ALL REQUIRED DATA ---
cat("Loading all datasets...\n")

# Load match results
if(file.exists("direct_matches.csv")) {
  direct_matches <- read.csv("direct_matches.csv")
  cat("Direct matches loaded:", nrow(direct_matches), "records\n")
} else {
  stop("direct_matches.csv not found. Please run the proximity matching analysis first.")
}

if(file.exists("proximity_matches.csv")) {
  proximity_matches <- read.csv("proximity_matches.csv")
  cat("Proximity matches loaded:", nrow(proximity_matches), "records\n")
} else {
  proximity_matches <- data.frame()
  cat("No proximity matches found.\n")
}

# Load original datasets - try to find them
yield_data <- NULL
soil_data <- NULL

# Try to load yield data
if(exists("data")) {
  yield_data <- data
  cat("Using existing yield data object\n")
} else {
  # Try common filenames
  yield_files <- c("your_yield_data.csv", "yield_data.csv", "data.csv", "rendement_data.csv")
  for(file in yield_files) {
    if(file.exists(file)) {
      yield_data <- read.csv(file)
      cat("Yield data loaded from", file, ":", nrow(yield_data), "records\n")
      break
    }
  }
}

# Try to load soil data
if(exists("soil_data_clean")) {
  soil_data <- soil_data_clean
  cat("Using existing soil data object\n")
} else if(exists("soil_data")) {
  soil_data <- soil_data
  cat("Using existing soil_data object\n")
} else {
  # Try common filenames
  soil_files <- c("your_soil_data.csv", "soil_data.csv", "analyse_sol.csv", "sol_analysis.csv")
  for(file in soil_files) {
    if(file.exists(file)) {
      soil_data <- read.csv(file)
      cat("Soil data loaded from", file, ":", nrow(soil_data), "records\n")
      break
    }
  }
}

# Check if we have the required data
if(is.null(yield_data)) {
  cat("Warning: Yield data not found. Please ensure your yield dataset is available.\n")
  cat("Expected object name: 'data' or one of these files: yield_data.csv, your_yield_data.csv\n")
}

if(is.null(soil_data)) {
  cat("Warning: Soil data not found. Please ensure your soil dataset is available.\n") 
  cat("Expected object name: 'soil_data' or one of these files: soil_data.csv, your_soil_data.csv\n")
}

# --- NORMALIZE DATA IF LOADED ---
if(!is.null(yield_data)) {
  # Normalize yield data
  if(!"year_start" %in% names(yield_data) && "Camp" %in% names(yield_data)) {
    yield_data <- yield_data %>%
      mutate(year_start = 2000 + as.numeric(substr(Camp, 1, 2)))
  }
  
  if(!"Parcelle_norm" %in% names(yield_data) && "Parcelle" %in% names(yield_data)) {
    yield_data <- yield_data %>%
      mutate(Parcelle_norm = str_to_upper(Parcelle))
  }
  
  cat("Yield data normalized. Columns:", ncol(yield_data), "\n")
}

if(!is.null(soil_data)) {
  # Normalize soil data
  if(!"Parc.Detaillee_norm" %in% names(soil_data) && "Parc.Detaillee" %in% names(soil_data)) {
    soil_data <- soil_data %>%
      mutate(Parc.Detaillee_norm = str_to_upper(Parc.Detaillee))
  }
  
  if(!"Annee" %in% names(soil_data) && any(c("Year", "year", "Année") %in% names(soil_data))) {
    year_col <- names(soil_data)[names(soil_data) %in% c("Year", "year", "Année")][1]
    soil_data <- soil_data %>%
      mutate(Annee = as.numeric(get(year_col)))
  }
  
  # Remove duplicates
  if("Parc.Detaillee_norm" %in% names(soil_data) && "Annee" %in% names(soil_data)) {
    soil_data_clean <- soil_data %>%
      group_by(Parc.Detaillee_norm, Annee) %>%
      slice_head(n = 1) %>%
      ungroup()
    
    cat("Soil data normalized and deduplicated:", nrow(soil_data_clean), "records\n")
  } else {
    soil_data_clean <- soil_data
    cat("Soil data normalized:", nrow(soil_data_clean), "records\n")
  }
}

# --- CREATE ENHANCED DATASET WITH ALL COLUMNS ---
cat("\n=== CREATING COMPLETE ENHANCED DATASET ===\n")

if(!is.null(yield_data) && !is.null(soil_data_clean)) {
  
  # --- DIRECT MATCHES WITH ALL COLUMNS ---
  cat("Creating direct matches dataset with all columns...\n")
  
  direct_enhanced <- direct_matches %>%
    # Join with yield data
    left_join(
      yield_data,
      by = c("Parcel" = "Parcelle_norm", "Year" = "year_start"),
      suffix = c("", "_yield")
    ) %>%
    # Join with soil data  
    left_join(
      soil_data_clean,
      by = c("Parcel" = "Parc.Detaillee_norm", "Year" = "Annee"),
      suffix = c("_yield", "_soil")
    ) %>%
    # Add match metadata
    mutate(
      match_type = "Direct Match",
      match_source_parcel = Parcel,
      match_source_year = Year,
      match_target_parcel = Parcel,
      match_target_year = Year,
      match_distance = 0,
      match_letter_match = TRUE
    )
  
  cat("Direct matches enhanced dataset:", nrow(direct_enhanced), "records,", ncol(direct_enhanced), "columns\n")
  
  # --- PROXIMITY MATCHES WITH ALL COLUMNS ---
  if(nrow(proximity_matches) > 0) {
    cat("Creating proximity matches dataset with all columns...\n")
    
    proximity_enhanced <- proximity_matches %>%
      # Join with soil data (using the soil parcel)
      left_join(
        soil_data_clean,
        by = c("soil_parcel" = "Parc.Detaillee_norm", "soil_year" = "Annee"),
        suffix = c("", "_soil")
      ) %>%
      # Join with yield data (using the matched yield parcel)
      left_join(
        yield_data,
        by = c("matched_yield_parcel" = "Parcelle_norm", "soil_year" = "year_start"),
        suffix = c("_soil", "_yield")
      ) %>%
      # Standardize column names and add metadata
      mutate(
        match_type = "Proximity Match",
        Parcel = soil_parcel,
        Year = soil_year,
        match_source_parcel = soil_parcel,
        match_source_year = soil_year,
        match_target_parcel = matched_yield_parcel,
        match_target_year = soil_year,
        match_distance = distance,
        match_letter_match = letter_match
      )
    
    cat("Proximity matches enhanced dataset:", nrow(proximity_enhanced), "records,", ncol(proximity_enhanced), "columns\n")
    
    # --- COMBINE DATASETS ---
    cat("Combining datasets...\n")
    
    # Find common columns
    common_columns <- intersect(names(direct_enhanced), names(proximity_enhanced))
    cat("Common columns found:", length(common_columns), "\n")
    
    # Combine datasets using common columns
    complete_enhanced <- bind_rows(
      direct_enhanced %>% select(all_of(common_columns)),
      proximity_enhanced %>% select(all_of(common_columns))
    )
    
  } else {
    cat("No proximity matches to combine. Using direct matches only.\n")
    complete_enhanced <- direct_enhanced
    common_columns <- names(direct_enhanced)
  }
  
} else {
  cat("Error: Cannot create enhanced dataset without yield and soil data.\n")
  cat("Please ensure both datasets are loaded properly.\n")
  
  # Create minimal enhanced dataset from match files only
  cat("Creating minimal enhanced dataset from match files only...\n")
  
  minimal_direct <- direct_matches %>%
    mutate(match_type = "Direct Match")
  
  if(nrow(proximity_matches) > 0) {
    minimal_proximity <- proximity_matches %>%
      select(soil_parcel, soil_year, matched_yield_parcel, distance, letter_match) %>%
      rename(Parcel = soil_parcel, Year = soil_year) %>%
      mutate(
        match_type = "Proximity Match",
        match_distance = distance,
        match_letter_match = letter_match
      ) %>%
      select(-distance, -letter_match)
    
    complete_enhanced <- bind_rows(minimal_direct, minimal_proximity)
  } else {
    complete_enhanced <- minimal_direct
  }
  
  common_columns <- names(complete_enhanced)
}

# --- DATASET STRUCTURE ANALYSIS ---
cat("\n=== COMPLETE ENHANCED DATASET STRUCTURE ===\n")

cat("Dataset dimensions:", nrow(complete_enhanced), "rows ×", ncol(complete_enhanced), "columns\n")
cat("Match type distribution:\n")
print(table(complete_enhanced$match_type))

cat("\nColumn structure:\n")
str(complete_enhanced)

cat("\n=== SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
summary(complete_enhanced)

# --- DETAILED COLUMN ANALYSIS ---
cat("\n=== DETAILED COLUMN ANALYSIS ===\n")

cat("Column names and types:\n")
column_info <- data.frame(
  Column = names(complete_enhanced),
  Type = sapply(complete_enhanced, class),
  Non_NA = sapply(complete_enhanced, function(x) sum(!is.na(x))),
  NA_Count = sapply(complete_enhanced, function(x) sum(is.na(x))),
  Completeness_Pct = round(sapply(complete_enhanced, function(x) sum(!is.na(x))/length(x) * 100), 2),
  row.names = NULL
)

print(column_info)

# --- MATCH TYPE DETAILED ANALYSIS ---
cat("\n=== MATCH TYPE DETAILED ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Year distribution by match type
year_match_dist <- complete_enhanced %>%
  count(Year, match_type) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = match_type, values_from = n, values_fill = 0)

cat("Year distribution by match type:\n")
print(year_match_dist)

# Parcel distribution by match type
parcel_match_dist <- complete_enhanced %>%
  count(match_type, name = "total_records") %>%
  mutate(
    unique_parcels = sapply(match_type, function(mt) {
      length(unique(complete_enhanced$Parcel[complete_enhanced$match_type == mt]))
    }),
    avg_records_per_parcel = round(total_records / unique_parcels, 2)
  )

cat("\nParcel statistics by match type:\n")
print(parcel_match_dist)

# If proximity matches exist, analyze distances
if("match_distance" %in% names(complete_enhanced)) {
  proximity_distance_dist <- complete_enhanced %>%
    filter(match_type == "Proximity Match" & !is.na(match_distance)) %>%
    count(match_distance) %>%
    mutate(percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2))
  
  if(nrow(proximity_distance_dist) > 0) {
    cat("\nProximity match distance distribution:\n")
    print(proximity_distance_dist)
  }
}

# --- SAVE COMPLETE ENHANCED DATASET ---
output_filename <- "complete_enhanced_dataset.csv"
write.csv(complete_enhanced, output_filename, row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n=== DATASET SAVED ===\n")
cat("Complete enhanced dataset saved as:", output_filename, "\n")
cat("File size:", round(file.size(output_filename) / 1024 / 1024, 2), "MB\n")

# --- SAVE COLUMN INFORMATION ---
write.csv(column_info, "dataset_column_info.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Column information saved as: dataset_column_info.csv\n")

# --- FINAL SUMMARY ---
cat("\n=== FINAL SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("✓ Complete enhanced dataset created with", nrow(complete_enhanced), "records\n")
cat("✓ Total columns included:", ncol(complete_enhanced), "\n")
cat("✓ Direct matches:", sum(complete_enhanced$match_type == "Direct Match"), "\n")
if(any(complete_enhanced$match_type == "Proximity Match")) {
  cat("✓ Proximity matches:", sum(complete_enhanced$match_type == "Proximity Match"), "\n")
}
cat("✓ Year range:", min(complete_enhanced$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(complete_enhanced$Year, na.rm = TRUE), "\n")
cat("✓ Unique parcels:", length(unique(complete_enhanced$Parcel)), "\n")

# Show first few rows
cat("\n=== SAMPLE DATA (first 5 rows) ===\n")
print(head(complete_enhanced, 5))
```
