```{r}
cat("Missing columns:", length(missing_columns), "\n")

if(length(missing_columns) > 0) {
  cat("\nMissing columns:\n")
  print(missing_columns)
}

# Create the subset dataset with available columns only
if(length(available_columns) > 0) {
  sugarcane_subset <- complete_enhanced[, available_columns, drop = FALSE]
  
  # Rename "Year" to "Harvest_Year" in the subset dataset
  if("Year" %in% colnames(sugarcane_subset)) {
    colnames(sugarcane_subset)[colnames(sugarcane_subset) == "Year"] <- "Harvest_Year"
    cat("✓ Renamed 'Year' column to 'Harvest_Year'\n")
  }
  
  # Display basic information about the subset
  cat("\nSubset dataset created with", ncol(sugarcane_subset), "columns and", nrow(sugarcane_subset), "rows\n")
  cat("Column names in final dataset:\n")
  print(colnames(sugarcane_subset))
  
  # Show first few rows
  cat("\nFirst 5 rows of the subset:\n")
  print(head(sugarcane_subset, 5))
  
  # Save the subset as CSV
  output_filename <- "sugarcane_soil_analysis_subsetv3.csv"
  write.csv(sugarcane_subset, output_filename, row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("\n✓ Dataset saved as:", output_filename, "\n")
  
  # Summary statistics
  cat("\nSummary of numeric columns:\n")
  numeric_cols <- sapply(sugarcane_subset, is.numeric)
  if(sum(numeric_cols) > 0) {
    print(summary(sugarcane_subset[, numeric_cols, drop = FALSE]))
  }
  
  # Check for missing values
  cat("\nMissing values per column:\n")
  missing_counts <- sapply(sugarcane_subset, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
  print(missing_counts[missing_counts > 0])
  
} else {
  cat("ERROR: No matching columns found. Please check your column names.\n")
  cat("Available columns in your dataset:\n")
  print(head(existing_columns, 20))
}
```

## VIII.2. Model 1 modelling

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# MODEL 1: PARCEL-BASED CONSTANT SOIL VALUES PREDICTION - CORRECTED
# Predicting ratoon soil values using parcel's own plant cane baseline
# Training: Plant Cane data by parcel | Validation: Same parcels in ratoon years
# ============================================================================

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(broom)
library(corrplot)
library(viridis)

# Load data (assuming it's already loaded with parcel variable)
# subset_data <- read.csv("sugarcane_soil_analysis_subsetv2.csv")

# ============================================================================
# DEFINE SOIL VARIABLES AND PREPARE DATA
# ============================================================================

# Define all numeric soil variables
soil_variables <- c(
  "pH", 
  "Electrical_Conductivity_mmho_cm", 
  "Exchangeable_Calcium_meq_100g", 
  "Exchangeable_Magnesium_meq_100g", 
  "Exchangeable_Sodium_meq_100g", 
  "Exchangeable_Potassium_meq_100g", 
  "Available_P2O5_mg_kg", 
  "Clay_percent", 
  "Fine_Silt_percent", 
  "Coarse_Silt_percent", 
  "Fine_Sand_percent", 
  "Coarse_Sand_percent", 
  "Organic_Carbon_per_mille", 
  "Total_Nitrogen_per_mille", 
  "Total_Silt_percent", 
  "Total_Sand_percent", 
  "Organic_Matter_percent", 
  "CN_Ratio", 
  "Sum_of_Exchangeable_Bases_meq_100g", 
  "CaO_g_100g", 
  "Mg_Ca_Ratio", 
  "Mg_K_Ratio", 
  "Compaction_Index"
)

# Function to convert comma decimal separator to dot and convert to numeric
fix_decimal_separator <- function(x) {
  if(is.character(x) || is.factor(x)) {
    x_clean <- as.character(x)
    x_clean <- gsub(",", ".", x_clean)
    x_numeric <- as.numeric(x_clean)
    return(x_numeric)
  } else if(is.numeric(x)) {
    return(x)
  } else {
    return(as.numeric(x))
  }
}

# Data preparation and cleaning
model_data <- subset_data %>%
  # Fix decimal separators for all soil variables
  mutate(
    across(all_of(soil_variables), fix_decimal_separator)
  ) %>%
  # Clean crop cycle data
  mutate(
    crop_cycle_numeric = case_when(
      is.na(crop_cycle) ~ NA_real_,
      tolower(as.character(crop_cycle)) %in% c("essais", "essai", "jachere", "jacheres") ~ NA_real_,
      TRUE ~ as.numeric(crop_cycle)
    ),
    crop_type = case_when(
      crop_cycle_numeric == 0 ~ "Plant_Cane",
      crop_cycle_numeric > 0 ~ "Ratoon",
      tolower(as.character(crop_cycle)) %in% c("essais", "essai") ~ "Trials",
      tolower(as.character(crop_cycle)) %in% c("jachere", "jacheres") ~ "Fallow",
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  # Filter to keep only Plant_Cane and Ratoon data
  filter(
    !is.na(crop_type),
    !is.na(parcel),  # Ensure parcel is not missing
    crop_type %in% c("Plant_Cane", "Ratoon")
  ) %>%
  # Remove rows with all soil variables missing
  filter(
    rowSums(is.na(select(., all_of(soil_variables)))) < length(soil_variables)
  )

cat("=== DATA PREPARATION COMPLETE ===\n")
cat("Total observations after filtering:", nrow(model_data), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# COMPREHENSIVE DATA ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

# 1. All Plant Cane Analysis
all_plant_cane <- model_data %>%
  filter(crop_type == "Plant_Cane") %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  summarise(
    n_plant_cane_years = n_distinct(Harvest_Year),
    plant_cane_years = paste(sort(unique(Harvest_Year)), collapse = ", "),
    n_observations = n(),
    first_plant_year = min(Harvest_Year),
    last_plant_year = max(Harvest_Year),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# 2. All Ratoon Analysis
all_ratoon <- model_data %>%
  filter(crop_type == "Ratoon") %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ratoon_years = n_distinct(Harvest_Year),
    ratoon_years = paste(sort(unique(Harvest_Year)), collapse = ", "),
    ratoon_cycles = paste(sort(unique(crop_cycle_numeric)), collapse = ", "),
    n_observations = n(),
    first_ratoon_year = min(Harvest_Year),
    last_ratoon_year = max(Harvest_Year),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# 3. Combined Analysis
parcel_summary <- model_data %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  summarise(
    has_plant_cane = "Plant_Cane" %in% crop_type,
    has_ratoon = "Ratoon" %in% crop_type,
    n_plant_cane_years = sum(crop_type == "Plant_Cane", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_ratoon_years = sum(crop_type == "Ratoon", na.rm = TRUE),
    n_total_observations = n(),
    first_year = min(Harvest_Year),
    last_year = max(Harvest_Year),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Print comprehensive summary
cat("\n=== COMPREHENSIVE DATA SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Total unique parcels:", nrow(parcel_summary), "\n")
cat("Parcels with Plant Cane only:", sum(parcel_summary$has_plant_cane & !parcel_summary$has_ratoon), "\n")
cat("Parcels with Ratoon only:", sum(!parcel_summary$has_plant_cane & parcel_summary$has_ratoon), "\n")
cat("Parcels with BOTH Plant Cane and Ratoon:", sum(parcel_summary$has_plant_cane & parcel_summary$has_ratoon), "\n\n")

# Plant Cane Summary
cat("=== PLANT CANE SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Total parcels with plant cane:", nrow(all_plant_cane), "\n")
cat("Parcels with multiple plant cane years:", sum(all_plant_cane$n_plant_cane_years > 1), "\n")
cat("Distribution of plant cane years per parcel:\n")
plant_cane_dist <- table(all_plant_cane$n_plant_cane_years)
print(plant_cane_dist)

# Plant cane parcels that also have ratoon
plant_cane_with_ratoon <- all_plant_cane %>%
  filter(parcel %in% all_ratoon$parcel)

cat("Plant cane parcels that also have ratoon data:", nrow(plant_cane_with_ratoon), "\n")

# Ratoon Summary
cat("\n=== RATOON SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Total parcels with ratoon:", nrow(all_ratoon), "\n")
cat("Distribution of ratoon years per parcel:\n")
ratoon_dist <- table(all_ratoon$n_ratoon_years)
print(ratoon_dist)

# Ratoon parcels that also have plant cane
ratoon_with_plant_cane <- all_ratoon %>%
  filter(parcel %in% all_plant_cane$parcel)

cat("Ratoon parcels that also have plant cane data:", nrow(ratoon_with_plant_cane), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# CORRECTED BASELINE CREATION (ONE PLANT CANE YEAR PER PARCEL)
# ============================================================================

# For parcels with multiple plant cane years, select the earliest year
# This ensures each parcel has only one baseline
plant_cane_single <- model_data %>%
  filter(crop_type == "Plant_Cane") %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  filter(Harvest_Year == min(Harvest_Year)) %>%  # Take earliest plant cane year
  slice(1) %>%  # If multiple observations in same year, take first
  ungroup()

cat("\n=== BASELINE CREATION (SINGLE PLANT CANE YEAR PER PARCEL) ===\n")
cat("Original plant cane observations:", sum(model_data$crop_type == "Plant_Cane"), "\n")
cat("Selected single plant cane per parcel:", nrow(plant_cane_single), "\n")

# Create parcel baselines from single plant cane observations
parcel_baselines <- plant_cane_single %>%
  select(parcel, Harvest_Year, all_of(soil_variables)) %>%
  rename(baseline_year = Harvest_Year) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(., "_baseline"), all_of(soil_variables))

cat("Baselines created for", nrow(parcel_baselines), "parcels\n")

# ============================================================================
# VALIDATION DATA PREPARATION
# ============================================================================

# Get ratoon data only for parcels that have plant cane baselines
validation_parcels <- parcel_baselines$parcel
validation_data <- model_data %>%
  filter(
    crop_type == "Ratoon",
    parcel %in% validation_parcels
  ) %>%
  left_join(parcel_baselines, by = "parcel")

cat("\n=== VALIDATION DATA SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Total ratoon observations for validation:", nrow(validation_data), "\n")
cat("Unique parcels in validation:", n_distinct(validation_data$parcel), "\n")

# Validation summary by ratoon cycle
validation_cycle_summary <- validation_data %>%
  group_by(crop_cycle_numeric) %>%
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_parcels = n_distinct(parcel),
    years = paste(sort(unique(Harvest_Year)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(crop_cycle_numeric)

cat("\n=== VALIDATION BY RATOON CYCLE ===\n")
print(validation_cycle_summary)

# Validation summary by year
validation_year_summary <- validation_data %>%
  group_by(Harvest_Year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_parcels = n_distinct(parcel),
    ratoon_cycles = paste(sort(unique(crop_cycle_numeric)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(Harvest_Year)

cat("\n=== VALIDATION BY YEAR ===\n")
print(validation_year_summary)

# ============================================================================
# DETAILED PARCEL TRACKING FOR VALIDATION
# ============================================================================

# Create detailed parcel tracking (CORRECTED - no list columns)
parcel_validation_summary <- validation_data %>%
  group_by(parcel, baseline_year) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ratoon_observations = n(),
    n_ratoon_years = n_distinct(Harvest_Year),
    first_ratoon_year = min(Harvest_Year),
    last_ratoon_year = max(Harvest_Year),
    ratoon_cycles_min = min(crop_cycle_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    ratoon_cycles_max = max(crop_cycle_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    years_span = max(Harvest_Year) - min(Harvest_Year) + 1,
    baseline_to_first_ratoon = min(Harvest_Year) - baseline_year,
    baseline_to_last_ratoon = max(Harvest_Year) - baseline_year,
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

cat("\n=== PARCEL VALIDATION DETAILED SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Parcels available for validation:", nrow(parcel_validation_summary), "\n")
cat("Average ratoon observations per parcel:", round(mean(parcel_validation_summary$n_ratoon_observations), 1), "\n")
cat("Average years from baseline to ratoon:", round(mean(parcel_validation_summary$baseline_to_first_ratoon), 1), "\n")

# Distribution analysis
cat("\n=== DISTRIBUTION ANALYSIS ===\n")
cat("Ratoon observations per parcel distribution:\n")
print(table(parcel_validation_summary$n_ratoon_observations))

cat("\nYears from baseline to first ratoon:\n")
print(table(parcel_validation_summary$baseline_to_first_ratoon))

# ============================================================================
# CALCULATE MODEL PERFORMANCE METRICS
# ============================================================================

calculate_performance <- function(actual, predicted, var_name, method_name = "Parcel_Based_Constant") {
  # Remove rows where either actual or predicted is NA
  valid_idx <- !is.na(actual) & !is.na(predicted)
  
  if(sum(valid_idx) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(
      variable = var_name,
      method = method_name,
      n_observations = sum(valid_idx),
      rmse = NA,
      mae = NA,
      r_squared = NA,
      correlation = NA,
      mean_actual = NA,
      mean_predicted = NA,
      bias = NA,
      cv_rmse = NA
    ))
  }
  
  actual_clean <- actual[valid_idx]
  predicted_clean <- predicted[valid_idx]
  
  # Calculate metrics
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((actual_clean - predicted_clean)^2))
  mae <- mean(abs(actual_clean - predicted_clean))
  
  # R-squared and correlation
  ss_res <- sum((actual_clean - predicted_clean)^2)
  ss_tot <- sum((actual_clean - mean(actual_clean))^2)
  r_squared <- ifelse(ss_tot > 0, 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot), 0)
  correlation <- cor(actual_clean, predicted_clean)
  
  # Bias
  bias <- mean(predicted_clean - actual_clean)
  
  # Coefficient of Variation of RMSE
  mean_actual_val <- mean(actual_clean)
  cv_rmse <- ifelse(abs(mean_actual_val) > 0, (rmse / abs(mean_actual_val)) * 100, NA)
  
  return(data.frame(
    variable = var_name,
    method = method_name,
    n_observations = sum(valid_idx),
    rmse = round(rmse, 4),
    mae = round(mae, 4),
    r_squared = round(r_squared, 4),
    correlation = round(correlation, 4),
    mean_actual = round(mean(actual_clean), 4),
    mean_predicted = round(mean(predicted_clean), 4),
    bias = round(bias, 4),
    cv_rmse = round(cv_rmse, 2)
  ))
}

# Calculate performance for all soil variables
performance_results <- list()

for(var in soil_variables) {
  actual_col <- var
  predicted_col <- paste0(var, "_baseline")
  
  if(actual_col %in% names(validation_data) && predicted_col %in% names(validation_data)) {
    perf <- calculate_performance(
      actual = validation_data[[actual_col]],
      predicted = validation_data[[predicted_col]],
      var_name = var
    )
    performance_results[[length(performance_results) + 1]] <- perf
  }
}

# Combine all performance results
parcel_model_performance <- do.call(rbind, performance_results)

# ============================================================================
# PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

# Overall performance summary
performance_summary <- parcel_model_performance %>%
  summarise(
    n_variables = n(),
    n_valid_variables = sum(!is.na(r_squared)),
    avg_rmse = round(mean(rmse, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    median_rmse = round(median(rmse, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    avg_mae = round(mean(mae, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    median_mae = round(median(mae, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    avg_r_squared = round(mean(r_squared, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    median_r_squared = round(median(r_squared, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    avg_correlation = round(mean(correlation, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    median_correlation = round(median(correlation, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    avg_bias = round(mean(bias, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    avg_cv_rmse = round(mean(cv_rmse, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  )

cat("\n=== MODEL PERFORMANCE SUMMARY ===\n")
print(performance_summary)

# Best performing variables
best_variables <- parcel_model_performance %>%
  filter(!is.na(r_squared)) %>%
  arrange(desc(r_squared)) %>%
  head(10)

cat("\n=== TOP 10 BEST PREDICTED VARIABLES (by R²) ===\n")
print(select(best_variables, variable, r_squared, correlation, rmse, cv_rmse, n_observations))

# ============================================================================
# SAVE CORRECTED RESULTS
# ============================================================================

# Save all results (all dataframes now have simple columns that can be saved)
write.csv(parcel_model_performance, "parcel_model_performance_detailed.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(performance_summary, "parcel_model_performance_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(parcel_baselines, "parcel_baselines_corrected.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(parcel_validation_summary, "parcel_validation_summary_corrected.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(validation_data, "validation_data_with_predictions_corrected.csv", row.names = FALSE)

# Summary files for data structure analysis
write.csv(all_plant_cane, "all_plant_cane_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(all_ratoon, "all_ratoon_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(plant_cane_with_ratoon, "plant_cane_parcels_with_ratoon.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(ratoon_with_plant_cane, "ratoon_parcels_with_plant_cane.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(parcel_summary, "complete_parcel_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## VIII.3. Plotting model 1

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# PARCEL-BASED MODEL COMPREHENSIVE VISUALIZATION SUITE
# Publication-ready plots showing process, performance, and results
# ============================================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(gridExtra)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(corrplot)
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(stringr)

# ============================================================================
# PUBLICATION THEME
# ============================================================================



# ============================================================================
# PLOT 1: PARCEL-BASED MODEL WORKFLOW
# ============================================================================

create_parcel_workflow_plot <- function() {
  # Create workflow data specific to parcel-based approach
  workflow_data <- data.frame(
    step = c("Plant Cane\nBaseline", "Parcel-Specific\nBaseline", "Ratoon\nPrediction", "Validation\nData"),
    description = c(
      paste0("Single Plant Cane\nper Parcel\n(n = ", nrow(parcel_baselines), " parcels)"), 
      "Calculate Parcel\nBaseline Values\n(Earliest Year)", 
      "AnaR = AnaP0\n(Constant per Parcel)", 
      paste0("Test on Ratoon Data\n(n = ", nrow(validation_data), " observations)")
    ),
    x = c(1, 2, 3, 4),
    y = c(1, 1, 1, 1),
    color = c("Training", "Processing", "Model", "Validation")
  )
  
  p1 <- ggplot(workflow_data, aes(x = x, y = y)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = color), size = 20, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = step), size = 3.2, fontface = "bold", color = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = description, y = y - 0.18), size = 2.8, hjust = 0.5) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = x + 0.12, xend = x + 0.88, y = y, yend = y), 
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.3, "cm"), type = "closed"),
                 color = "gray40", size = 1) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Process Stage", option = "plasma") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0.5, 4.5)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0.65, 1.35)) +
    labs(
      title = "Parcel-Based Model: Constant Values Prediction Workflow",
      subtitle = "Each parcel uses its own Plant Cane baseline → Ratoon Prediction",
      caption = paste0("AnaR (Ratoon soil) = AnaP0 (Plant cane baseline per parcel)\n",
                      "Validation uses ", n_distinct(validation_data$parcel), 
                      " parcels with both plant cane and ratoon data")
    ) +
    parcel_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text = element_blank(),
      axis.title = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  return(p1)
}

# ============================================================================
# PLOT 2: PARCEL DATA STRUCTURE AND DISTRIBUTION
# ============================================================================

create_parcel_data_distribution_plot <- function() {
  # Create comprehensive data distribution
  parcel_structure_data <- model_data %>%
    group_by(parcel, crop_type, Harvest_Year) %>%
    summarise(n_obs = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    complete(parcel, crop_type, Harvest_Year, fill = list(n_obs = 0)) %>%
    mutate(
      has_data = n_obs > 0,
      validation_parcel = parcel %in% validation_data$parcel
    )
  
  # Summary by year and type
  year_summary <- model_data %>%
    count(crop_type, Harvest_Year, name = "n_observations") %>%
    mutate(
      in_validation = case_when(
        crop_type == "Plant_Cane" ~ "Training (Baseline)",
        crop_type == "Ratoon" ~ "Validation", 
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    )
  
  p2a <- year_summary %>%
    filter(crop_type %in% c("Plant_Cane", "Ratoon")) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(Harvest_Year), y = n_observations, fill = in_validation)) +
    geom_col(position = "stack", alpha = 0.85, width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(n_observations > 5, n_observations, "")), 
              position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), 
              color = "white", fontface = "bold", size = 3) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "Data Use",
      values = c("Training (Baseline)" = "#440154FF", 
                 "Validation" = "#35B779FF")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = comma_format()) +
    labs(
      title = "Parcel-Based Model: Training vs Validation Data",
      subtitle = "Plant Cane used for baselines; Ratoon used for validation",
      x = "Harvest Year",
      y = "Number of Observations"
    ) +
    parcel_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  # Parcel distribution summary
  parcel_dist_data <- validation_data %>%
    group_by(parcel) %>%
    summarise(
      n_ratoon_obs = n(),
      n_years = n_distinct(Harvest_Year),
      baseline_year = first(baseline_year),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    count(n_ratoon_obs, name = "n_parcels") %>%
    mutate(category = paste0(n_ratoon_obs, " ratoon obs"))
  
  p2b <- parcel_dist_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(category, n_ratoon_obs), y = n_parcels)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#31688EFF", alpha = 0.8, width = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = n_parcels), vjust = -0.3, fontface = "bold") +
    labs(
      title = "Validation Parcels Distribution",
      subtitle = paste0("Distribution of ratoon observations per parcel (n=", 
                       n_distinct(validation_data$parcel), " validation parcels)"),
      x = "Ratoon Observations per Parcel",
      y = "Number of Parcels"
    ) +
    parcel_theme +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  
  return(list(p2a = p2a, p2b = p2b))
}

# ============================================================================
# PLOT 3: PERFORMANCE OVERVIEW
# ============================================================================

create_performance_overview_plot <- function() {
  # Performance metrics distribution
  perf_long <- parcel_model_performance %>%
    select(variable, r_squared, correlation, rmse, mae, cv_rmse, bias) %>%
    filter(!is.na(r_squared)) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(r_squared, correlation, cv_rmse), 
                names_to = "metric", values_to = "value") %>%
    mutate(
      metric_label = case_when(
        metric == "r_squared" ~ "R² (higher better)",
        metric == "correlation" ~ "Correlation (higher better)", 
        metric == "cv_rmse" ~ "CV RMSE % (lower better)"
      ),
      value_for_plot = ifelse(metric == "cv_rmse", 100 - pmin(value, 100), value)
    )
  
  p3 <- perf_long %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = metric_label, y = value_for_plot)) +
    geom_boxplot(fill = "#440154FF", alpha = 0.7, outlier.alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.4, color = "#FDE725FF", size = 1) +
    stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "point", color = "red", size = 3, shape = 18) +
    labs(
      title = "Parcel-Based Model Performance Distribution",
      subtitle = "Performance metrics across all 23 soil variables",
      x = "Performance Metric",
      y = "Performance Value",
      caption = "Red diamonds show mean values; CV RMSE is inverse-scaled for visualization\nEach point represents one soil variable"
    ) +
    parcel_theme
  
  return(p3)
}

# ============================================================================
# PLOT 4: VARIABLE PERFORMANCE RANKING
# ============================================================================

create_variable_ranking_plot <- function() {
  variable_performance <- parcel_model_performance %>%
    filter(!is.na(r_squared)) %>%
    arrange(desc(r_squared)) %>%
    mutate(
      rank = row_number(),
      variable_clean = str_replace_all(variable, "_", " "),
      performance_category = case_when(
        r_squared >= 0.7 ~ "Excellent (≥0.7)",
        r_squared >= 0.5 ~ "Good (0.5-0.7)",
        r_squared >= 0.3 ~ "Moderate (0.3-0.5)",
        r_squared >= 0.1 ~ "Poor (0.1-0.3)",
        TRUE ~ "Very Poor (<0.1)"
      ),
      temporal_stability = case_when(
        cv_rmse <= 10 ~ "Very Stable (≤10%)",
        cv_rmse <= 20 ~ "Stable (≤20%)", 
        cv_rmse <= 40 ~ "Moderate (≤40%)",
        TRUE ~ "Variable (>40%)"
      )
    )
  
  p4 <- variable_performance %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(variable_clean, r_squared), y = r_squared)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = performance_category), alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
    geom_point(aes(color = temporal_stability, size = n_observations), 
               y = 0.02, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = paste0("R²=", round(r_squared, 2), 
                               "\nCV=", round(cv_rmse, 1), "%")), 
              hjust = -0.1, size = 2.5, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "R² Category",
      values = c(
        "Excellent (≥0.7)" = "#440154FF",
        "Good (0.5-0.7)" = "#31688EFF", 
        "Moderate (0.3-0.5)" = "#35B779FF",
        "Poor (0.1-0.3)" = "#FDE725FF",
        "Very Poor (<0.1)" = "#FF6B6B"
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Temporal Stability",
      values = c(
        "Very Stable (≤10%)" = "#006837",
        "Stable (≤20%)" = "#31A354",
        "Moderate (≤40%)" = "#FD8D3C", 
        "Variable (>40%)" = "#E31A1C"
      )
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Sample Size", range = c(1, 4)) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "Soil Variable Prediction Performance Ranking", 
      subtitle = "Parcel-based constant model performance with temporal stability",
      x = "Soil Variables (ordered by R²)",
      y = "R² (Coefficient of Determination)",
      caption = "Bars show R² performance; dots show temporal stability (CV RMSE %)\nLabels show exact R² and CV RMSE values"
    ) +
    parcel_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.position = "right"
    ) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(order = 1),
      color = guide_legend(order = 2),
      size = guide_legend(order = 3)
    )
  
  return(p4)
}

# ============================================================================
# PLOT 5: ALL VARIABLES ACTUAL VS PREDICTED SCATTER PLOTS
# ============================================================================

create_all_scatter_plots <- function() {
  # Prepare data for all variables
  scatter_data_list <- list()
  
  for(var in soil_variables) {
    actual_col <- var
    predicted_col <- paste0(var, "_baseline")
    
    if(actual_col %in% names(validation_data) && predicted_col %in% names(validation_data)) {
      # Get performance info
      perf_info <- parcel_model_performance %>%
        filter(variable == var)
      
      if(nrow(perf_info) > 0) {
        var_data <- validation_data %>%
          select(parcel, Harvest_Year, crop_cycle_numeric,
                 actual = all_of(actual_col), 
                 predicted = all_of(predicted_col)) %>%
          filter(!is.na(actual), !is.na(predicted)) %>%
          mutate(
            variable_clean = str_replace_all(var, "_", " "),
            r_squared = perf_info$r_squared[1],
            correlation = perf_info$correlation[1],
            rmse = perf_info$rmse[1],
            n_obs = perf_info$n_observations[1],
            cv_rmse = perf_info$cv_rmse[1],
            # Add residuals for coloring
            residual = predicted - actual,
            abs_residual = abs(residual),
            # Ratoon cycle for additional info
            ratoon_cycle = crop_cycle_numeric
          )
        
        scatter_data_list[[var]] <- var_data
      }
    }
  }
  
  # Combine all data
  combined_scatter <- do.call(rbind, scatter_data_list)
  
  # Create faceted plot for all variables
  p5 <- combined_scatter %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = actual, y = predicted)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = ratoon_cycle, alpha = abs_residual), size = 1.2) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black", 
                linetype = "dashed", size = 0.8) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#E31A1C", 
                fill = "#E31A1C", alpha = 0.15, size = 0.8) +
    facet_wrap(~paste0(variable_clean, "\n(R² = ", round(r_squared, 2), 
                      ", n = ", n_obs, ")"), 
               scales = "free", ncol = 5) +
    scale_color_viridis_c(name = "Ratoon\nCycle", option = "plasma") +
    scale_alpha_continuous(name = "Residual\nMagnitude", range = c(0.3, 0.9)) +
    labs(
      title = "Actual vs Predicted: All Soil Variables",
      subtitle = "Parcel-based constant model validation across all variables",
      x = "Actual Values (Observed in Ratoon Years)",
      y = "Predicted Values (Plant Cane Baseline)",
      caption = "Perfect prediction = dashed line; regression line = red\nPoints colored by ratoon cycle, transparency by prediction error"
    ) +
    parcel_theme +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 7),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 6),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  return(p5)
}

# ============================================================================
# PLOT 6: TOP AND BOTTOM PERFORMERS DETAILED VIEW
# ============================================================================

create_detailed_performance_plot <- function() {
  # Get top 6 and bottom 6 performers
  perf_ranked <- parcel_model_performance %>%
    filter(!is.na(r_squared)) %>%
    arrange(desc(r_squared))
  
  top_vars <- head(perf_ranked, 6)$variable
  bottom_vars <- tail(perf_ranked, 6)$variable
  
  # Create detailed scatter plots
  create_detailed_scatter <- function(vars, title_prefix) {
    scatter_data_list <- list()
    
    for(var in vars) {
      actual_col <- var
      predicted_col <- paste0(var, "_baseline")
      
      perf_info <- parcel_model_performance %>%
        filter(variable == var)
      
      var_data <- validation_data %>%
        select(parcel, Harvest_Year, crop_cycle_numeric,
               actual = all_of(actual_col), 
               predicted = all_of(predicted_col)) %>%
        filter(!is.na(actual), !is.na(predicted)) %>%
        mutate(
          variable_clean = str_replace_all(var, "_", " "),
          performance_info = paste0("R² = ", round(perf_info$r_squared[1], 3),
                                  "\nRMSE = ", round(perf_info$rmse[1], 3),
                                  "\nCV RMSE = ", round(perf_info$cv_rmse[1], 1), "%")
        )
      
      scatter_data_list[[var]] <- var_data
    }
    
    combined_data <- do.call(rbind, scatter_data_list)
    
    combined_data %>%
      ggplot(aes(x = actual, y = predicted)) +
      geom_point(aes(color = factor(crop_cycle_numeric)), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
      geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black", 
                  linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
      geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "#E31A1C", 
                  fill = "#E31A1C", alpha = 0.2) +
      facet_wrap(~paste0(variable_clean, "\n", performance_info), 
                 scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
      scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Ratoon\nCycle", option = "plasma") +
      labs(
        title = paste(title_prefix, "Variables: Detailed View"),
        x = "Actual Values",
        y = "Predicted Values (Plant Cane Baseline)",
        caption = "Perfect prediction = dashed line; points colored by ratoon cycle"
      ) +
      parcel_theme +
      theme(
        strip.text = element_text(size = 9),
        legend.position = "right"
      )
  }
  
  p6a <- create_detailed_scatter(top_vars, "Top 6 Performing")
  p6b <- create_detailed_scatter(bottom_vars, "Bottom 6 Performing")
  
  return(list(p6a = p6a, p6b = p6b))
}

# ============================================================================
# PLOT 7: TEMPORAL ANALYSIS AND PARCEL EFFECTS
# ============================================================================

create_temporal_analysis_plot <- function() {
  # Performance by ratoon cycle
  cycle_performance <- validation_data %>%
    group_by(crop_cycle_numeric) %>%
    summarise(
      n_observations = n(),
      n_parcels = n_distinct(parcel),
      years_from_baseline = mean(Harvest_Year - baseline_year, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  p7a <- cycle_performance %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = factor(crop_cycle_numeric))) +
    geom_col(aes(y = n_observations), fill = "#440154FF", alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(y = n_observations, label = paste0("n=", n_observations, 
                                                     "\nparcels=", n_parcels)), 
              vjust = -0.1, size = 3) +
    labs(
      title = "Validation Data by Ratoon Cycle",
      subtitle = "Distribution of observations used for model validation",
      x = "Ratoon Cycle",
      y = "Number of Observations",
      caption = "Each bar shows total observations and number of parcels"
    ) +
    parcel_theme
  
  # Parcel-level performance distribution
  parcel_level_performance <- validation_data %>%
    group_by(parcel) %>%
    summarise(
      n_observations = n(),
      years_span = max(Harvest_Year) - min(Harvest_Year) + 1,
      baseline_year = first(baseline_year),
      time_to_validation = min(Harvest_Year) - baseline_year,
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      parcel_category = case_when(
        n_observations == 1 ~ "Single Observation",
        n_observations <= 3 ~ "2-3 Observations", 
        n_observations <= 5 ~ "4-5 Observations",
        TRUE ~ "6+ Observations"
      )
    )
  
  p7b <- parcel_level_performance %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = time_to_validation, y = years_span)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = parcel_category, size = n_observations), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = "red", alpha = 0.3) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Parcel\nCategory", option = "plasma") +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Observations\nper Parcel", range = c(1, 4)) +
    labs(
      title = "Parcel Validation Characteristics",
      subtitle = "Time span and baseline distance for validation parcels",
      x = "Years from Baseline to First Ratoon",
      y = "Years Span of Ratoon Data",
      caption = "Each point represents one validation parcel"
    ) +
    parcel_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  
  return(list(p7a = p7a, p7b = p7b))
}

# ============================================================================
# PLOT 8: BIAS AND ERROR ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

create_bias_error_analysis_plot <- function() {
  # Bias analysis
  bias_data <- parcel_model_performance %>%
    filter(!is.na(bias), !is.na(r_squared)) %>%
    mutate(
      variable_clean = str_replace_all(variable, "_", " "),
      bias_category = case_when(
        abs(bias) <= 0.1 ~ "Low Bias (≤0.1)",
        abs(bias) <= 0.5 ~ "Moderate Bias (≤0.5)",
        TRUE ~ "High Bias (>0.5)"
      ),
      bias_direction = ifelse(bias > 0, "Over-prediction", "Under-prediction"),
      performance_level = case_when(
        r_squared >= 0.5 ~ "Good Performance (R²≥0.5)",
        r_squared >= 0.3 ~ "Moderate Performance (R²≥0.3)",
        TRUE ~ "Poor Performance (R²<0.3)"
      )
    )
  
  p8a <- bias_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = bias, y = r_squared)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = performance_level, size = n_observations), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(0.3, 0.5), linetype = "dotted", color = "gray50") +
    geom_text_repel(aes(label = variable_clean), size = 2.5, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Performance Level",
      values = c(
        "Good Performance (R²≥0.5)" = "#31688EFF",
        "Moderate Performance (R²≥0.3)" = "#35B779FF", 
        "Poor Performance (R²<0.3)" = "#FDE725FF"
      )
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Sample Size", range = c(2, 5)) +
    labs(
      title = "Bias vs Performance Analysis",
      subtitle = "Relationship between prediction bias and model performance",
      x = "Bias (Predicted - Actual)",
      y = "R² (Model Performance)",
      caption = "Vertical line shows unbiased prediction; horizontal lines show performance thresholds"
    ) +
    parcel_theme +
    theme(legend.position = "right")
  
  # Error distribution by variable type
  p8b <- bias_data %>%
    mutate(
      variable_type = case_when(
        str_detect(variable_clean, "pH|Conductivity") ~ "Chemical Properties",
        str_detect(variable_clean, "Clay|Sand|Silt") ~ "Texture",
        str_detect(variable_clean, "Carbon|Nitrogen|Matter") ~ "Organic Matter",
        str_detect(variable_clean, "Calcium|Magnesium|Sodium|Potassium|P2O5") ~ "Nutrients",
        TRUE ~ "Other"
      )
    ) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = variable_type, y = abs(bias))) +
    geom_boxplot(aes(fill = variable_type), alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_jitter(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.5, size = 2) +
    scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Variable Type", option = "plasma") +
    labs(
      title = "Prediction Bias by Soil Property Type",
      subtitle = "Absolute bias distribution across different soil variable categories",
      x = "Soil Variable Category",
      y = "Absolute Bias",
      caption = "Lower values indicate more accurate predictions"
    ) +
    parcel_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
  
  return(list(p8a = p8a, p8b = p8b))
}
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# R² PERFORMANCE RANKING PLOT - READABLE FORMAT
# ============================================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(viridis)

# ============================================================================
# READABLE THEME DEFINITION
# ============================================================================
readable_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", margin = margin(b = 15)),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 16, color = "gray50", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray95", size = 0.3),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA)
  )

# ============================================================================
# CREATE R² PERFORMANCE RANKING PLOT - READABLE VERSION
# ============================================================================

create_r_squared_ranking_readable <- function() {
  # Create performance data with categories
  # Note: Replace 'parcel_model_performance' with your actual performance data frame name
  variable_performance <- parcel_model_performance %>%
    filter(!is.na(r_squared)) %>%
    arrange(desc(r_squared)) %>%
    mutate(
      rank = row_number(),
      variable_clean = str_replace_all(variable, "_", " "),
      performance_category = case_when(
        r_squared >= 0.7 ~ "Excellent (≥0.7)",
        r_squared >= 0.5 ~ "Good (0.5-0.7)",
        r_squared >= 0.3 ~ "Moderate (0.3-0.5)",
        r_squared >= 0.1 ~ "Poor (0.1-0.3)",
        TRUE ~ "Very Poor (<0.1)"
      ),
      temporal_stability = case_when(
        cv_rmse <= 10 ~ "Very Stable (≤10%)",
        cv_rmse <= 20 ~ "Stable (≤20%)", 
        cv_rmse <= 40 ~ "Moderate (≤40%)",
        TRUE ~ "Variable (>40%)"
      )
    )
  
  # Create the plot
  p_ranking <- variable_performance %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(variable_clean, r_squared), y = r_squared)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = performance_category), alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
    geom_point(aes(color = temporal_stability, size = n_observations), 
               y = 0.05, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(r_squared, 2)), 
              hjust = -0.15, size = 8, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "R² Category",
      values = c(
        "Excellent (≥0.7)" = "#440154FF",
        "Good (0.5-0.7)" = "#31688EFF", 
        "Moderate (0.3-0.5)" = "#35B779FF",
        "Poor (0.1-0.3)" = "#FDE725FF",
        "Very Poor (<0.1)" = "#FF6B6B"
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Temporal Stability",
      values = c(
        "Very Stable (≤10%)" = "#006837",
        "Stable (≤20%)" = "#31A354",
        "Moderate (≤40%)" = "#FD8D3C", 
        "Variable (>40%)" = "#E31A1C"
      )
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Sample Size", range = c(2, 6)) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("All ", nrow(variable_performance), " Variables: R² Performance Ranking"), 
      subtitle = "Parcel-based model performance (ordered by R²)",
      x = "Soil Variables",
      y = "R² (Coefficient of Determination)",
      caption = "Bars show R² performance; dots show temporal stability (CV RMSE %)"
    ) +
    readable_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "right"
    ) +
    guides(
      fill = guide_legend(order = 1),
      color = guide_legend(order = 2),
      size = guide_legend(order = 3)
    )
  
  return(p_ranking)
}

# ============================================================================
# EXECUTE AND SAVE THE PLOT
# ============================================================================

# Create the plot
cat("Creating R² ranking plot with readable format...\n")
r_squared_ranking_plot <- create_r_squared_ranking_readable()

# Display the plot
print(r_squared_ranking_plot)

# Save the plot
ggsave("r_squared_ranking_readable.png", r_squared_ranking_plot, 
       width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300, bg = "white")

cat("Plot saved as: r_squared_ranking_readable.png (16x12 inches, 300 DPI)\n")

# Print summary statistics
summary_stats <- parcel_model_performance %>%
  filter(!is.na(r_squared)) %>%
  summarise(
    total_variables = n(),
    excellent_vars = sum(r_squared >= 0.7, na.rm = TRUE),
    good_vars = sum(r_squared >= 0.5 & r_squared < 0.7, na.rm = TRUE),
    moderate_vars = sum(r_squared >= 0.3 & r_squared < 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
    poor_vars = sum(r_squared >= 0.1 & r_squared < 0.3, na.rm = TRUE),
    very_poor_vars = sum(r_squared < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_r_squared = mean(r_squared, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_r_squared = median(r_squared, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

cat("\n=== PERFORMANCE SUMMARY ===\n")
cat(paste0("Total variables: ", summary_stats$total_variables, "\n"))
cat(paste0("Excellent (R² ≥ 0.7): ", summary_stats$excellent_vars, 
          " (", round(summary_stats$excellent_vars/summary_stats$total_variables*100, 1), "%)\n"))
cat(paste0("Good (R² 0.5-0.7): ", summary_stats$good_vars, 
          " (", round(summary_stats$good_vars/summary_stats$total_variables*100, 1), "%)\n"))
cat(paste0("Moderate (R² 0.3-0.5): ", summary_stats$moderate_vars, 
          " (", round(summary_stats$moderate_vars/summary_stats$total_variables*100, 1), "%)\n"))
cat(paste0("Mean R²: ", round(summary_stats$mean_r_squared, 3), "\n"))
cat(paste0("Median R²: ", round(summary_stats$median_r_squared, 3), "\n"))
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# DIAGNOSTIC SCRIPT: PLANT CANE AND FIRST RATOON PARCEL ANALYSIS
# Verify exactly how many parcels have both plant cane baseline and first ratoon
# ============================================================================

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

cat("=== DIAGNOSTIC: PLANT CANE AND FIRST RATOON ANALYSIS ===\n")
cat("Checking actual parcel counts and identifying specific parcels\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# 1. BASIC DATA OVERVIEW
# ============================================================================

cat("=== BASIC DATA OVERVIEW ===\n")
if(exists("model_data")) {
  total_records <- nrow(model_data)
  unique_parcels <- n_distinct(model_data$parcel)
  
  crop_type_summary <- model_data %>%
    group_by(crop_type) %>%
    summarise(
      n_records = n(),
      n_parcels = n_distinct(parcel),
      min_year = min(Harvest_Year, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_year = max(Harvest_Year, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  cat("Total records in model_data:", total_records, "\n")
  cat("Total unique parcels:", unique_parcels, "\n\n")
  
  cat("Crop type summary:\n")
  print(crop_type_summary)
  
} else {
  cat("❌ ERROR: model_data not found! Please load your data first.\n")
  stop("Data not available")
}

# ============================================================================
# 2. DETAILED PLANT CANE ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== DETAILED PLANT CANE ANALYSIS ===\n")

# All plant cane records
plant_cane_all <- model_data %>%
  filter(crop_type == "Plant_Cane") %>%
  arrange(parcel, Harvest_Year)

cat("Total Plant Cane records:", nrow(plant_cane_all), "\n")
cat("Unique parcels with Plant Cane:", n_distinct(plant_cane_all$parcel), "\n")

# Plant cane records per parcel
plant_cane_per_parcel <- plant_cane_all %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  summarise(
    n_plant_cane_records = n(),
    min_plant_cane_year = min(Harvest_Year),
    max_plant_cane_year = max(Harvest_Year),
    plant_cane_years = paste(sort(unique(Harvest_Year)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(parcel)

cat("\nPlant cane records per parcel distribution:\n")
print(table(plant_cane_per_parcel$n_plant_cane_records))

# Show first few parcels with their plant cane years
cat("\nFirst 10 parcels with plant cane data:\n")
print(head(plant_cane_per_parcel, 10))

# ============================================================================
# 3. DETAILED RATOON ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== DETAILED RATOON ANALYSIS ===\n")

# All ratoon records
ratoon_all <- model_data %>%
  filter(crop_type == "Ratoon") %>%
  arrange(parcel, Harvest_Year)

cat("Total Ratoon records:", nrow(ratoon_all), "\n")
cat("Unique parcels with Ratoon:", n_distinct(ratoon_all$parcel), "\n")

# Ratoon records per parcel
ratoon_per_parcel <- ratoon_all %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ratoon_records = n(),
    min_ratoon_year = min(Harvest_Year),
    max_ratoon_year = max(Harvest_Year),
    ratoon_years = paste(sort(unique(Harvest_Year)), collapse = ", "),
    min_cycle = min(crop_cycle_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_cycle = max(crop_cycle_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(parcel)

cat("\nRatoon records per parcel distribution:\n")
print(table(ratoon_per_parcel$n_ratoon_records))

cat("\nFirst 10 parcels with ratoon data:\n")
print(head(ratoon_per_parcel, 10))

# ============================================================================
# 4. BASELINE PLANT CANE IDENTIFICATION
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== BASELINE PLANT CANE IDENTIFICATION ===\n")

# Get baseline plant cane (earliest year per parcel) - matching Model 2 logic
baseline_plant_cane <- model_data %>%
  filter(crop_type == "Plant_Cane") %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  filter(Harvest_Year == min(Harvest_Year)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # Take first record if multiple in same year
  ungroup() %>%
  select(parcel, Harvest_Year) %>%
  rename(baseline_year = Harvest_Year) %>%
  arrange(parcel)

cat("Parcels with baseline plant cane:", nrow(baseline_plant_cane), "\n")
cat("These are the ACTUAL baseline parcels used in Model 2\n\n")

cat("First 15 baseline plant cane parcels:\n")
print(head(baseline_plant_cane, 15))

# ============================================================================
# 5. FIRST RATOON IDENTIFICATION
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== FIRST RATOON IDENTIFICATION ===\n")

# Get first ratoon (earliest ratoon year per parcel) - matching Model 2 logic
first_ratoon <- model_data %>%
  filter(crop_type == "Ratoon") %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  filter(Harvest_Year == min(Harvest_Year)) %>%
  slice(1) %>%  # Take first record if multiple in same year
  ungroup() %>%
  select(parcel, Harvest_Year, crop_cycle_numeric) %>%
  rename(
    first_ratoon_year = Harvest_Year,
    first_ratoon_cycle = crop_cycle_numeric
  ) %>%
  arrange(parcel)

cat("Parcels with first ratoon:", nrow(first_ratoon), "\n")
cat("These are the ACTUAL first ratoon parcels used in Model 2\n\n")

cat("First 15 first ratoon parcels:\n")
print(head(first_ratoon, 15))

# ============================================================================
# 6. CRITICAL ANALYSIS: PARCELS WITH BOTH BASELINE AND FIRST RATOON
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== CRITICAL ANALYSIS: PARCELS WITH BOTH BASELINE AND FIRST RATOON ===\n")

# This is the EXACT logic used in Model 2 for training_linear_evolution
parcels_both_baseline_ratoon <- baseline_plant_cane %>%
  inner_join(first_ratoon, by = "parcel") %>%
  mutate(
    years_between = first_ratoon_year - baseline_year,
    time_gap_reasonable = years_between >= 1 & years_between <= 10
  ) %>%
  arrange(parcel)

cat("🎯 EXACT COUNT: Parcels with BOTH baseline plant cane AND first ratoon:", nrow(parcels_both_baseline_ratoon), "\n")
cat("This should match the training_linear_evolution count from Model 2\n\n")

cat("Time gap between baseline and first ratoon:\n")
print(table(parcels_both_baseline_ratoon$years_between))

cat("\nReasonable time gaps (1-10 years):", sum(parcels_both_baseline_ratoon$time_gap_reasonable), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# 7. COMPLETE LIST OF PARCELS WITH BOTH
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== COMPLETE LIST OF PARCELS WITH BOTH BASELINE AND FIRST RATOON ===\n")
cat("Showing ALL", nrow(parcels_both_baseline_ratoon), "parcels:\n\n")

# Show all parcels
parcels_display <- parcels_both_baseline_ratoon %>%
  select(parcel, baseline_year, first_ratoon_year, first_ratoon_cycle, years_between) %>%
  mutate(parcel = as.character(parcel))

print(parcels_display)

# ============================================================================
# 8. PARCELS WITH ONLY PLANT CANE (NO RATOON)
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== PARCELS WITH ONLY PLANT CANE (NO RATOON) ===\n")

parcels_only_plant_cane <- baseline_plant_cane %>%
  anti_join(first_ratoon, by = "parcel") %>%
  arrange(parcel)

cat("Parcels with baseline plant cane but NO ratoon:", nrow(parcels_only_plant_cane), "\n")

if(nrow(parcels_only_plant_cane) > 0) {
  cat("First 10 parcels with only plant cane:\n")
  print(head(parcels_only_plant_cane, 10))
}

# ============================================================================
# 9. PARCELS WITH ONLY RATOON (NO PLANT CANE)
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== PARCELS WITH ONLY RATOON (NO PLANT CANE) ===\n")

parcels_only_ratoon <- first_ratoon %>%
  anti_join(baseline_plant_cane, by = "parcel") %>%
  arrange(parcel)

cat("Parcels with first ratoon but NO baseline plant cane:", nrow(parcels_only_ratoon), "\n")

if(nrow(parcels_only_ratoon) > 0) {
  cat("First 10 parcels with only ratoon:\n")
  print(head(parcels_only_ratoon, 10))
}

# ============================================================================
# 10. VALIDATION AGAINST MODEL 2 RESULTS
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== VALIDATION AGAINST MODEL 2 RESULTS ===\n")

if(exists("training_linear_evolution")) {
  model2_count <- nrow(training_linear_evolution)
  diagnostic_count <- nrow(parcels_both_baseline_ratoon)
  
  cat("Model 2 training_linear_evolution count:", model2_count, "\n")
  cat("Diagnostic analysis count:", diagnostic_count, "\n")
  cat("Counts match:", model2_count == diagnostic_count, "\n")
  
  if(model2_count != diagnostic_count) {
    cat("❌ WARNING: Counts don't match! There may be an issue in Model 2 logic.\n")
  } else {
    cat("✅ SUCCESS: Counts match perfectly!\n")
  }
} else {
  cat("Model 2 results not available for comparison.\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# 11. SUMMARY STATISTICS
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== FINAL SUMMARY STATISTICS ===\n")
cat("📊 Data Overview:\n")
cat("   • Total unique parcels in dataset:", n_distinct(model_data$parcel), "\n")
cat("   • Parcels with plant cane data:", n_distinct(plant_cane_all$parcel), "\n")
cat("   • Parcels with ratoon data:", n_distinct(ratoon_all$parcel), "\n")
cat("   • Parcels with baseline plant cane:", nrow(baseline_plant_cane), "\n")
cat("   • Parcels with first ratoon:", nrow(first_ratoon), "\n")

cat("\n🎯 Key Results:\n")
cat("   • Parcels with BOTH baseline plant cane AND first ratoon:", nrow(parcels_both_baseline_ratoon), "\n")
cat("   • Parcels with ONLY plant cane (no ratoon):", nrow(parcels_only_plant_cane), "\n")
cat("   • Parcels with ONLY ratoon (no plant cane):", nrow(parcels_only_ratoon), "\n")

cat("\n⏱️ Time Gap Analysis:\n")
if(nrow(parcels_both_baseline_ratoon) > 0) {
  cat("   • Average years between baseline and first ratoon:", round(mean(parcels_both_baseline_ratoon$years_between), 1), "\n")
  cat("   • Minimum gap:", min(parcels_both_baseline_ratoon$years_between), "years\n")
  cat("   • Maximum gap:", max(parcels_both_baseline_ratoon$years_between), "years\n")
  cat("   • Most common gap:", names(sort(table(parcels_both_baseline_ratoon$years_between), decreasing = TRUE))[1], "years\n")
}

# Save results
write.csv(parcels_both_baseline_ratoon, "diagnostic_parcels_with_both_baseline_and_ratoon.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(parcels_only_plant_cane, "diagnostic_parcels_only_plant_cane.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(parcels_only_ratoon, "diagnostic_parcels_only_ratoon.csv", row.names = FALSE)

write.csv(first_ratoon, "diagnostic_all_first_ratoon.csv", row.names = FALSE)

cat("\n💾 Results saved to diagnostic CSV files\n")
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# CORRECTED DIAGNOSTIC SCRIPT: PLANT CANE AND FIRST RATOON ANALYSIS
# Fixed to handle negative time differences and proper baseline selection
# ============================================================================

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)

cat("=== CORRECTED DIAGNOSTIC: PLANT CANE AND FIRST RATOON ANALYSIS ===\n")

if(exists("model_data")) {
  total_records <- nrow(model_data)
  unique_parcels <- n_distinct(model_data$parcel)
  
  crop_type_summary <- model_data %>%
    group_by(crop_type) %>%

      n_records = n(),
      n_parcels = n_distinct(parcel),
      min_year = min(Harvest_Year, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_year = max(Harvest_Year, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  cat("Total records in model_data:", total_records, "\n")
  cat("Total unique parcels:", unique_parcels, "\n\n")
  
  cat("Crop type summary:\n")
  print(crop_type_summary)
  
} else {
  cat("❌ ERROR: model_data not found! Please load your data first.\n")
  stop("Data not available")
}

# ============================================================================
# 2. DETAILED PLANT CANE ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== DETAILED PLANT CANE ANALYSIS ===\n")

# All plant cane records
plant_cane_all <- model_data %>%
  filter(crop_type == "Plant_Cane") %>%
  arrange(parcel, Harvest_Year)

cat("Total Plant Cane records:", nrow(plant_cane_all), "\n")
cat("Unique parcels with Plant Cane:", n_distinct(plant_cane_all$parcel), "\n")

# Plant cane records per parcel
plant_cane_per_parcel <- plant_cane_all %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  summarise(
    n_plant_cane_records = n(),
    min_plant_cane_year = min(Harvest_Year),
    max_plant_cane_year = max(Harvest_Year),

    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(parcel)

cat("\nPlant cane records per parcel distribution:\n")

# ============================================================================
# 3. DETAILED RATOON ANALYSIS
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== DETAILED RATOON ANALYSIS ===\n")

# All ratoon records
ratoon_all <- model_data %>%
  filter(crop_type == "Ratoon") %>%
  arrange(parcel, Harvest_Year)

cat("Total Ratoon records:", nrow(ratoon_all), "\n")
cat("Unique parcels with Ratoon:", n_distinct(ratoon_all$parcel), "\n")

# Ratoon records per parcel
ratoon_per_parcel <- ratoon_all %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%

    n_ratoon_records = n(),
```
