```{r}
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(parcel)

cat("\nRatoon records per parcel distribution:\n")
print(table(ratoon_per_parcel$n_ratoon_records))

# ============================================================================
# 4. CORRECTED BASELINE PLANT CANE IDENTIFICATION
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== CORRECTED BASELINE PLANT CANE IDENTIFICATION ===\n")

# Get ALL plant cane data for proper baseline selection
all_plant_cane_data <- model_data %>%
  filter(crop_type == "Plant_Cane") %>%
  select(parcel, Harvest_Year, all_of(soil_variables)) %>%
  arrange(parcel, Harvest_Year)

cat("All plant cane observations:", nrow(all_plant_cane_data), "\n")

# For each parcel, we'll select baseline based on what ratoon data is available
# This will be done in the training section below

# ============================================================================
# 5. ALL RATOON DATA FOR PREDICTION TARGET YEARS
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== ALL RATOON DATA FOR PREDICTION ===\n")

# Get ALL ratoon observations
all_ratoon_data <- model_data %>%
  filter(crop_type == "Ratoon") %>%
  select(parcel, Harvest_Year, crop_cycle_numeric, all_of(soil_variables)) %>%
  arrange(parcel, Harvest_Year)

cat("All ratoon observations:", nrow(all_ratoon_data), "\n")
cat("Unique parcels with ratoon:", n_distinct(all_ratoon_data$parcel), "\n")

# Ratoon target years (what we want to predict) - FIXED: Remove list column
ratoon_target_years <- all_ratoon_data %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  summarise(
    n_ratoon_years = n(),
    min_ratoon_year = min(Harvest_Year),
    max_ratoon_year = max(Harvest_Year),
    ratoon_years_text = paste(sort(unique(Harvest_Year)), collapse = ", "),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

cat("\nRatoon years distribution:\n")
print(table(ratoon_target_years$n_ratoon_years))

# ============================================================================
# 6. CORRECTED TRAINING DATA PREPARATION
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== CORRECTED TRAINING DATA PREPARATION ===\n")
cat("Selecting proper baselines: Plant cane BEFORE ratoon years\n\n")

# Function to find best baseline for each parcel
find_baseline_for_ratoon <- function(parcel_id, ratoon_years_vec, plant_cane_data) {
  parcel_plant_cane <- plant_cane_data %>%
    filter(parcel == parcel_id) %>%
    arrange(Harvest_Year)
  
  if(nrow(parcel_plant_cane) == 0) {
    return(NULL)  # No plant cane data
  }
  
  min_ratoon_year <- min(ratoon_years_vec)
  
  # Find plant cane years BEFORE the earliest ratoon year
  valid_baselines <- parcel_plant_cane %>%
    filter(Harvest_Year < min_ratoon_year)
  
  if(nrow(valid_baselines) == 0) {
    # If no plant cane before ratoon, take the earliest plant cane
    # (this creates negative time difference, which we'll handle)
    baseline <- parcel_plant_cane %>%
      filter(Harvest_Year == min(Harvest_Year)) %>%
      slice(1)
  } else {
    # Take the latest plant cane before ratoon (closest baseline)
    baseline <- valid_baselines %>%
      filter(Harvest_Year == max(Harvest_Year)) %>%
      slice(1)
  }
  
  return(baseline)
}

# Create training dataset with proper baselines
training_data_corrected <- list()

for(i in 1:nrow(ratoon_target_years)) {
  parcel_id <- ratoon_target_years$parcel[i]
  # Parse ratoon years from text
  ratoon_years_vec <- as.numeric(strsplit(ratoon_target_years$ratoon_years_text[i], ", ")[[1]])
  
  # Find baseline for this parcel
  baseline <- find_baseline_for_ratoon(parcel_id, ratoon_years_vec, all_plant_cane_data)
  
  if(!is.null(baseline)) {
    # Calculate time differences for each ratoon year
    for(ratoon_year in ratoon_years_vec) {
      ratoon_data <- all_ratoon_data %>%
        filter(parcel == parcel_id, Harvest_Year == ratoon_year) %>%
        slice(1)
      
      if(nrow(ratoon_data) > 0) {
        training_record <- data.frame(
          parcel = parcel_id,
          baseline_year = baseline$Harvest_Year,
          ratoon_year = ratoon_year,
          ratoon_cycle = ratoon_data$crop_cycle_numeric,
          time_diff = ratoon_year - baseline$Harvest_Year,
          time_diff_abs = abs(ratoon_year - baseline$Harvest_Year),
          is_baseline_before_ratoon = baseline$Harvest_Year < ratoon_year
        )
        
        # Add baseline soil values (P0)
        for(var in soil_variables) {
          if(var %in% names(baseline)) {
            training_record[[paste0(var, "_P0")]] <- baseline[[var]]
          }
        }
        
        # Add ratoon soil values (actual values to predict)
        for(var in soil_variables) {
          if(var %in% names(ratoon_data)) {
            training_record[[var]] <- ratoon_data[[var]]
          }
        }
        
        training_data_corrected[[length(training_data_corrected) + 1]] <- training_record
      }
    }
  }
}

# Combine all training records
if(length(training_data_corrected) > 0) {
  training_corrected <- do.call(rbind, training_data_corrected)
} else {
  training_corrected <- data.frame()
}

cat("=== CORRECTED TRAINING DATA SUMMARY ===\n")
cat("Total training observations:", nrow(training_corrected), "\n")
cat("Unique parcels in training:", n_distinct(training_corrected$parcel), "\n")

if(nrow(training_corrected) > 0) {
  cat("\nTime difference analysis:\n")
  cat("Baseline BEFORE ratoon (positive time_diff):", sum(training_corrected$time_diff > 0), "\n")
  cat("Baseline SAME YEAR as ratoon (time_diff = 0):", sum(training_corrected$time_diff == 0), "\n")
  cat("Baseline AFTER ratoon (negative time_diff):", sum(training_corrected$time_diff < 0), "\n")
  
  cat("\nTime difference distribution:\n")
  print(table(training_corrected$time_diff))
  
  cat("\nAbsolute time difference distribution:\n")
  print(table(training_corrected$time_diff_abs))
  
  # Analysis by baseline timing
  timing_analysis <- training_corrected %>%
    group_by(is_baseline_before_ratoon) %>%
    summarise(
      n_observations = n(),
      n_parcels = n_distinct(parcel),
      avg_time_diff = round(mean(time_diff), 1),
      avg_abs_time_diff = round(mean(time_diff_abs), 1),
      min_time_diff = min(time_diff),
      max_time_diff = max(time_diff),
      .groups = 'drop'
    )
  
  cat("\nBaseline timing analysis:\n")
  print(timing_analysis)
}

# ============================================================================
# 7. FIRST RATOON IDENTIFICATION FOR MODEL 2 APPROACH
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== FIRST RATOON IDENTIFICATION FOR LINEAR EVOLUTION ===\n")

if(nrow(training_corrected) > 0) {
  # For linear evolution model, we need parcels with at least 2 time points
  # Baseline (P0) and at least one ratoon (P1) to establish the slope
  
  parcels_with_slope_data <- training_corrected %>%
    group_by(parcel, baseline_year) %>%
    summarise(
      n_ratoon_points = n(),
      min_ratoon_year = min(ratoon_year),
      max_ratoon_year = max(ratoon_year),
      min_time_diff = min(time_diff),
      max_time_diff = max(time_diff),
      ratoon_years = paste(sort(unique(ratoon_year)), collapse = ", "),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(parcel)
  
  cat("Parcels with baseline + ratoon data for slope calculation:", nrow(parcels_with_slope_data), "\n")
  
  # Select first ratoon for slope calculation (P1)
  first_ratoon_for_slope <- training_corrected %>%
    group_by(parcel, baseline_year) %>%
    filter(ratoon_year == min(ratoon_year)) %>%
    slice(1) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(parcel, baseline_year, ratoon_year, time_diff, 
           starts_with(paste0(soil_variables, "_P0", collapse = "|"))) %>%
    rename(first_ratoon_year = ratoon_year,
           first_ratoon_time_diff = time_diff)
  
  # Add first ratoon values (P1)
  for(var in soil_variables) {
    if(var %in% names(training_corrected)) {
      first_ratoon_values <- training_corrected %>%
        group_by(parcel, baseline_year) %>%
        filter(ratoon_year == min(ratoon_year)) %>%
        slice(1) %>%
        select(parcel, baseline_year, !!sym(var)) %>%
        rename(!!paste0(var, "_P1") := !!sym(var))
      
      first_ratoon_for_slope <- first_ratoon_for_slope %>%
        left_join(first_ratoon_values, by = c("parcel", "baseline_year"))
    }
  }
  
  cat("Parcels suitable for linear evolution model:", nrow(first_ratoon_for_slope), "\n")
  
  cat("\nFirst ratoon time differences:\n")
  print(table(first_ratoon_for_slope$first_ratoon_time_diff))
}

# ============================================================================
# 8. DATA QUALITY ASSESSMENT
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== DATA QUALITY ASSESSMENT ===\n")

if(nrow(training_corrected) > 0) {
  # Assess data quality for modeling
  quality_summary <- training_corrected %>%
    mutate(
      quality_category = case_when(
        time_diff > 5 ~ "Long Gap (>5 years)",
        time_diff >= 1 & time_diff <= 5 ~ "Good Gap (1-5 years)",
        time_diff == 0 ~ "Same Year",
        time_diff >= -2 ~ "Short Reverse Gap (-1 to -2 years)",
        time_diff < -2 ~ "Long Reverse Gap (<-2 years)"
      )
    ) %>%
    group_by(quality_category) %>%
    summarise(
      n_observations = n(),
      n_parcels = n_distinct(parcel),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_observations))
  
  cat("Data quality by time gap:\n")
  print(quality_summary)
  
  # Variables with sufficient data
  var_availability <- training_corrected %>%
    summarise(
      across(all_of(soil_variables), 
             ~ sum(!is.na(.) & !is.na(get(paste0(cur_column(), "_P0")))), 
             .names = "n_{.col}")
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "n_available") %>%
    mutate(variable = gsub("n_", "", variable)) %>%
    filter(n_available >= 10) %>%
    arrange(desc(n_available))
  
  cat("\nVariables with sufficient data (≥10 pairs):\n")
  print(head(var_availability, 10))
}

# ============================================================================
# 9. SAVE CORRECTED RESULTS (FIXED)
# ============================================================================

# Save corrected datasets
if(nrow(training_corrected) > 0) {
  write.csv(training_corrected, "corrected_training_data_complete.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  if(exists("parcels_with_slope_data")) {
    write.csv(parcels_with_slope_data, "corrected_parcels_with_slope_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  }
  if(exists("first_ratoon_for_slope")) {
    write.csv(first_ratoon_for_slope, "corrected_first_ratoon_for_slope.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  }
  
  if(exists("quality_summary")) {
    write.csv(quality_summary, "corrected_data_quality_assessment.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  }
  if(exists("var_availability")) {
    write.csv(var_availability, "corrected_variable_availability.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  }
}

# Save parcel summaries - FIXED: No list columns
write.csv(ratoon_target_years, "corrected_ratoon_target_years.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(plant_cane_per_parcel, "corrected_plant_cane_per_parcel.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(ratoon_per_parcel, "corrected_ratoon_per_parcel.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## IX.2. Model 2 modelling

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# CORRECTED MODEL 2: LINEAR EVOLUTION SOIL VALUES PREDICTION
# Fixed to use only plant cane in the past, calculate proper slopes,
# and show gradual changes over time
# Formula: AnaR = [AnaP0 * (Nb_année_tot - Nb_année) + AnaP1 * Nb_année] / Nb_année_tot
# ============================================================================

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)
library(broom)
library(corrplot)
library(viridis)

cat("=== CORRECTED MODEL 2: LINEAR EVOLUTION ANALYSIS ===\n")
cat("Fixed to ensure plant cane is always before ratoon, with proper slope analysis\n\n")

# ============================================================================
# CORRECTED TRAINING DATA PREPARATION 
# ============================================================================

cat("=== CORRECTED TRAINING DATA PREPARATION ===\n")

# Function to find proper baseline plant cane (before ratoons)
find_proper_baseline <- function(parcel_id, ratoon_data, plant_cane_data) {
  parcel_ratoons <- ratoon_data %>%
    filter(parcel == parcel_id) %>%
    arrange(Harvest_Year)
  
  parcel_plant_canes <- plant_cane_data %>%
    filter(parcel == parcel_id) %>%
    arrange(Harvest_Year)
  
  if(nrow(parcel_ratoons) == 0 || nrow(parcel_plant_canes) == 0) {
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  min_ratoon_year <- min(parcel_ratoons$Harvest_Year)
  
  # Find plant cane years BEFORE the earliest ratoon
  valid_plant_canes <- parcel_plant_canes %>%
    filter(Harvest_Year < min_ratoon_year)
  
  if(nrow(valid_plant_canes) == 0) {
    return(NULL)  # No valid plant cane before ratoons
  }
  
  # Take the latest plant cane before ratoons (closest baseline)
  baseline <- valid_plant_canes %>%
    filter(Harvest_Year == max(Harvest_Year)) %>%
    slice(1)
  
  return(baseline)
}

# Get all ratoon data for analysis
all_ratoon_data <- model_data %>%
  filter(crop_type == "Ratoon") %>%
  arrange(parcel, Harvest_Year)

# Get all plant cane data
all_plant_cane_data <- model_data %>%
  filter(crop_type == "Plant_Cane") %>%
  arrange(parcel, Harvest_Year)

# Create proper training dataset
training_data_corrected <- list()

parcels_with_ratoons <- unique(all_ratoon_data$parcel)

for(parcel_id in parcels_with_ratoons) {
  # Find proper baseline for this parcel
  baseline <- find_proper_baseline(parcel_id, all_ratoon_data, all_plant_cane_data)
  
  if(!is.null(baseline)) {
    # Get all ratoon observations for this parcel
    parcel_ratoons <- all_ratoon_data %>%
      filter(parcel == parcel_id) %>%
      arrange(Harvest_Year)
    
    # Create records for each ratoon year
    for(i in 1:nrow(parcel_ratoons)) {
      ratoon_record <- parcel_ratoons[i, ]
      
      training_record <- data.frame(
        parcel = parcel_id,
        baseline_year = baseline$Harvest_Year,
        ratoon_year = ratoon_record$Harvest_Year,
        ratoon_cycle = ratoon_record$crop_cycle_numeric,
        time_diff = ratoon_record$Harvest_Year - baseline$Harvest_Year,
        is_first_ratoon = i == 1
      )
      
      # Add baseline soil values (P0)
      for(var in soil_variables) {
        if(var %in% names(baseline)) {
          training_record[[paste0(var, "_P0")]] <- baseline[[var]]
        }
      }
      
      # Add ratoon soil values (actual values)
      for(var in soil_variables) {
        if(var %in% names(ratoon_record)) {
          training_record[[var]] <- ratoon_record[[var]]
        }
      }
      
      training_data_corrected[[length(training_data_corrected) + 1]] <- training_record
    }
  }
}

# Combine all training records
if(length(training_data_corrected) > 0) {
  training_corrected <- do.call(rbind, training_data_corrected)
} else {
  training_corrected <- data.frame()
  stop("No valid training data found!")
}

cat("Total training observations (all with positive time_diff):", nrow(training_corrected), "\n")
cat("Unique parcels in training:", n_distinct(training_corrected$parcel), "\n")
cat("Time difference range:", min(training_corrected$time_diff), "to", max(training_corrected$time_diff), "years\n")

# Verify all time differences are positive
negative_diffs <- sum(training_corrected$time_diff <= 0)
cat("Observations with non-positive time differences:", negative_diffs, "\n")

if(negative_diffs > 0) {
  cat("⚠️ Warning: Some time differences are not positive. Filtering them out.\n")
  training_corrected <- training_corrected %>%
    filter(time_diff > 0)
  cat("Filtered training observations:", nrow(training_corrected), "\n")
}

# ============================================================================
# SLOPE CALCULATION FOR EACH VARIABLE AND PARCEL
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== SLOPE CALCULATION ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Calculate slopes for each parcel and variable
slope_analysis <- list()

for(parcel_id in unique(training_corrected$parcel)) {
  parcel_data <- training_corrected %>%
    filter(parcel == parcel_id) %>%
    arrange(time_diff)
  
  if(nrow(parcel_data) >= 1) {  # Need at least baseline + 1 ratoon
    for(var in soil_variables) {
      P0_col <- paste0(var, "_P0")
      
      if(P0_col %in% names(parcel_data) && var %in% names(parcel_data)) {
        P0_value <- parcel_data[[P0_col]][1]  # Baseline value
        
        # Calculate slope for each ratoon observation
        for(i in 1:nrow(parcel_data)) {
          ratoon_value <- parcel_data[[var]][i]
          time_diff <- parcel_data$time_diff[i]
          
          if(!is.na(P0_value) && !is.na(ratoon_value) && time_diff > 0) {
            slope <- (ratoon_value - P0_value) / time_diff
            
            slope_record <- data.frame(
              parcel = parcel_id,
              variable = var,
              baseline_year = parcel_data$baseline_year[i],
              ratoon_year = parcel_data$ratoon_year[i],
              time_diff = time_diff,
              P0_value = P0_value,
              ratoon_value = ratoon_value,
              slope = slope,
              is_first_ratoon = parcel_data$is_first_ratoon[i]
            )
            
            slope_analysis[[length(slope_analysis) + 1]] <- slope_record
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
}

# Combine slope analysis
if(length(slope_analysis) > 0) {
  slopes_data <- do.call(rbind, slope_analysis)
} else {
  slopes_data <- data.frame()
}

cat("Total slope calculations:", nrow(slopes_data), "\n")
cat("Unique variable-parcel combinations:", n_distinct(slopes_data[c("parcel", "variable")]), "\n")

# ============================================================================
# AVERAGE SLOPE BY VARIABLE AND TIME DIFFERENCE
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== AVERAGE SLOPES BY VARIABLE ===\n")

# Overall average slope by variable
variable_slopes <- slopes_data %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_parcels = n_distinct(parcel),
    avg_slope = round(mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE), 6),
    median_slope = round(median(slope, na.rm = TRUE), 6),
    std_slope = round(sd(slope, na.rm = TRUE), 6),
    min_slope = round(min(slope, na.rm = TRUE), 6),
    max_slope = round(max(slope, na.rm = TRUE), 6),
    positive_slopes = sum(slope > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    negative_slopes = sum(slope < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    slope_direction = ifelse(avg_slope > 0, "Increasing", "Decreasing"),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(avg_slope)))

cat("Top 10 variables with largest absolute slopes:\n")
print(head(variable_slopes, 10))

# ============================================================================
# SLOPE ANALYSIS BY TIME DIFFERENCE
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== SLOPE ANALYSIS BY TIME DIFFERENCE ===\n")

# Average slope by time difference (gradual change analysis)
slopes_by_time <- slopes_data %>%
  group_by(time_diff) %>%
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_variables = n_distinct(variable),
    n_parcels = n_distinct(parcel),
    avg_absolute_slope = round(mean(abs(slope), na.rm = TRUE), 6),
    avg_slope = round(mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE), 6),
    median_slope = round(median(slope, na.rm = TRUE), 6),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(time_diff)

cat("Average slopes by time difference (years from plant cane):\n")
print(slopes_by_time)

# ============================================================================
# SLOPE ANALYSIS BY VARIABLE AND TIME DIFFERENCE
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== DETAILED SLOPE ANALYSIS BY VARIABLE AND TIME ===\n")

# Average slope for each variable at each time difference
slopes_variable_time <- slopes_data %>%
  group_by(variable, time_diff) %>%
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_parcels = n_distinct(parcel),
    avg_slope = round(mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE), 6),
    median_slope = round(median(slope, na.rm = TRUE), 6),
    std_slope = round(sd(slope, na.rm = TRUE), 6),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(variable, time_diff)

# Show detailed slopes for top 5 most important variables
top_variables <- head(variable_slopes$variable, 5)
cat("Detailed slope evolution for top 5 variables with largest absolute slopes:\n")
for(var in top_variables) {
  cat(paste("\n", var, ":\n"))
  var_slopes <- slopes_variable_time %>%
    filter(variable == var) %>%
    select(time_diff, n_observations, avg_slope, median_slope)
  print(var_slopes)
}

# ============================================================================
# FIRST RATOON SLOPE ANALYSIS (FOR MODEL TRAINING)
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== FIRST RATOON SLOPE ANALYSIS ===\n")

# Get first ratoon slopes for model training (P0 to P1)
first_ratoon_slopes <- slopes_data %>%
  filter(is_first_ratoon == TRUE) %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(
    n_parcels = n(),
    avg_first_ratoon_slope = round(mean(slope, na.rm = TRUE), 6),
    median_first_ratoon_slope = round(median(slope, na.rm = TRUE), 6),
    std_first_ratoon_slope = round(sd(slope, na.rm = TRUE), 6),
    avg_time_to_first_ratoon = round(mean(time_diff, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(abs(avg_first_ratoon_slope)))

cat("First ratoon slopes (P0 to P1) - these define the linear evolution rate:\n")
print(head(first_ratoon_slopes, 10))

# ============================================================================
# LINEAR EVOLUTION MODEL IMPLEMENTATION (CORRECTED)
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== LINEAR EVOLUTION MODEL IMPLEMENTATION ===\n")

# Prepare data for linear evolution using first ratoon slopes
linear_evolution_training <- training_corrected %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  arrange(time_diff) %>%
  filter(row_number() == 1) %>%  # Take first ratoon for each parcel
  ungroup()

cat("Parcels available for linear evolution training:", nrow(linear_evolution_training), "\n")

# Create linear evolution predictions for ALL ratoon observations
linear_predictions <- training_corrected

# Function for linear evolution prediction (corrected formula)
calculate_linear_evolution_corrected <- function(P0_value, P1_value, time_to_P1, time_to_target) {
  if(is.na(P0_value) | is.na(P1_value) | is.na(time_to_P1) | is.na(time_to_target) | time_to_P1 == 0) {
    return(NA)
  }
  
  # Calculate slope from P0 to P1
  slope <- (P1_value - P0_value) / time_to_P1
  
  # Predict value at target time using linear evolution
  predicted_value <- P0_value + slope * time_to_target
  
  return(predicted_value)
}

# Add P1 values for each parcel (first ratoon values)
parcel_P1_values <- linear_evolution_training %>%
  select(parcel, time_diff, all_of(soil_variables)) %>%
  rename_with(~ paste0(., "_P1"), all_of(soil_variables)) %>%
  rename(time_to_P1 = time_diff)

# Join P1 values to all observations
linear_predictions <- linear_predictions %>%
  left_join(parcel_P1_values, by = "parcel")

# Calculate linear evolution predictions
for(var in soil_variables) {
  P0_col <- paste0(var, "_P0")
  P1_col <- paste0(var, "_P1")
  pred_col <- paste0(var, "_linear_pred")
  
  if(all(c(P0_col, P1_col) %in% names(linear_predictions))) {
    linear_predictions[[pred_col]] <- mapply(
      calculate_linear_evolution_corrected,
      P0_value = linear_predictions[[P0_col]],
      P1_value = linear_predictions[[P1_col]],
      time_to_P1 = linear_predictions$time_to_P1,
      time_to_target = linear_predictions$time_diff
    )
  }
}

cat("Linear evolution predictions calculated for all observations\n")

# ============================================================================
# MODEL PERFORMANCE CALCULATION
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== MODEL PERFORMANCE CALCULATION ===\n")

# Performance calculation function
calculate_performance_corrected <- function(actual, predicted, var_name, method_name = "Linear_Evolution_Corrected") {
  valid_idx <- !is.na(actual) & !is.na(predicted)
  
  if(sum(valid_idx) < 2) {
    return(data.frame(
      variable = var_name,
      method = method_name,
      n_observations = sum(valid_idx),
      rmse = NA,
      mae = NA,
      r_squared = NA,
      correlation = NA,
      mean_actual = NA,
      mean_predicted = NA,
      bias = NA,
      cv_rmse = NA
    ))
  }
  
  actual_clean <- actual[valid_idx]
  predicted_clean <- predicted[valid_idx]
  
  rmse <- sqrt(mean((actual_clean - predicted_clean)^2))
  mae <- mean(abs(actual_clean - predicted_clean))
  
  ss_res <- sum((actual_clean - predicted_clean)^2)
  ss_tot <- sum((actual_clean - mean(actual_clean))^2)
  r_squared <- ifelse(ss_tot > 0, 1 - (ss_res / ss_tot), 0)
  correlation <- cor(actual_clean, predicted_clean)
  
  bias <- mean(predicted_clean - actual_clean)
  mean_actual_val <- mean(actual_clean)
  cv_rmse <- ifelse(abs(mean_actual_val) > 0, (rmse / abs(mean_actual_val)) * 100, NA)
  
  return(data.frame(
    variable = var_name,
    method = method_name,
    n_observations = sum(valid_idx),
    rmse = round(rmse, 4),
    mae = round(mae, 4),
    r_squared = round(r_squared, 4),
    correlation = round(correlation, 4),
    mean_actual = round(mean(actual_clean), 4),
    mean_predicted = round(mean(predicted_clean), 4),
    bias = round(bias, 4),
    cv_rmse = round(cv_rmse, 2)
  ))
}

# Calculate performance for all variables
performance_results <- list()

for(var in soil_variables) {
  actual_col <- var
  predicted_col <- paste0(var, "_linear_pred")
  
  if(all(c(actual_col, predicted_col) %in% names(linear_predictions))) {
    perf <- calculate_performance_corrected(
      actual = linear_predictions[[actual_col]],
      predicted = linear_predictions[[predicted_col]],
      var_name = var
    )
    performance_results[[length(performance_results) + 1]] <- perf
  }
}

# Combine performance results
model_performance <- do.call(rbind, performance_results)

# Performance summary
performance_summary <- model_performance %>%
  filter(!is.na(r_squared)) %>%
  summarise(
    n_variables = n(),
    avg_rmse = round(mean(rmse, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    median_rmse = round(median(rmse, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    avg_mae = round(mean(mae, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    avg_r_squared = round(mean(r_squared, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    median_r_squared = round(median(r_squared, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    avg_correlation = round(mean(correlation, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    avg_bias = round(mean(bias, na.rm = TRUE), 4),
    avg_cv_rmse = round(mean(cv_rmse, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
  )

cat("=== CORRECTED LINEAR EVOLUTION MODEL PERFORMANCE ===\n")
print(performance_summary)

# Best performing variables
best_variables <- model_performance %>%
  filter(!is.na(r_squared)) %>%
  arrange(desc(r_squared)) %>%
  head(10)

cat("\n=== TOP 10 BEST PREDICTED VARIABLES ===\n")
print(select(best_variables, variable, r_squared, correlation, rmse, cv_rmse, n_observations))

# ============================================================================
# PERFORMANCE BY TIME DIFFERENCE
# ============================================================================

cat("\n=== PERFORMANCE BY TIME DIFFERENCE ===\n")

performance_by_time <- linear_predictions %>%
  group_by(time_diff) %>%
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_parcels = n_distinct(parcel),
    n_variables = length(soil_variables),  # All variables analyzed
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(time_diff)

cat("Observations available by time difference:\n")
print(performance_by_time)

# ============================================================================
# SAVE CORRECTED RESULTS
# ============================================================================

# Save all corrected results
write.csv(training_corrected, "corrected_linear_evolution_training_data.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(slopes_data, "corrected_variable_slopes_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(variable_slopes, "corrected_average_slopes_by_variable.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(slopes_by_time, "corrected_slopes_by_time_difference.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(slopes_variable_time, "corrected_slopes_by_variable_and_time.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(first_ratoon_slopes, "corrected_first_ratoon_slopes.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(linear_predictions, "corrected_linear_evolution_predictions.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(model_performance, "corrected_linear_evolution_performance.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(performance_summary, "corrected_linear_evolution_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(performance_by_time, "corrected_performance_by_time.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
# ALL VARIABLES R² RANKING AND SCATTER PLOTS - READABLE VERSION
# ============================================================================

# ============================================================================
# LARGE, READABLE THEME
# ============================================================================
readable_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", margin = margin(b = 15)),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 16, color = "gray50", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray95", size = 0.3),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA)
  )

# ============================================================================
# PLOT: ALL VARIABLES PERFORMANCE RANKING WITH SLOPES - READABLE
# ============================================================================

create_all_variable_ranking_readable <- function() {
  all_variable_performance_slopes <- model_performance %>%
    filter(!is.na(r_squared)) %>%
    left_join(
      select(variable_slopes, variable, avg_slope, slope_direction), 
      by = "variable"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(r_squared)) %>%
    mutate(
      rank = row_number(),
      variable_clean = str_replace_all(variable, "_", " "),
      performance_category = case_when(
        r_squared >= 0.7 ~ "Excellent (≥0.7)",
        r_squared >= 0.5 ~ "Good (0.5-0.7)",
        r_squared >= 0.3 ~ "Moderate (0.3-0.5)",
        r_squared >= 0.1 ~ "Poor (0.1-0.3)",
        TRUE ~ "Very Poor (<0.1)"
      )
    )
  
  p_all <- all_variable_performance_slopes %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = reorder(variable_clean, r_squared), y = r_squared)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = performance_category), alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
    geom_point(aes(color = slope_direction, size = abs(avg_slope)), 
               y = 0.05, alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_text(aes(label = round(r_squared, 2)), 
              hjust = -0.15, size = 8, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      name = "R² Category",
      values = c(
        "Excellent (≥0.7)" = "#440154FF",
        "Good (0.5-0.7)" = "#31688EFF", 
        "Moderate (0.3-0.5)" = "#35B779FF",
        "Poor (0.1-0.3)" = "#FDE725FF",
        "Very Poor (<0.1)" = "#FF6B6B"
      )
    ) +
    scale_color_manual(
      name = "Slope Direction",
      values = c("Increasing" = "#35B779FF", "Decreasing" = "#E31A1C")
    ) +
    scale_size_continuous(name = "Slope Magnitude", range = c(2, 6)) +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = paste0("All ", nrow(all_variable_performance_slopes), " Variables: R² Performance"), 
      subtitle = "Linear evolution model performance (ordered by R²)",
      x = "Soil Variables",
      y = "R² (Coefficient of Determination)",
      caption = "Bars show R² performance; dots show slope direction and magnitude"
    ) +
    readable_theme +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
  
  return(p_all)
}

# ============================================================================
# PLOT: SCATTER PLOTS FOR ALL VARIABLES - READABLE
# ============================================================================

create_all_scatter_plots_readable <- function() {
  all_vars_with_predictions <- model_performance %>%
    filter(!is.na(r_squared)) %>%
    pull(variable)
  
  cat(paste0("Creating scatter plots for ", length(all_vars_with_predictions), " variables...\n"))
  
  scatter_data_list <- list()
  
  for(var in all_vars_with_predictions) {
    actual_col <- var
    predicted_col <- paste0(var, "_linear_pred")
    
    if(!predicted_col %in% names(linear_predictions)) {
      next
    }
    
    perf_info <- model_performance %>% filter(variable == var)
    
    var_data <- linear_predictions %>%
      select(parcel, time_diff, ratoon_year,
             actual = all_of(actual_col), 
             predicted = all_of(predicted_col)) %>%
      filter(!is.na(actual), !is.na(predicted)) %>%
      mutate(
        variable_clean = str_replace_all(var, "_", " "),
        r_squared = perf_info$r_squared[1],
        n_obs = perf_info$n_observations[1],
        residual = predicted - actual,
        abs_residual = abs(residual),
        time_category = case_when(
          time_diff <= 2 ~ "Short (≤2y)",
          time_diff <= 5 ~ "Medium (3-5y)",
          TRUE ~ "Long (>5y)"
        )
      )
    
    scatter_data_list[[var]] <- var_data
  }
  
  combined_scatter <- do.call(rbind, scatter_data_list)
  
  p_scatter_all <- combined_scatter %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = actual, y = predicted)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = time_category), size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, color = "black", 
                linetype = "dashed", size = 1.5) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "#E31A1C", 
                size = 1.5) +
    facet_wrap(~paste0(variable_clean, "\nR² = ", round(r_squared, 2), 
                      " (n=", n_obs, ")"), 
               scales = "free", ncol = 3) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Time from Baseline", option = "plasma") +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Actual vs Predicted: All Variables"),
      subtitle = "Linear evolution model validation",
      x = "Actual Values",
      y = "Predicted Values",
      caption = "Perfect prediction = dashed line; regression line = red"
    ) +
    readable_theme +
    theme(
      strip.text = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
      axis.text = element_text(size = 14),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
  
  return(p_scatter_all)
}

# ============================================================================
# PLOT: PERFORMANCE SUMMARY - READABLE
# ============================================================================

create_performance_summary_readable <- function() {
  summary_stats <- model_performance %>%
    filter(!is.na(r_squared)) %>%
    summarise(
      total_variables = n(),
      excellent_vars = sum(r_squared >= 0.7, na.rm = TRUE),
      good_vars = sum(r_squared >= 0.5 & r_squared < 0.7, na.rm = TRUE),
      moderate_vars = sum(r_squared >= 0.3 & r_squared < 0.5, na.rm = TRUE),
      poor_vars = sum(r_squared >= 0.1 & r_squared < 0.3, na.rm = TRUE),
      very_poor_vars = sum(r_squared < 0.1, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_r_squared = mean(r_squared, na.rm = TRUE),
      median_r_squared = median(r_squared, na.rm = TRUE)
    )
  
  category_data <- data.frame(
    category = c("Excellent\n(≥0.7)", "Good\n(0.5-0.7)", "Moderate\n(0.3-0.5)", 
                "Poor\n(0.1-0.3)", "Very Poor\n(<0.1)"),
    count = c(summary_stats$excellent_vars, summary_stats$good_vars, 
             summary_stats$moderate_vars, summary_stats$poor_vars, 
             summary_stats$very_poor_vars),
    percentage = c(summary_stats$excellent_vars, summary_stats$good_vars, 
                  summary_stats$moderate_vars, summary_stats$poor_vars, 
                  summary_stats$very_poor_vars) / summary_stats$total_variables * 100
  ) %>%
    mutate(
      category = factor(category, levels = category),
      label = paste0(count, "\n(", round(percentage, 1), "%)")
    )
  
  p_summary <- category_data %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = category, y = count)) +
    geom_col(aes(fill = category), alpha = 0.8, width = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = label), vjust = -0.3, size = 8, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c(
        "Excellent\n(≥0.7)" = "#440154FF",
        "Good\n(0.5-0.7)" = "#31688EFF", 
        "Moderate\n(0.3-0.5)" = "#35B779FF",
        "Poor\n(0.1-0.3)" = "#FDE725FF",
        "Very Poor\n(<0.1)" = "#FF6B6B"
      )
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Model Performance Summary",
      subtitle = paste0("Distribution across ", summary_stats$total_variables, " variables"),
      x = "Performance Category",
      y = "Number of Variables",
      caption = paste0("Mean R² = ", round(summary_stats$mean_r_squared, 3), 
                      ", Median R² = ", round(summary_stats$median_r_squared, 3))
    ) +
    readable_theme +
    theme(
      legend.position = "none",
      axis.text.x = element_text(size = 16)
    )
  
  return(p_summary)
}

cat(paste0("Poor (R² 0.1-0.3): ", summary_stats$poor_vars,

cat(paste0("Very poor (R² < 0.1): ", summary_stats$very_poor_vars,
```

```{r}
# ===============================
# DATASET LINKING SCRIPT
# Creating Parcel-Year IDs for linking soil and leaf datasets
# ===============================

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(corrplot)

# ===============================
# HELPER FUNCTION FOR DECIMAL CONVERSION
# ===============================
convert_decimal_format <- function(x) {
  # Convert factor/character columns with comma decimals to numeric
  if(is.factor(x)) {
    x <- as.character(x)
  }
  if(is.character(x)) {
    # Replace comma with dot and convert to numeric
    x <- gsub(",", ".", x)
    x <- as.numeric(x)
  }
  return(x)
}

# Function to fix decimal formatting in a dataframe
fix_decimal_columns <- function(df, exclude_cols = c()) {
  # Get column names to check (exclude ID columns and specified columns)
  cols_to_check <- setdiff(names(df), exclude_cols)
  
  for(col in cols_to_check) {
    original_class <- class(df[[col]])[1]
    
    # Try to convert if it looks like it might be numeric
    if(original_class %in% c("character", "factor")) {
      # Check if the column contains values that look like numbers with commas
      sample_vals <- na.omit(df[[col]])[1:min(100, length(na.omit(df[[col]])))]
      
      if(length(sample_vals) > 0) {
        # Check for comma decimal pattern
        has_comma_decimals <- any(grepl("^-?\\d+,\\d+$", sample_vals) | 
                                 grepl("^-?\\d{1,3}(\\s\\d{3})*,\\d+$", sample_vals))
        
        if(has_comma_decimals) {
          cat(paste("Converting column", col, "from", original_class, "to numeric (comma to dot conversion)\n"))
          df[[col]] <- convert_decimal_format(df[[col]])
        }
      }
    }
  }
  return(df)
}

# ===============================
# 1. CREATE ID FOR FIRST DATASET (SOIL DATA)
# ===============================
cat("1. CREATING ID FOR SOIL DATASET\n")
cat("================================\n")

# Fix decimal formatting in soil data first
cat("Checking and fixing decimal formatting in soil data...\n")
subset_data <- fix_decimal_columns(subset_data, exclude_cols = c("parcel", "parcel_year_id"))

# Create parcel-year ID for the first dataset
# Format: "parcel-year" (e.g., "P001-2020")
subset_data <- subset_data %>%
  mutate(
    parcel_year_id = paste0(parcel, "-", Harvest_Year)
  )

# Display the first few IDs to verify

# Check for any missing values in the ID components

cat("Missing Harvest_Year values:", missing_year, "\n")

# ===============================
# 2. CREATE ID FOR SECOND DATASET (LEAF DATA)
# ===============================
cat("\n2. CREATING ID FOR LEAF DATASET\n")

# Function to extract year from campaign format
extract_year_from_campaign <- function(campaign) {
  # Handle different possible formats
  if(is.na(campaign) || campaign == "") {
    return(NA)
  }
  
  # Extract the first year from formats like "2011-2012", "2012-2013", etc.
  # Split by "-" and take the first part
  year_parts <- str_split(as.character(campaign), "-")[[1]]
  if(length(year_parts) >= 1) {
    first_year <- as.numeric(year_parts[1])
    return(first_year)
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

# Apply the function to extract years from Campagne and select only required variables
leaf_data_selected <- leaf_data_converted %>%
  mutate(
    # Extract year from Campagne (e.g., "2011-2012" -> 2011)
    extracted_year = sapply(Campagne, extract_year_from_campaign),
    # Create parcel-year ID using Parc. and extracted year
    parcel_year_id = paste0(Parc., "-", extracted_year)
  ) %>%
  # Select only the required variables and rename them
  select(
    parcel_year_id,
    Cycle,
    leaf_age_days = Age_prel.,
    leaf_water_content_pct = H2O_feuilles,
    sheath_water_content_pct = H20_gaines,
    leaf_nitrogen_pct = N.,
    leaf_phosphorus_pct = X.P,
    leaf_potassium_pct = X.K
  )

# Fix decimal formatting in selected leaf data
cat("Checking and fixing decimal formatting in leaf data...\n")
leaf_data_selected <- fix_decimal_columns(leaf_data_selected, exclude_cols = c("parcel_year_id", "Cycle"))

# Display sample results

print(head(leaf_data_selected, 10))

# Check for missing values in selected variables

colnames(missing_vars) <- "Missing_Count"

# Get unique IDs from both datasets
soil_ids <- unique(subset_data$parcel_year_id)
leaf_ids <- unique(leaf_data_selected$parcel_year_id)

# Remove NA IDs for analysis
soil_ids_clean <- soil_ids[!is.na(soil_ids) & soil_ids != "NA-NA" & soil_ids != "-"]
leaf_ids_clean <- leaf_ids[!is.na(leaf_ids) & leaf_ids != "NA-NA" & leaf_ids != "-"]

cat("Number of unique parcel-year IDs:\n")
cat("Soil dataset:", length(soil_ids_clean), "\n")
cat("Leaf dataset:", length(leaf_ids_clean), "\n")

# Find matching IDs
matching_ids <- intersect(soil_ids_clean, leaf_ids_clean)
cat("Number of matching IDs:", length(matching_ids), "\n")

if(length(matching_ids) > 0) {
  cat("\nSample matching IDs:\n")
  print(head(matching_ids, 10))
  
  # Show match rate
  match_rate_soil <- length(matching_ids) / length(soil_ids_clean) * 100
  match_rate_leaf <- length(matching_ids) / length(leaf_ids_clean) * 100
  cat("\nMatch rates:\n")
  cat("Soil dataset match rate:", round(match_rate_soil, 2), "%\n")
  cat("Leaf dataset match rate:", round(match_rate_leaf, 2), "%\n")
  
  # Analyze non-matching IDs
  soil_only_ids <- setdiff(soil_ids_clean, leaf_ids_clean)
  leaf_only_ids <- setdiff(leaf_ids_clean, soil_ids_clean)
  
  cat("\nNon-matching analysis:\n")
  cat("IDs only in soil dataset:", length(soil_only_ids), "\n")
  cat("IDs only in leaf dataset:", length(leaf_only_ids), "\n")
  
  if(length(soil_only_ids) > 0 && length(soil_only_ids) <= 20) {
    cat("\nSoil-only IDs:\n")

  }
  
  if(length(leaf_only_ids) > 0 && length(leaf_only_ids) <= 20) {
    cat("\nLeaf-only IDs:\n")
    print(leaf_only_ids)
  }
}

# ===============================

cat("\n5. COMPREHENSIVE DATA SUMMARIES\n")

if(nrow(joined_complete_data) > 0) {
  
  # 5.1 Dataset Overview

  # 5.3 Spatial Coverage

  cat("\n5.4 LEAF NUTRIENT ANALYSIS\n")

  npk_summary <- joined_complete_data %>%

      N_sd = round(sd(leaf_nitrogen_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      N_min = round(min(leaf_nitrogen_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      N_max = round(max(leaf_nitrogen_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      N_cv = round(sd(leaf_nitrogen_pct, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(leaf_nitrogen_pct, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 2),
      
      # Phosphorus
      P_mean = round(mean(leaf_phosphorus_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      P_sd = round(sd(leaf_phosphorus_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      P_min = round(min(leaf_phosphorus_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      P_max = round(max(leaf_phosphorus_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      P_cv = round(sd(leaf_phosphorus_pct, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(leaf_phosphorus_pct, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 2),
      
      # Potassium
      K_mean = round(mean(leaf_potassium_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      K_sd = round(sd(leaf_potassium_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      K_min = round(min(leaf_potassium_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      K_max = round(max(leaf_potassium_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),

    )
  
  cat("NPK Content Summary (% dry weight):\n")
  cat("Nitrogen  - Mean:", npk_summary$N_mean, "± SD:", npk_summary$N_sd, 
      "(Range:", npk_summary$N_min, "-", npk_summary$N_max, ") CV:", npk_summary$N_cv, "%\n")
  cat("Phosphorus- Mean:", npk_summary$P_mean, "± SD:", npk_summary$P_sd, 
      "(Range:", npk_summary$P_min, "-", npk_summary$P_max, ") CV:", npk_summary$P_cv, "%\n")
  cat("Potassium - Mean:", npk_summary$K_mean, "± SD:", npk_summary$K_sd, 
      "(Range:", npk_summary$K_min, "-", npk_summary$K_max, ") CV:", npk_summary$K_cv, "%\n")
  
  # 5.5 Water Content Analysis
  cat("\n5.5 WATER CONTENT ANALYSIS\n")
  cat("--------------------------\n")
  
  water_summary <- joined_complete_data %>%
    summarise(
      leaf_water_mean = round(mean(leaf_water_content_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      leaf_water_sd = round(sd(leaf_water_content_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      sheath_water_mean = round(mean(sheath_water_content_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      sheath_water_sd = round(sd(sheath_water_content_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
      water_diff_mean = round(mean(leaf_water_content_pct - sheath_water_content_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
    )
  
  cat("Water Content Summary (%):\n")
  cat("Leaf water content   :", water_summary$leaf_water_mean, "±", water_summary$leaf_water_sd, "\n")
  cat("Sheath water content :", water_summary$sheath_water_mean, "±", water_summary$sheath_water_sd, "\n")
  cat("Leaf-Sheath difference:", water_summary$water_diff_mean, "\n")
  
  # 5.6 Cycle and Age Analysis
  cat("\n5.6 CYCLE AND AGE ANALYSIS\n")
  cat("-------------------------\n")
  
  cycle_summary <- joined_complete_data %>%
    group_by(Cycle) %>%
    summarise(
      n_obs = n(),
      avg_age = round(mean(leaf_age_days, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
      avg_yield = round(mean(tc_per_ha_actual, na.rm = TRUE), 2),

      avg_P = round(mean(leaf_phosphorus_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      avg_K = round(mean(leaf_potassium_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
      .groups = 'drop'
    ) %>%
    arrange(Cycle)
  
  cat("Cycle-wise summary:\n")

  # Age distribution

      median_age = median(leaf_age_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      q75_age = quantile(leaf_age_days, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
      max_age = max(leaf_age_days, na.rm = TRUE),
      mean_age = round(mean(leaf_age_days, na.rm = TRUE), 1)
    )

      "Median:", age_summary$median_age, "Q3:", age_summary$q75_age, 
      "Max:", age_summary$max_age, "Mean:", age_summary$mean_age, "\n")
  
  # 5.7 Yield Relationships - FIXED VERSION
  cat("\n5.7 YIELD RELATIONSHIPS\n")
  cat("----------------------\n")
  
  # Select numeric variables for correlation analysis
  numeric_vars <- c("tc_per_ha_actual", "leaf_nitrogen_pct", "leaf_phosphorus_pct", 
                    "leaf_potassium_pct", "leaf_water_content_pct", "sheath_water_content_pct", 
                    "leaf_age_days", "brix_percent", "pH")
  
  # Check which variables actually exist in the dataset and are numeric
  available_vars <- numeric_vars[numeric_vars %in% colnames(joined_complete_data)]
  
  # Further filter to ensure they are actually numeric
  numeric_check <- sapply(available_vars, function(x) is.numeric(joined_complete_data[[x]]))
  available_numeric_vars <- available_vars[numeric_check]
  
  cat("Available numeric variables for correlation:", paste(available_numeric_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  
  if(length(available_numeric_vars) >= 2 && "tc_per_ha_actual" %in% available_numeric_vars) {
    # Calculate correlations with proper error handling
    tryCatch({
      correlation_data <- joined_complete_data %>%
        select(all_of(available_numeric_vars))
      
      # Remove rows with all NA values
      correlation_data <- correlation_data[rowSums(is.na(correlation_data)) < ncol(correlation_data), ]
      
      if(nrow(correlation_data) > 0) {
        yield_correlations <- cor(correlation_data, use = "pairwise.complete.obs")
        
        if("tc_per_ha_actual" %in% rownames(yield_correlations)) {
          yield_cors <- yield_correlations[,"tc_per_ha_actual"]
          yield_cors <- yield_cors[names(yield_cors) != "tc_per_ha_actual"]
          yield_cors <- sort(abs(yield_cors), decreasing = TRUE)
          
          cat("Variables most correlated with yield (absolute correlation):\n")
          for(i in 1:min(length(yield_cors), 8)) {
            var_name <- names(yield_cors)[i]
            if(!is.na(var_name) && var_name %in% colnames(yield_correlations)) {
              cor_value <- round(yield_correlations["tc_per_ha_actual", var_name], 3)
              if(!is.na(cor_value)) {
                cat(paste0(i, ". ", var_name, ": r = ", cor_value, "\n"))
              }
            }
          }
        } else {
          cat("tc_per_ha_actual not found in correlation matrix\n")
        }
      } else {
        cat("No valid data available for correlation analysis after removing NA rows\n")
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error in correlation calculation:", e$message, "\n")
      cat("Checking data types of variables:\n")
      for(var in available_vars) {
        if(var %in% colnames(joined_complete_data)) {
          cat(paste0(var, ": ", class(joined_complete_data[[var]])[1], "\n"))
        }
      }
    })
  } else {
    cat("Insufficient numeric variables available for yield correlation analysis\n")
    cat("Available variables:", paste(available_numeric_vars, collapse = ", "), "\n")
  }
  
  # 5.8 Quality Relationships - FIXED VERSION
  cat("\n5.8 BRIX (SUGAR CONTENT) RELATIONSHIPS\n")
  cat("-------------------------------------\n")
  
  if(exists("yield_correlations") && !is.null(yield_correlations) && "brix_percent" %in% colnames(yield_correlations)) {
    tryCatch({
      brix_cors <- yield_correlations[,"brix_percent"]
      brix_cors <- brix_cors[names(brix_cors) != "brix_percent"]
      brix_cors <- sort(abs(brix_cors), decreasing = TRUE)
      
      cat("Variables most correlated with Brix (absolute correlation):\n")
      for(i in 1:min(length(brix_cors), 6)) {
        var_name <- names(brix_cors)[i]
        if(!is.na(var_name) && var_name %in% colnames(yield_correlations)) {
          cor_value <- round(yield_correlations["brix_percent", var_name], 3)
          if(!is.na(cor_value)) {
            cat(paste0(i, ". ", var_name, ": r = ", cor_value, "\n"))
          }
        }
      }
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("Error calculating Brix correlations:", e$message, "\n")
    })
  } else {
    cat("Unable to calculate Brix correlations - Brix variable not found or insufficient data\n")
  }
  
  # 5.9 NPK Balance Analysis
  cat("\n5.9 NPK BALANCE ANALYSIS\n")
  cat("-----------------------\n")
  
  # Calculate NPK ratios with better error handling
  tryCatch({
    npk_ratios <- joined_complete_data %>%
      filter(!is.na(leaf_nitrogen_pct) & !is.na(leaf_phosphorus_pct) & !is.na(leaf_potassium_pct) &
             leaf_nitrogen_pct > 0 & leaf_phosphorus_pct > 0 & leaf_potassium_pct > 0) %>%
      mutate(
        N_P_ratio = leaf_nitrogen_pct / leaf_phosphorus_pct,
        N_K_ratio = leaf_nitrogen_pct / leaf_potassium_pct,
        P_K_ratio = leaf_phosphorus_pct / leaf_potassium_pct
      ) %>%
      summarise(
        NP_ratio_mean = round(mean(N_P_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        NK_ratio_mean = round(mean(N_K_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        PK_ratio_mean = round(mean(P_K_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        NP_ratio_sd = round(sd(N_P_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        NK_ratio_sd = round(sd(N_K_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        PK_ratio_sd = round(sd(P_K_ratio, na.rm = TRUE), 2),
        .groups = 'drop'
      )
    
    if(nrow(npk_ratios) > 0) {
      cat("NPK Ratio Analysis:\n")
      cat("N:P ratio - Mean:", npk_ratios$NP_ratio_mean, "± SD:", npk_ratios$NP_ratio_sd, "\n")
      cat("N:K ratio - Mean:", npk_ratios$NK_ratio_mean, "± SD:", npk_ratios$NK_ratio_sd, "\n")
      cat("P:K ratio - Mean:", npk_ratios$PK_ratio_mean, "± SD:", npk_ratios$PK_ratio_sd, "\n")
    } else {
      cat("Unable to calculate NPK ratios - insufficient valid data\n")
    }
  }, error = function(e) {
    cat("Error in NPK ratio calculation:", e$message, "\n")
  })
  
  # 5.10 Data Quality Assessment
  cat("\n5.10 DATA QUALITY ASSESSMENT\n")
  cat("---------------------------\n")
  
  # Missing value analysis
  missing_analysis <- joined_complete_data %>%
    summarise_all(~sum(is.na(.))) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "variable", values_to = "missing_count") %>%
    mutate(missing_percent = round(missing_count / nrow(joined_complete_data) * 100, 2)) %>%
    arrange(desc(missing_percent))
  
  cat("Variables with missing data (>0%):\n")
  missing_vars <- missing_analysis %>% filter(missing_percent > 0)
  if(nrow(missing_vars) > 0) {
    print(missing_vars)
  } else {
    cat("No missing values found in the dataset!\n")
  }
  
  # Outlier detection for key variables
  cat("\nOutlier detection (values beyond 3 SD from mean):\n")
  outlier_vars <- c("tc_per_ha_actual", "brix_percent", "leaf_nitrogen_pct", 
                    "leaf_phosphorus_pct", "leaf_potassium_pct")
  
  for(var in outlier_vars) {
    if(var %in% colnames(joined_complete_data) && is.numeric(joined_complete_data[[var]])) {
      values <- joined_complete_data[[var]]
      values <- values[!is.na(values)]
      if(length(values) > 0) {
        mean_val <- mean(values)
        sd_val <- sd(values)
        if(sd_val > 0) {
          outliers <- sum(abs(values - mean_val) > 3 * sd_val)
          outlier_pct <- round(outliers / length(values) * 100, 2)
          cat(paste0(var, ": ", outliers, " outliers (", outlier_pct, "%)\n"))
        } else {
          cat(paste0(var, ": No variation (SD = 0)\n"))
        }
      } else {
        cat(paste0(var, ": No valid values\n"))
      }
    }
  }
  
} else {
  cat("No matching data found between soil and leaf datasets!\n")
}

# ===============================
# 6. SAVE RESULTS
# ===============================
cat("\n6. SAVING RESULTS\n")
cat("=================\n")

# Save the joined datasets (complete dataset contains only selected leaf variables)
if(nrow(joined_complete_data) > 0) {
  write.csv(joined_complete_data, "sugarcane_soil_leaf_joined_complete.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Complete joined dataset saved as 'sugarcane_soil_leaf_joined_complete.csv'\n")
  cat("This file contains all soil variables + selected leaf variables (NPK, water content, cycle, age)\n")
}

write.csv(joined_left_data, "sugarcane_soil_leaf_joined_left.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Left joined dataset saved as 'sugarcane_soil_leaf_joined_left.csv'\n")

# Save the datasets with IDs separately as well
write.csv(subset_data, "soil_data_with_ids.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(leaf_data_selected, "leaf_data_selected_with_ids.csv", row.names = FALSE)
cat("Individual datasets with IDs saved\n")

# Save summary statistics
if(exists("year_summary")) {
  write.csv(year_summary, "summary_by_year.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(parcel_summary, "summary_by_parcel.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  write.csv(cycle_summary, "summary_by_cycle.csv", row.names = FALSE)
  cat("Summary tables saved as separate CSV files\n")
}
```

# X. Crop Cycle Analysis : Three datasets (Yield + Soil + Leaf)

```{r}
# ===============================
# CROP CYCLE DIAGNOSTIC ANALYSIS
# Analyzing crop cycles and parcel plantation trajectories
# ===============================

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(viridis)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(gridExtra)
library(scales)

# Define the readable theme
readable_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5, margin = margin(b = 20)),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 20, hjust = 0.5, color = "gray40", margin = margin(b = 15)),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 16, color = "gray50", hjust = 0, margin = margin(t = 15)),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 16),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90", size = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "gray95", size = 0.3),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray95", color = NA)
  )

# ===============================
# 1. LOAD AND PREPARE DATA
# ===============================

# Read the joined dataset
joined_data <- read.csv("sugarcane_soil_leaf_joined_complete.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

cat("===============================\n")
cat("CROP CYCLE DIAGNOSTIC ANALYSIS\n")
cat("===============================\n\n")

cat("Dataset dimensions:", nrow(joined_data), "rows,", ncol(joined_data), "columns\n\n")

# ===============================
# 2. CYCLE COMPARISON ANALYSIS
# ===============================

cat("2. CYCLE COMPARISON ANALYSIS\n")
cat("============================\n")

# Check for differences between crop_cycle and Cycle
cycle_comparison <- joined_data %>%
  mutate(
    crop_cycle_clean = as.character(crop_cycle),
    Cycle_clean = as.character(Cycle),
    cycles_match = crop_cycle_clean == Cycle_clean
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(crop_cycle_clean) & !is.na(Cycle_clean))

# Summary of matches/mismatches
match_summary <- cycle_comparison %>%
  summarise(
    total_records = n(),
    matching_cycles = sum(cycles_match, na.rm = TRUE),
    mismatching_cycles = sum(!cycles_match, na.rm = TRUE),
    match_percentage = round(matching_cycles / total_records * 100, 2)
  )

cat("Cycle Comparison Summary:\n")
cat("Total records with both cycle variables:", match_summary$total_records, "\n")
cat("Matching cycles:", match_summary$matching_cycles, "\n")
cat("Mismatching cycles:", match_summary$mismatching_cycles, "\n")
cat("Match percentage:", match_summary$match_percentage, "%\n\n")

# Show examples of mismatches if any exist
if(match_summary$mismatching_cycles > 0) {
  mismatches <- cycle_comparison %>%
    filter(!cycles_match) %>%
    select(parcel_year_id, parcel, Harvest_Year, crop_cycle_clean, Cycle_clean) %>%
    head(10)
  
  cat("Sample of mismatching cycles:\n")
  print(mismatches)
  cat("\n")
}

# Create a contingency table for cycle comparison
cycle_table <- table(cycle_comparison$crop_cycle_clean, cycle_comparison$Cycle_clean, useNA = "ifany")
cat("Contingency table (crop_cycle vs Cycle):\n")
print(cycle_table)
cat("\n")

# ===============================
# 3. DETERMINE PRIMARY CYCLE VARIABLE
# ===============================

# Use the variable with more complete data or create consensus
cycle_data <- joined_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Create a consensus cycle variable - prefer one with more data
    primary_cycle = case_when(
      !is.na(crop_cycle) & !is.na(Cycle) & crop_cycle == Cycle ~ crop_cycle,
      !is.na(crop_cycle) & is.na(Cycle) ~ crop_cycle,
      is.na(crop_cycle) & !is.na(Cycle) ~ Cycle,
      !is.na(crop_cycle) & !is.na(Cycle) & crop_cycle != Cycle ~ crop_cycle, # Default to soil data
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    primary_cycle = as.numeric(primary_cycle)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(primary_cycle))

cat("3. PRIMARY CYCLE VARIABLE SELECTION\n")
cat("===================================\n")
cat("Using consensus cycle variable with", nrow(cycle_data), "valid records\n")
cat("Cycle range:", min(cycle_data$primary_cycle, na.rm = TRUE), "to", max(cycle_data$primary_cycle, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

# ===============================
# 4. PARCEL-LEVEL CYCLE ANALYSIS
# ===============================

cat("4. PARCEL-LEVEL CYCLE ANALYSIS\n")
cat("==============================\n")

# Analyze cycles per parcel
parcel_cycle_summary <- cycle_data %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  summarise(
    n_observations = n(),
    n_years = n_distinct(Harvest_Year),
    n_cycles = n_distinct(primary_cycle),
    min_cycle = min(primary_cycle, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_cycle = max(primary_cycle, na.rm = TRUE),
    cycle_range = max_cycle - min_cycle + 1,
    cycles_observed = paste(sort(unique(primary_cycle)), collapse = ", "),
    years_span = paste(sort(unique(Harvest_Year)), collapse = ", "),
    first_year = min(Harvest_Year),
    last_year = max(Harvest_Year),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_cycles), desc(n_observations))

cat("Parcel Cycle Summary Statistics:\n")
cat("Total unique parcels:", nrow(parcel_cycle_summary), "\n")
cat("Parcels with multiple cycles:", sum(parcel_cycle_summary$n_cycles > 1), "\n")
cat("Average cycles per parcel:", round(mean(parcel_cycle_summary$n_cycles), 2), "\n")
cat("Maximum cycles observed:", max(parcel_cycle_summary$n_cycles), "\n\n")

# Distribution of cycles per parcel
cycle_dist <- table(parcel_cycle_summary$n_cycles)
cat("Distribution of number of cycles per parcel:\n")
print(cycle_dist)
cat("\n")

# Top parcels by cycle coverage
cat("Top 15 parcels by cycle coverage:\n")
top_parcels <- parcel_cycle_summary %>% head(15)
print(top_parcels[, c("parcel", "n_cycles", "cycle_range", "cycles_observed", "first_year", "last_year")])
cat("\n")

# ===============================
# 5. TEMPORAL TRAJECTORY ANALYSIS
# ===============================

cat("5. TEMPORAL TRAJECTORY ANALYSIS\n")
cat("===============================\n")

# Create trajectory analysis for parcels with multiple cycles
trajectory_data <- cycle_data %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  arrange(Harvest_Year, primary_cycle) %>%
  mutate(
    cycle_sequence = row_number(),
    is_first_cycle = primary_cycle == min(primary_cycle),
    years_since_start = Harvest_Year - min(Harvest_Year)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Analyze cycle progression patterns
cycle_transitions <- trajectory_data %>%
  arrange(parcel, Harvest_Year) %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  mutate(
    next_cycle = lead(primary_cycle),
    cycle_transition = paste0(primary_cycle, "->", next_cycle)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(next_cycle)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Most common transitions
transition_summary <- cycle_transitions %>%
  count(cycle_transition, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 2))

cat("Most common cycle transitions:\n")
print(head(transition_summary, 10))
cat("\n")

# ===============================
# 6. LONGITUDINAL COHORT ANALYSIS
# ===============================

cat("6. LONGITUDINAL COHORT ANALYSIS\n")
cat("===============================\n")

# Track parcels starting from cycle 1
first_cycle_parcels <- cycle_data %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  filter(primary_cycle == min(primary_cycle)) %>%
  select(parcel, first_cycle = primary_cycle, first_year = Harvest_Year) %>%
  distinct()

# Create cohort tracking
cohort_tracking <- cycle_data %>%
  inner_join(first_cycle_parcels, by = "parcel") %>%
  mutate(
    cycle_from_start = primary_cycle - first_cycle + 1,
    years_since_first = Harvest_Year - first_year
  ) %>%
  filter(cycle_from_start >= 1)

# Cohort survival analysis
cohort_survival <- cohort_tracking %>%
  group_by(first_cycle, cycle_from_start) %>%
  summarise(
    n_parcels = n_distinct(parcel),
    avg_years_elapsed = round(mean(years_since_first), 1),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  group_by(first_cycle) %>%
  mutate(
    initial_parcels = first(n_parcels),
    survival_rate = round(n_parcels / initial_parcels * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cat("Cohort survival analysis:\n")
print(cohort_survival)
cat("\n")

# ===============================
# 7. CREATE VISUALIZATIONS
# ===============================

cat("7. CREATING VISUALIZATIONS\n")
cat("==========================\n")

# 7.1 Cycle Distribution by Parcel
p1 <- ggplot(parcel_cycle_summary, aes(x = n_cycles)) +
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 1, fill = "steelblue", color = "white", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(stat = "count", aes(label = after_stat(count)), vjust = -0.5, size = 6) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Crop Cycles per Parcel",
    subtitle = "Number of different cycles observed per parcel",
    x = "Number of Cycles per Parcel",
    y = "Number of Parcels",
    caption = "Each bar shows how many parcels have that number of cycles"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(1, max(parcel_cycle_summary$n_cycles), 1)) +
  readable_theme

# 7.2 Cycle Timeline Heatmap
cycle_year_matrix <- cycle_data %>%
  count(primary_cycle, Harvest_Year) %>%
  complete(primary_cycle, Harvest_Year, fill = list(n = 0))

p2 <- ggplot(cycle_year_matrix, aes(x = factor(Harvest_Year), y = factor(primary_cycle), fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(name = "Number of\nObservations", option = "plasma") +
  labs(
    title = "Crop Cycle Distribution Across Years",
    subtitle = "Intensity heatmap showing cycle-year combinations",
    x = "Harvest Year",
    y = "Crop Cycle",
    caption = "Darker colors indicate more observations for that cycle-year combination"
  ) +
  readable_theme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# 7.3 Parcel Trajectory Visualization (for top parcels)
top_trajectory_parcels <- parcel_cycle_summary %>%
  filter(n_cycles >= 3) %>%
  head(12) %>%
  pull(parcel)

trajectory_plot_data <- trajectory_data %>%
  filter(parcel %in% top_trajectory_parcels) %>%
  arrange(parcel, Harvest_Year)

p3 <- ggplot(trajectory_plot_data, aes(x = Harvest_Year, y = primary_cycle, color = parcel)) +
  geom_line(size = 1.2, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_point(size = 3, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_viridis_d(name = "Parcel", option = "turbo") +
  facet_wrap(~parcel, scales = "free_x", ncol = 4) +
  labs(
    title = "Individual Parcel Cycle Trajectories",
    subtitle = "Crop cycle progression over time for parcels with ≥3 cycles",
    x = "Harvest Year",
    y = "Crop Cycle",
    caption = "Each line shows how one parcel's crop cycle changed over time"
  ) +
  readable_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# 7.4 Cycle Transition Network
transition_matrix <- cycle_transitions %>%
  separate(cycle_transition, into = c("from_cycle", "to_cycle"), sep = "->", remove = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    from_cycle = as.numeric(from_cycle),
    to_cycle = as.numeric(to_cycle)
  ) %>%
  count(from_cycle, to_cycle, sort = TRUE) %>%
  filter(n >= 2)  # Only show transitions that happened at least twice

p4 <- ggplot(transition_matrix, aes(x = factor(from_cycle), y = factor(to_cycle), fill = n)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white", size = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = n), color = "white", size = 6, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "lightblue", high = "darkblue", name = "Frequency") +
  labs(
    title = "Crop Cycle Transition Matrix",
    subtitle = "How often parcels transition from one cycle to another",
    x = "From Cycle",
    y = "To Cycle",
    caption = "Numbers show frequency of each transition type"
  ) +
  readable_theme

# 7.5 Cohort Survival Analysis
cohort_filtered <- cohort_survival %>%
  filter(first_cycle %in% c(1, 2, 3, 4)) %>%  # Focus on main starting cycles
  filter(cycle_from_start <= 8)  # Limit to reasonable range

p5 <- ggplot(cohort_filtered, aes(x = cycle_from_start, y = survival_rate, color = factor(first_cycle))) +
  geom_line(size = 1.5, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 4, alpha = 0.9) +
  scale_color_brewer(type = "qual", palette = "Set1", name = "Starting\nCycle") +
  labs(
    title = "Parcel Retention by Starting Cycle",
    subtitle = "Percentage of parcels still tracked over successive cycles",
    x = "Cycles Since Start",
    y = "Retention Rate (%)",
    caption = "Shows what percentage of parcels continue to be observed over time"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), labels = function(x) paste0(x, "%")) +
  readable_theme

# 7.6 Cycle Age Distribution
cycle_age_data <- cycle_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(leaf_age_days)) %>%
  group_by(primary_cycle) %>%
  mutate(cycle_count = n()) %>%
  filter(cycle_count >= 10)  # Only cycles with enough observations

p6 <- ggplot(cycle_age_data, aes(x = factor(primary_cycle), y = leaf_age_days, fill = factor(primary_cycle))) +
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.7, scale = "width") +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, alpha = 0.8, outlier.alpha = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Cycle", option = "viridis") +
  labs(
    title = "Leaf Sampling Age Distribution by Crop Cycle",
    subtitle = "Distribution of leaf age at sampling across different crop cycles",
    x = "Crop Cycle",
    y = "Leaf Age (days)",
    caption = "Violin plots show distribution shape, box plots show median and quartiles"
  ) +
  readable_theme +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# ===============================
# 8. SAVE PLOTS - with error handling
# ===============================

# Save all plots with error handling
tryCatch({
  ggsave("cycle_distribution_per_parcel.png", p1, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
  cat("✓ Saved: cycle_distribution_per_parcel.png\n")
}, error = function(e) cat("✗ Error saving p1:", e$message, "\n"))

tryCatch({
  ggsave("cycle_year_heatmap.png", p2, width = 16, height = 10, dpi = 300)
  cat("✓ Saved: cycle_year_heatmap.png\n")
}, error = function(e) cat("✗ Error saving p2:", e$message, "\n"))

tryCatch({
  ggsave("parcel_trajectories.png", p3, width = 20, height = 16, dpi = 300)
  cat("✓ Saved: parcel_trajectories.png\n")
}, error = function(e) cat("✗ Error saving p3:", e$message, "\n"))

tryCatch({
  ggsave("cycle_transition_matrix.png", p4, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
  cat("✓ Saved: cycle_transition_matrix.png\n")
}, error = function(e) cat("✗ Error saving p4:", e$message, "\n"))

tryCatch({
  ggsave("cohort_survival_analysis.png", p5, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
  cat("✓ Saved: cohort_survival_analysis.png\n")
}, error = function(e) cat("✗ Error saving p5:", e$message, "\n"))

tryCatch({
  ggsave("cycle_age_distribution.png", p6, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300)
  cat("✓ Saved: cycle_age_distribution.png\n")
}, error = function(e) cat("✗ Error saving p6:", e$message, "\n"))

# Create a combined summary plot - only with plots that were successfully created
valid_plots <- list()
if(exists("p1")) valid_plots[["Distribution"]] <- p1
if(exists("p2")) valid_plots[["Heatmap"]] <- p2
if(exists("p4") && nrow(transition_matrix) > 0) valid_plots[["Transitions"]] <- p4
if(exists("p5") && nrow(cohort_filtered) > 0) valid_plots[["Cohorts"]] <- p5

if(length(valid_plots) >= 2) {
  tryCatch({
    if(length(valid_plots) == 4) {
      combined_plot <- grid.arrange(valid_plots[[1]], valid_plots[[2]], valid_plots[[3]], valid_plots[[4]], ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
    } else if(length(valid_plots) == 3) {
      combined_plot <- grid.arrange(valid_plots[[1]], valid_plots[[2]], valid_plots[[3]], ncol = 2, nrow = 2)
    } else {
      combined_plot <- grid.arrange(valid_plots[[1]], valid_plots[[2]], ncol = 2, nrow = 1)
    }
    ggsave("cycle_analysis_summary.png", combined_plot, width = 24, height = 20, dpi = 300)
    cat("✓ Saved: cycle_analysis_summary.png\n")
  }, error = function(e) cat("✗ Error saving combined plot:", e$message, "\n"))
} else {
  cat("⚠ Not enough valid plots for combined summary\n")
}

# ===============================
# 9. SAVE DETAILED SUMMARIES
# ===============================

# Save summary tables
write.csv(parcel_cycle_summary, "parcel_cycle_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(transition_summary, "cycle_transitions_summary.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(cohort_survival, "cohort_survival_analysis.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```
