```{r}
# ===============================
# ARCEL ANALYSIS SCRIPT
# Analyzing leaf analysis frequency and replantation patterns
# Based on crop_cycle progression and leaf monitoring data
# ===============================

# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)
library(scales)

cat("PARCEL ANALYSIS: LEAF MONITORING & REPLANTATION DETECTION\n")
cat("==================================================================\n\n")

# ===============================
# 1. DATA PREPARATION AND VALIDATION
# ===============================
cat("1. DATA PREPARATION AND VALIDATION\n")
cat("===================================\n")

# Check if the joined dataset exists from previous script
if(!exists("joined_complete_data") || nrow(joined_complete_data) == 0) {
  stop("Error: joined_complete_data not found. Please run the linking script first.")
}

# Validate required columns
required_cols <- c("parcel", "Harvest_Year", "crop_cycle", "parcel_year_id", 
                   "leaf_nitrogen_pct", "leaf_phosphorus_pct", "leaf_potassium_pct")
missing_cols <- setdiff(required_cols, colnames(joined_complete_data))
if(length(missing_cols) > 0) {
  stop(paste("Missing required columns:", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", ")))
}

# Clean and standardize crop_cycle values
joined_complete_data <- joined_complete_data %>%
  mutate(
    # Standardize crop_cycle values
    crop_cycle_clean = case_when(
      tolower(crop_cycle) %in% c("jachere", "jachère", "fallow") ~ "Fallow",
      tolower(crop_cycle) %in% c("essais", "essai", "trial", "test") ~ "Trial",
      is.na(crop_cycle) ~ "Unknown",
      TRUE ~ as.character(crop_cycle)
    ),
    # Convert numeric crop cycles to integers where possible
    crop_cycle_numeric = case_when(
      crop_cycle_clean %in% c("Fallow", "Trial", "Unknown") ~ NA_real_,
      str_detect(crop_cycle_clean, "^\\d+$") ~ as.numeric(crop_cycle_clean),
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    )
  )

cat("Data preparation completed. Dataset contains", nrow(joined_complete_data), "observations.\n")

# Display crop cycle distribution
cycle_dist <- joined_complete_data %>%
  count(crop_cycle_clean, sort = TRUE)
cat("\nCrop cycle distribution:\n")
print(cycle_dist)

# ===============================
# 2. LEAF ANALYSIS FREQUENCY PER PARCEL
# ===============================
cat("\n2. LEAF ANALYSIS FREQUENCY PER PARCEL\n")
cat("=====================================\n")

# Calculate leaf analysis frequency per parcel
parcel_analysis_frequency <- joined_complete_data %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  summarise(
    # Basic counts
    total_leaf_analyses = n(),
    years_with_analyses = n_distinct(Harvest_Year),
    first_analysis_year = min(Harvest_Year, na.rm = TRUE),
    last_analysis_year = max(Harvest_Year, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Crop cycle information
    crop_cycles_analyzed = paste(sort(unique(crop_cycle_clean)), collapse = ", "),
    numeric_cycles_range = ifelse(
      all(is.na(crop_cycle_numeric)), 
      "Non-numeric cycles only",
      paste0(min(crop_cycle_numeric, na.rm = TRUE), "-", max(crop_cycle_numeric, na.rm = TRUE))
    ),
    
    # Analysis patterns
    avg_analyses_per_year = round(total_leaf_analyses / years_with_analyses, 2),
    analysis_span_years = last_analysis_year - first_analysis_year + 1,
    
    # Special cycle indicators
    has_fallow_analysis = "Fallow" %in% crop_cycle_clean,
    has_trial_analysis = "Trial" %in% crop_cycle_clean,
    has_numeric_cycles = any(!is.na(crop_cycle_numeric)),
    
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_leaf_analyses))

cat("LEAF ANALYSIS FREQUENCY SUMMARY\n")
cat("-------------------------------\n")
cat("Total parcels analyzed:", nrow(parcel_analysis_frequency), "\n")
cat("Average analyses per parcel:", round(mean(parcel_analysis_frequency$total_leaf_analyses), 2), "\n")
cat("Median analyses per parcel:", median(parcel_analysis_frequency$total_leaf_analyses), "\n")
cat("Range of analyses per parcel:", min(parcel_analysis_frequency$total_leaf_analyses), 
    "to", max(parcel_analysis_frequency$total_leaf_analyses), "\n")

# Display top parcels by analysis frequency
cat("\nTOP 15 PARCELS BY ANALYSIS FREQUENCY:\n")
top_parcels <- head(parcel_analysis_frequency, 15)
print(top_parcels[, c("parcel", "total_leaf_analyses", "years_with_analyses", 
                      "first_analysis_year", "last_analysis_year", "crop_cycles_analyzed")])

# Analysis frequency distribution
cat("\nANALYSIS FREQUENCY DISTRIBUTION:\n")
freq_dist <- parcel_analysis_frequency %>%
  count(total_leaf_analyses, name = "parcels_count") %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(parcels_count / sum(parcels_count) * 100, 2)) %>%
  arrange(total_leaf_analyses)
print(freq_dist)

# ===============================
# 3. REPLANTATION DETECTION ANALYSIS
# ===============================
cat("\n3. REPLANTATION DETECTION ANALYSIS\n")
cat("==================================\n")

# Function to detect replantations based on crop cycle patterns
detect_replantations <- function(df) {
  df %>%
    filter(!is.na(crop_cycle_numeric)) %>%
    arrange(Harvest_Year) %>%
    mutate(
      # Calculate differences between consecutive crop cycles
      cycle_diff = c(NA, diff(crop_cycle_numeric)),
      # Detect replantation: cycle goes back to 0 or 1, or significant decrease
      is_replantation = case_when(
        is.na(lag(crop_cycle_numeric)) ~ FALSE, # First observation
        crop_cycle_numeric <= 1 & lag(crop_cycle_numeric) > 2 ~ TRUE, # Reset to early cycle
        crop_cycle_numeric < lag(crop_cycle_numeric) - 1 ~ TRUE, # Significant decrease
        TRUE ~ FALSE
      ),
      # Number the plantation periods
      plantation_period = cumsum(c(TRUE, is_replantation[-1]))
    )
}

# Apply replantation detection to each parcel
replantation_analysis <- joined_complete_data %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  do(detect_replantations(.)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Summary of replantation patterns
replantation_summary <- replantation_analysis %>%
  group_by(parcel) %>%
  summarise(
    total_observations = n(),
    replantations_detected = sum(is_replantation, na.rm = TRUE),
    plantation_periods = max(plantation_period, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    # Detailed replantation info
    replantation_years = ifelse(
      sum(is_replantation, na.rm = TRUE) > 0,
      paste(Harvest_Year[is_replantation], collapse = ", "),
      "None"
    ),
    
    # Cycle progression analysis
    min_cycle = min(crop_cycle_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    max_cycle = max(crop_cycle_numeric, na.rm = TRUE),
    cycle_progression = paste(sort(unique(crop_cycle_numeric[!is.na(crop_cycle_numeric)])), collapse = " → "),
    
    # Years span
    analysis_span_years = paste0(min(Harvest_Year), "-", max(Harvest_Year)),
    years_monitored = n_distinct(Harvest_Year),
    
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  # Fix infinite values
  mutate(
    min_cycle = ifelse(is.infinite(min_cycle), NA, min_cycle),
    max_cycle = ifelse(is.infinite(max_cycle), NA, max_cycle),
    plantation_periods = ifelse(is.infinite(plantation_periods), 1, plantation_periods)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(replantations_detected), desc(plantation_periods))

cat("REPLANTATION DETECTION SUMMARY\n")
cat("------------------------------\n")
total_parcels_with_numeric <- sum(!is.na(replantation_summary$min_cycle))
parcels_with_replantations <- sum(replantation_summary$replantations_detected > 0, na.rm = TRUE)

cat("Total parcels with numeric crop cycles:", total_parcels_with_numeric, "\n")
cat("Parcels with detected replantations:", parcels_with_replantations, "\n")
if(total_parcels_with_numeric > 0) {
  cat("Replantation rate:", round(parcels_with_replantations / total_parcels_with_numeric * 100, 2), "%\n")
}

if(parcels_with_replantations > 0) {
  cat("\nPARCELS WITH DETECTED REPLANTATIONS:\n")
  replanted_parcels <- replantation_summary %>%
    filter(replantations_detected > 0) %>%
    select(parcel, replantations_detected, plantation_periods, replantation_years, 
           cycle_progression, analysis_span_years)
  print(replanted_parcels)
}

# ===============================
# 4. DETAILED PARCEL-BY-PARCEL ANALYSIS
# ===============================
cat("\n4. DETAILED PARCEL-BY-PARCEL ANALYSIS\n")
cat("====================================\n")

# Comprehensive parcel analysis combining frequency and replantation data
comprehensive_parcel_analysis <- parcel_analysis_frequency %>%
  left_join(
    replantation_summary %>%
      select(parcel, replantations_detected, plantation_periods, replantation_years, 
             cycle_progression, min_cycle, max_cycle),
    by = "parcel"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # Classification of parcel monitoring patterns
    monitoring_pattern = case_when(
      total_leaf_analyses >= 10 ~ "Intensive monitoring (10+ analyses)",
      total_leaf_analyses >= 5 ~ "Regular monitoring (5-9 analyses)",
      total_leaf_analyses >= 3 ~ "Moderate monitoring (3-4 analyses)",
      TRUE ~ "Limited monitoring (1-2 analyses)"
    ),
    
    # Replantation classification
    replantation_pattern = case_when(
      is.na(replantations_detected) ~ "No numeric cycles",
      replantations_detected == 0 ~ "No replantations",
      replantations_detected == 1 ~ "Single replantation",
      replantations_detected >= 2 ~ "Multiple replantations"
    ),
    
    # Calculate monitoring intensity (analyses per year)
    monitoring_intensity = case_when(
      analysis_span_years == 0 ~ total_leaf_analyses,
      TRUE ~ round(total_leaf_analyses / analysis_span_years, 2)
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(total_leaf_analyses))

# Summary by monitoring patterns
monitoring_pattern_summary <- comprehensive_parcel_analysis %>%
  group_by(monitoring_pattern) %>%
  summarise(
    parcels_count = n(),
    avg_analyses = round(mean(total_leaf_analyses), 2),
    avg_years_span = round(mean(analysis_span_years), 2),
    parcels_with_replantations = sum(replantations_detected > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(parcels_count / sum(parcels_count) * 100, 2))

cat("MONITORING PATTERN SUMMARY:\n")
print(monitoring_pattern_summary)

# Summary by replantation patterns
replantation_pattern_summary <- comprehensive_parcel_analysis %>%
  group_by(replantation_pattern) %>%
  summarise(
    parcels_count = n(),
    avg_analyses = round(mean(total_leaf_analyses), 2),
    avg_monitoring_years = round(mean(years_with_analyses), 2),
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  mutate(percentage = round(parcels_count / sum(parcels_count) * 100, 2))

cat("\nREPLANTATION PATTERN SUMMARY:\n")
print(replantation_pattern_summary)

# ===============================
# 5. TEMPORAL ANALYSIS OF LEAF MONITORING
# ===============================
cat("\n5. TEMPORAL ANALYSIS OF LEAF MONITORING\n")
cat("======================================\n")

# Year-by-year analysis
yearly_analysis <- joined_complete_data %>%
  group_by(Harvest_Year) %>%
  summarise(
    parcels_analyzed = n_distinct(parcel),
    total_analyses = n(),
    avg_analyses_per_parcel = round(total_analyses / parcels_analyzed, 2),
    
    # Crop cycle distribution
    fallow_analyses = sum(crop_cycle_clean == "Fallow"),
    trial_analyses = sum(crop_cycle_clean == "Trial"),
    numeric_cycle_analyses = sum(!is.na(crop_cycle_numeric)),
    
    # Average nutrient levels
    avg_nitrogen = round(mean(leaf_nitrogen_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    avg_phosphorus = round(mean(leaf_phosphorus_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    avg_potassium = round(mean(leaf_potassium_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  arrange(Harvest_Year)

# Add replantation information to yearly analysis (separate calculation)
yearly_replantations <- replantation_analysis %>%
  group_by(Harvest_Year) %>%
  summarise(
    replantations_this_year = sum(is_replantation, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

# Join replantation data with yearly analysis
yearly_analysis <- yearly_analysis %>%
  left_join(yearly_replantations, by = "Harvest_Year") %>%
  mutate(replantations_this_year = ifelse(is.na(replantations_this_year), 0, replantations_this_year))

cat("YEARLY MONITORING SUMMARY:\n")
print(yearly_analysis)

# Peak monitoring years
peak_years <- yearly_analysis %>%
  arrange(desc(total_analyses)) %>%
  head(5)
cat("\nTOP 5 YEARS BY ANALYSIS VOLUME:\n")
print(peak_years[, c("Harvest_Year", "parcels_analyzed", "total_analyses", "avg_analyses_per_parcel")])

# ===============================
# 6. NUTRIENT ANALYSIS BY MONITORING PATTERNS
# ===============================
cat("\n6. NUTRIENT ANALYSIS BY MONITORING PATTERNS\n")
cat("==========================================\n")

# Nutrient levels by monitoring intensity
nutrient_by_monitoring <- joined_complete_data %>%
  left_join(
    comprehensive_parcel_analysis %>% select(parcel, monitoring_pattern),
    by = "parcel"
  ) %>%
  group_by(monitoring_pattern) %>%
  summarise(
    observations = n(),
    
    # Nitrogen analysis
    N_mean = round(mean(leaf_nitrogen_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    N_sd = round(sd(leaf_nitrogen_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    N_cv = round(sd(leaf_nitrogen_pct, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(leaf_nitrogen_pct, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 2),
    
    # Phosphorus analysis
    P_mean = round(mean(leaf_phosphorus_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    P_sd = round(sd(leaf_phosphorus_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    P_cv = round(sd(leaf_phosphorus_pct, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(leaf_phosphorus_pct, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 2),
    
    # Potassium analysis
    K_mean = round(mean(leaf_potassium_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    K_sd = round(sd(leaf_potassium_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    K_cv = round(sd(leaf_potassium_pct, na.rm = TRUE) / mean(leaf_potassium_pct, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 2),
    
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

cat("NUTRIENT LEVELS BY MONITORING INTENSITY:\n")
print(nutrient_by_monitoring)

# Nutrient levels by crop cycle
nutrient_by_cycle <- joined_complete_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(crop_cycle_numeric)) %>%
  mutate(
    cycle_category = case_when(
      crop_cycle_numeric <= 2 ~ "Young (0-2)",
      crop_cycle_numeric <= 5 ~ "Mature (3-5)",
      crop_cycle_numeric <= 8 ~ "Old (6-8)",
      TRUE ~ "Very Old (9+)"
    )
  ) %>%
  group_by(cycle_category) %>%
  summarise(
    observations = n(),
    parcels = n_distinct(parcel),
    
    # Average nutrient content
    avg_N = round(mean(leaf_nitrogen_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    avg_P = round(mean(leaf_phosphorus_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    avg_K = round(mean(leaf_potassium_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    
    # Standard deviations
    sd_N = round(sd(leaf_nitrogen_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    sd_P = round(sd(leaf_phosphorus_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    sd_K = round(sd(leaf_potassium_pct, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    
    .groups = 'drop'
  )

cat("\nNUTRIENT LEVELS BY CROP CYCLE CATEGORY:\n")
print(nutrient_by_cycle)

# ===============================
# 7. SPECIAL CASES AND ANOMALIES
# ===============================
cat("\n7. SPECIAL CASES AND ANOMALIES\n")
cat("=============================\n")

# Identify special cases
special_cases <- list()

# 1. Parcels with only fallow/trial analyses
special_cases$non_production <- comprehensive_parcel_analysis %>%
  filter(!has_numeric_cycles & (has_fallow_analysis | has_trial_analysis)) %>%
  select(parcel, total_leaf_analyses, crop_cycles_analyzed, analysis_span_years)

if(nrow(special_cases$non_production) > 0) {
  cat("PARCELS WITH ONLY NON-PRODUCTION ANALYSES (Fallow/Trial):\n")
  print(special_cases$non_production)
}

# 2. Parcels with very high analysis frequency
special_cases$high_frequency <- comprehensive_parcel_analysis %>%
  filter(monitoring_intensity >= 2) %>% # 2+ analyses per year
  select(parcel, total_leaf_analyses, years_with_analyses, monitoring_intensity, 
         replantation_pattern) %>%
  arrange(desc(monitoring_intensity))

if(nrow(special_cases$high_frequency) > 0) {
  cat("\nPARCELS WITH HIGH MONITORING FREQUENCY (≥2 analyses/year):\n")
  print(special_cases$high_frequency)
}

# 3. Parcels with multiple replantations
special_cases$multiple_replantations <- comprehensive_parcel_analysis %>%
  filter(replantations_detected >= 2) %>%
  select(parcel, replantations_detected, plantation_periods, replantation_years, 
         cycle_progression, total_leaf_analyses)

if(nrow(special_cases$multiple_replantations) > 0) {
  cat("\nPARCELS WITH MULTIPLE REPLANTATIONS:\n")
  print(special_cases$multiple_replantations)
}

# 4. Long-term monitored parcels
special_cases$long_term <- comprehensive_parcel_analysis %>%
  filter(analysis_span_years >= 8) %>% # 8+ years of monitoring
  select(parcel, total_leaf_analyses, years_with_analyses, analysis_span_years, 
         first_analysis_year, last_analysis_year, replantation_pattern) %>%
  arrange(desc(analysis_span_years))

if(nrow(special_cases$long_term) > 0) {
  cat("\nLONG-TERM MONITORED PARCELS (≥8 years):\n")
  print(special_cases$long_term)
}

# ===============================
# 8. KEY INSIGHTS AND RECOMMENDATIONS
# ===============================
cat("\n8. KEY INSIGHTS AND RECOMMENDATIONS\n")
cat("==================================\n")

cat("KEY FINDINGS:\n")
cat("-------------\n")

# Calculate key metrics
total_parcels <- nrow(comprehensive_parcel_analysis)
intensive_monitoring <- sum(comprehensive_parcel_analysis$total_leaf_analyses >= 10)
parcels_with_replants <- sum(comprehensive_parcel_analysis$replantations_detected > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
long_term_parcels <- sum(comprehensive_parcel_analysis$analysis_span_years >= 8)

cat("1. MONITORING COVERAGE:\n")
cat(sprintf("   - Total parcels analyzed: %d\n", total_parcels))
cat(sprintf("   - Intensively monitored parcels (10+ analyses): %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
            intensive_monitoring, intensive_monitoring/total_parcels*100))
cat(sprintf("   - Long-term monitored parcels (8+ years): %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
            long_term_parcels, long_term_parcels/total_parcels*100))

cat("\n2. REPLANTATION PATTERNS:\n")
if(sum(!is.na(comprehensive_parcel_analysis$replantations_detected)) > 0) {
  cat(sprintf("   - Parcels with replantations: %d (%.1f%%)\n", 
              parcels_with_replants, 
              parcels_with_replants/sum(!is.na(comprehensive_parcel_analysis$replantations_detected))*100))
  cat(sprintf("   - Average replantations per parcel: %.2f\n", 
              mean(comprehensive_parcel_analysis$replantations_detected, na.rm = TRUE)))
}
```

```{r}
# ===============================
# PARCEL ANALYSIS VISUALIZATIONS
# Creating comprehensive plots for leaf monitoring and replantation analysis
# ===============================

# Load additional plotting libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(gridExtra)
library(RColorBrewer)
library(viridis)

cat("CREATING PARCEL ANALYSIS VISUALIZATIONS\n")
cat("=======================================\n")

# Set up consistent theme for all plots
theme_parcel <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 9),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Color palettes
colors_monitoring <- c("#2E86AB", "#A23B72", "#F18F01", "#C73E1D")
colors_replantation <- c("#264653", "#2A9D8F", "#E9C46A", "#F4A261")

# ===============================
# 1. MONITORING FREQUENCY ANALYSIS
# ===============================

cat("1. Creating monitoring frequency plots...\n")

# Plot 1a: Distribution of analyses per parcel
p1a <- parcel_analysis_frequency %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = total_leaf_analyses)) +
  geom_histogram(bins = 30, fill = colors_monitoring[1], alpha = 0.7, color = "white") +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept = mean(total_leaf_analyses)), 
             color = colors_monitoring[4], linetype = "dashed", size = 1) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Leaf Analyses per Parcel",
    subtitle = paste("Mean:", round(mean(parcel_analysis_frequency$total_leaf_analyses), 1), "analyses per parcel"),
    x = "Number of Leaf Analyses",
    y = "Number of Parcels"
  ) +
  theme_parcel +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 8)) +
  annotate("text", 
           x = mean(parcel_analysis_frequency$total_leaf_analyses) + 2, 
           y = Inf, 
           label = "Mean", 
           vjust = 2, 
           color = colors_monitoring[4])

# Plot 1b: Monitoring patterns pie chart
monitoring_summary <- comprehensive_parcel_analysis %>%
  count(monitoring_pattern) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = n / sum(n) * 100,
    label = paste0(monitoring_pattern, "\n", n, " parcels\n(", round(percentage, 1), "%)")
  )

p1b <- monitoring_summary %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = "", y = n, fill = monitoring_pattern)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", width = 1, color = "white", size = 1) +
  coord_polar("y", start = 0) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_monitoring) +
  labs(
    title = "Distribution of Monitoring Patterns",
    subtitle = paste("Total Parcels:", sum(monitoring_summary$n))
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_blank()
  ) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(round(percentage, 1), "%")), 
            position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5),
            color = "white", fontface = "bold")

# Plot 1c: Monitoring intensity over time
if(nrow(yearly_analysis) > 1) {
  p1c <- yearly_analysis %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Harvest_Year)) +
    geom_col(aes(y = total_analyses), fill = colors_monitoring[1], alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_line(aes(y = parcels_analyzed * 5), color = colors_monitoring[4], size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(aes(y = parcels_analyzed * 5), color = colors_monitoring[4], size = 3) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      name = "Total Analyses",
      sec.axis = sec_axis(~ . / 5, name = "Parcels Analyzed")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = "Monitoring Activity Over Time",
      subtitle = "Bars: Total analyses | Line: Number of parcels analyzed",
      x = "Harvest Year"
    ) +
    theme_parcel +
    theme(
      axis.title.y = element_text(color = colors_monitoring[1]),
      axis.title.y.right = element_text(color = colors_monitoring[4])
    )
} else {
  p1c <- ggplot() + 
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "Insufficient temporal data", size = 6) +
    theme_void()
}

# ===============================
# 2. REPLANTATION ANALYSIS PLOTS
# ===============================

cat("2. Creating replantation analysis plots...\n")

# Plot 2a: Replantation patterns
replantation_summary_plot <- comprehensive_parcel_analysis %>%
  count(replantation_pattern) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = n / sum(n) * 100,
    replantation_pattern = factor(replantation_pattern, 
                                 levels = c("No numeric cycles", "No replantations", 
                                          "Single replantation", "Multiple replantations"))
  )

p2a <- replantation_summary_plot %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = replantation_pattern, y = n, fill = replantation_pattern)) +
  geom_col(color = "white", size = 1) +
  geom_text(aes(label = paste0(n, "\n(", round(percentage, 1), "%)")), 
            vjust = 0.5, fontface = "bold", color = "white") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = colors_replantation) +
  labs(
    title = "Replantation Patterns Across Parcels",
    subtitle = paste("Based on", nrow(comprehensive_parcel_analysis), "parcels"),
    x = "Replantation Pattern",
    y = "Number of Parcels"
  ) +
  theme_parcel +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)
  )

# Plot 2b: Relationship between monitoring intensity and replantations
if(sum(!is.na(comprehensive_parcel_analysis$replantations_detected)) > 0) {
  p2b <- comprehensive_parcel_analysis %>%
    filter(!is.na(replantations_detected)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = total_leaf_analyses, y = replantations_detected)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = monitoring_pattern), size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
    geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = colors_replantation[2], size = 1) +
    scale_color_manual(values = colors_monitoring) +
    labs(
      title = "Relationship: Monitoring Intensity vs Replantations",
      subtitle = "Each point represents one parcel",
      x = "Total Leaf Analyses",
      y = "Number of Replantations Detected",
      color = "Monitoring Pattern"
    ) +
    theme_parcel +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
} else {
  p2b <- ggplot() + 
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No replantation data available", size = 6) +
    theme_void()
}

# ===============================
# 3. NUTRIENT ANALYSIS PLOTS
# ===============================

cat("3. Creating nutrient analysis plots...\n")

# Plot 3a: Nutrient levels by monitoring pattern
nutrient_long <- nutrient_by_monitoring %>%
  select(monitoring_pattern, N_mean, P_mean, K_mean) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols = c(N_mean, P_mean, K_mean), 
               names_to = "nutrient", 
               values_to = "concentration") %>%
  mutate(
    nutrient = case_when(
      nutrient == "N_mean" ~ "Nitrogen",
      nutrient == "P_mean" ~ "Phosphorus",
      nutrient == "K_mean" ~ "Potassium"
    ),
    nutrient = factor(nutrient, levels = c("Nitrogen", "Phosphorus", "Potassium"))
  )

p3a <- nutrient_long %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = monitoring_pattern, y = concentration, fill = nutrient)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "white") +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(option = "plasma", end = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Average Nutrient Levels by Monitoring Pattern",
    subtitle = "Mean leaf nutrient concentrations (%)",
    x = "Monitoring Pattern",
    y = "Nutrient Concentration (%)",
    fill = "Nutrient"
  ) +
  theme_parcel +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Plot 3b: Nutrient levels by crop cycle (if available)
if(exists("nutrient_by_cycle") && nrow(nutrient_by_cycle) > 0) {
  nutrient_cycle_long <- nutrient_by_cycle %>%
    select(cycle_category, avg_N, avg_P, avg_K) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(avg_N, avg_P, avg_K), 
                 names_to = "nutrient", 
                 values_to = "concentration") %>%
    mutate(
      nutrient = case_when(
        nutrient == "avg_N" ~ "Nitrogen",
        nutrient == "avg_P" ~ "Phosphorus", 
        nutrient == "avg_K" ~ "Potassium"
      ),
      nutrient = factor(nutrient, levels = c("Nitrogen", "Phosphorus", "Potassium")),
      cycle_category = factor(cycle_category, 
                            levels = c("Young (0-2)", "Mature (3-5)", "Old (6-8)", "Very Old (9+)"))
    )
  
  p3b <- nutrient_cycle_long %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = cycle_category, y = concentration, color = nutrient, group = nutrient)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma", end = 0.8) +
    labs(
      title = "Nutrient Levels by Crop Cycle Category",
      subtitle = "Trends in leaf nutrient concentrations over crop maturity",
      x = "Crop Cycle Category",
      y = "Average Nutrient Concentration (%)",
      color = "Nutrient"
    ) +
    theme_parcel +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom"
    )
} else {
  p3b <- ggplot() + 
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No crop cycle nutrient data available", size = 6) +
    theme_void()
}

# ===============================
# 4. TEMPORAL TRENDS
# ===============================

cat("4. Creating temporal trend plots...\n")

# Plot 4a: Nutrient trends over time
if(nrow(yearly_analysis) > 1) {
  yearly_nutrients_long <- yearly_analysis %>%
    select(Harvest_Year, avg_nitrogen, avg_phosphorus, avg_potassium) %>%
    pivot_longer(cols = c(avg_nitrogen, avg_phosphorus, avg_potassium),
                 names_to = "nutrient",
                 values_to = "concentration") %>%
    mutate(
      nutrient = case_when(
        nutrient == "avg_nitrogen" ~ "Nitrogen",
        nutrient == "avg_phosphorus" ~ "Phosphorus",
        nutrient == "avg_potassium" ~ "Potassium"
      ),
      nutrient = factor(nutrient, levels = c("Nitrogen", "Phosphorus", "Potassium"))
    )
  
  p4a <- yearly_nutrients_long %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Harvest_Year, y = concentration, color = nutrient)) +
    geom_line(size = 1.2) +
    geom_point(size = 3) +
    scale_color_viridis_d(option = "plasma", end = 0.8) +
    labs(
      title = "Nutrient Trends Over Time",
      subtitle = "Average leaf nutrient concentrations by harvest year",
      x = "Harvest Year",
      y = "Average Nutrient Concentration (%)",
      color = "Nutrient"
    ) +
    theme_parcel +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom") +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6))
} else {
  p4a <- ggplot() + 
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "Insufficient temporal data for trends", size = 6) +
    theme_void()
}

# Plot 4b: Replantations over time (if available)
if(exists("yearly_analysis") && "replantations_this_year" %in% names(yearly_analysis) && 
   sum(yearly_analysis$replantations_this_year, na.rm = TRUE) > 0) {
  
  p4b <- yearly_analysis %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = Harvest_Year, y = replantations_this_year)) +
    geom_col(fill = colors_replantation[3], alpha = 0.8, color = "white") +
    geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, color = colors_replantation[1], size = 1) +
    labs(
      title = "Replantation Events Over Time",
      subtitle = "Number of detected replantations per year",
      x = "Harvest Year", 
      y = "Number of Replantations"
    ) +
    theme_parcel +
    scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6)) +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = pretty_breaks(n = 6))
} else {
  p4b <- ggplot() + 
    annotate("text", x = 0.5, y = 0.5, label = "No replantation temporal data available", size = 6) +
    theme_void()
}

# ===============================
# 5. COMPREHENSIVE DASHBOARD
# ===============================

cat("5. Creating comprehensive dashboard...\n")

# Create multi-panel plots
cat("   Creating monitoring analysis panel...\n")
monitoring_panel <- grid.arrange(p1a, p1b, p1c, nrow = 3,
                                top = "MONITORING FREQUENCY ANALYSIS")

cat("   Creating replantation analysis panel...\n") 
replantation_panel <- grid.arrange(p2a, p2b, nrow = 2,
                                  top = "REPLANTATION PATTERN ANALYSIS")

cat("   Creating nutrient analysis panel...\n")
nutrient_panel <- grid.arrange(p3a, p3b, nrow = 2,
                              top = "NUTRIENT LEVEL ANALYSIS")

cat("   Creating temporal analysis panel...\n")
temporal_panel <- grid.arrange(p4a, p4b, nrow = 2,
                              top = "TEMPORAL TRENDS ANALYSIS")

# ===============================
# 6. SAVE ALL PLOTS
# ===============================

cat("6. Saving all plots...\n")

# Save individual plots
ggsave("01_analyses_distribution.png", p1a, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
ggsave("02_monitoring_patterns.png", p1b, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300)
if(exists("p1c")) ggsave("03_monitoring_over_time.png", p1c, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)

ggsave("04_replantation_patterns.png", p2a, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
if(exists("p2b")) ggsave("05_monitoring_vs_replantations.png", p2b, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

ggsave("06_nutrients_by_monitoring.png", p3a, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
if(exists("p3b")) ggsave("07_nutrients_by_cycle.png", p3b, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

if(exists("p4a")) ggsave("08_nutrient_trends.png", p4a, width = 12, height = 6, dpi = 300)
if(exists("p4b")) ggsave("09_replantation_trends.png", p4b, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)

# Save multi-panel plots
ggsave("10_monitoring_dashboard.png", monitoring_panel, width = 12, height = 16, dpi = 300)
ggsave("11_replantation_dashboard.png", replantation_panel, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
ggsave("12_nutrient_dashboard.png", nutrient_panel, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)
ggsave("13_temporal_dashboard.png", temporal_panel, width = 12, height = 10, dpi = 300)

# ===============================
# 7. SUMMARY STATISTICS PLOT
# ===============================

cat("7. Creating summary statistics visualization...\n")

# Create a summary statistics table plot
summary_stats <- data.frame(
  Metric = c(
    "Total Parcels",
    "Total Analyses", 
    "Avg Analyses/Parcel",
    "Parcels with Replantations",
    "Years Monitored",
    "Intensive Monitoring Rate"
  ),
  Value = c(
    nrow(comprehensive_parcel_analysis),
    sum(comprehensive_parcel_analysis$total_leaf_analyses),
    round(mean(comprehensive_parcel_analysis$total_leaf_analyses), 1),
    sum(comprehensive_parcel_analysis$replantations_detected > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    ifelse(exists("yearly_analysis"), nrow(yearly_analysis), "N/A"),
    paste0(round(sum(comprehensive_parcel_analysis$total_leaf_analyses >= 10) / 
                 nrow(comprehensive_parcel_analysis) * 100, 1), "%")
  )
)

# Create text-based summary plot
p_summary <- summary_stats %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = 1, y = rev(seq_along(Metric)), label = paste(Metric, ":", Value))) +
  geom_text(size = 5, hjust = 0, fontface = "bold") +
  xlim(0.5, 3) +
  labs(title = "PARCEL ANALYSIS SUMMARY STATISTICS",
       subtitle = paste("Analysis completed on", Sys.Date())) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5)
  )

ggsave("14_summary_statistics.png", p_summary, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300)
```
